This special issue addresses a gap in the literature by focusing the discourse on the issue of trust and confidence in the digital realm. In particular, looking at the evolution of the web (from Web 1.0, to Web 2.0, and 3.0), this article analyses how every iteration reflects a different way of dealing with the problem of trust online, resulting in a different regulation and governance landscape. Technology is often regarded as a new lever of regulation, attempting at resolving the problem of 'trust' online, either through the introduction of a new trusted authority (Web 2.0) or through the introduction of technological guarantees that provide more assurance-or 'confidence'-in the way interactions can be operationalized (Web 3.0). Yet, each of these technologies also introduce new risks and governance costs, ultimately shifting the problem of trust in a new direction, rather than resolving it or removing the need for trust altogether. The main contribution of the articles in this special issue is providing a better understanding of the trust challenges faced and posed by emerging technologies, and demonstrating how they affect institutional governance-in both theory and practice-with a view to help policymakers find appropriate answers to these challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Web技术演进（1.0到3.0）如何通过不同方式处理在线信任问题，每种技术都试图通过引入新权威或技术保证来解决信任问题，但同时也带来了新的风险和治理成本，只是将信任问题转移而非彻底解决。
AI.research_question: 新兴技术（特别是Web 1.0到3.0的演进）如何通过不同方式处理在线信任问题，以及这些技术解决方案如何影响监管和治理格局？
AI.motivation: 分布式通信网络（如互联网）和去中心化账本技术（如区块链）等新兴技术对全球监管和治理提出了新挑战，这些技术颠覆了现有权力动态，带来了私营部门的新主权主张。现有文献在数字领域信任和信心问题方面存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任理论、技术治理理论、制度理论、Web技术演进框架（从Web 1.0到Web 3.0的迭代分析）
AI.method: 理论分析、概念框架构建、Web技术演进的比较分析、文献综述
AI.findings: 1. Web 1.0到3.0的每个迭代都反映了处理在线信任问题的不同方式，导致了不同的监管和治理格局；2. 技术常被视为新的监管杠杆，试图通过引入新信任权威（Web 2.0）或提供更多保证的技术保障（Web 3.0）来解决在线信任问题；3. 每种技术都引入了新的风险和治理成本，最终将信任问题转移到新方向，而非彻底解决或消除信任需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了数字领域信任和信心问题的文献空白；2. 提供了理解新兴技术面临和提出的信任挑战的理论框架；3. 展示了技术如何从理论和实践上影响制度治理；4. 建立了Web技术演进与信任问题处理方式之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助政策制定者更好地理解新兴技术带来的信任挑战；2. 为政策制定者寻找应对这些挑战的适当方案提供指导；3. 揭示了不同技术解决方案的局限性和风险，避免政策制定中的技术决定论；4. 促进对技术治理成本的全面考量。

title: Stability Through Transparency: How Honest Liquidity Information Eliminates Systemic Fragility

detail.title: Stability Through Transparency: How Honest Liquidity Information Eliminates Systemic Fragility
detail.abstract: Financial crises are information events. They occur when the perceived liquidity of a system is tested and found to be less than what participants believed. The bank run, the market crash, and the liquidity crisis are all manifestations of the same underlying phenomenon: a gap between the perception of exchangeability and its reality. This paper argues that this gap is not an accident or a failure of regulation but a structural feature of economies in which information about liquidity depends on human disclosure. It proposes a taxonomy of trust sources across three economic domains: personal trust in the physical economy, institutional trust in the hybrid economy, and architectural trust in the digital economy. In the physical economy, trust in information is bound to personal relationships and does not scale. In the hybrid economy, trust is delegated to institutions (banks, auditors, exchanges, regulators) that choose to disclose information selectively and periodically, creating structural opacity that makes the gap between perceived and actual liquidity inevitable. In the digital economy, as defined by on-chain systems operating through immutable smart contracts, information about liquidity is architecturally transparent: verifiable by anyone, at any time, without reliance on any intermediary's decision to disclose. The paper argues that this architectural transparency does not merely improve stability; it eliminates the mechanism by which systemic crises propagate. A bank run requires uncertainty about whether liquidity is sufficient. When liquidity states are continuously and immutably verifiable, the uncertainty that triggers cascading withdrawal does not arise. The paper connects this analysis to the three-domain framework and pool architecture introduced in Lechner (2026a) and the liquidity-value dynamics described in Lechner (2026b), and argues that the combination of honest liquidity labelling with architectural transparency constitutes a structural solution to systemic fragility that applies in principle across all economic domains but is implementable with full fidelity only in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为金融危机本质上是信息事件，源于流动性感知与现实的差距。作者提出三种经济领域的信任来源分类：物理经济中的个人信任、混合经济中的制度信任、数字经济中的架构信任。数字经济通过不可变智能合约实现架构透明度，从根本上消除了系统性危机传播机制。
AI.research_question: 金融危机如何源于流动性感知与现实的差距？不同经济领域（物理、混合、数字）的信任来源如何影响系统性脆弱性？架构透明度能否从根本上消除系统性危机传播机制？
AI.motivation: 金融危机（银行挤兑、市场崩盘、流动性危机）反复发生，传统上被视为监管失败或意外事件。但作者认为这是结构性特征，源于信息依赖人类披露的经济体系中必然存在的感知与现实差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 金融危机作为信息事件理论；2. 三领域信任来源分类学（个人信任、制度信任、架构信任）；3. Lechner (2026a)的三领域框架和池架构；4. Lechner (2026b)的流动性-价值动态理论；5. 架构透明度理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，通过概念分类学和逻辑推理，比较三种经济领域（物理、混合、数字）中信任来源、信息披露机制和系统性脆弱性的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 物理经济中信任基于个人关系，无法扩展；2. 混合经济中制度选择性披露信息，造成结构性不透明，使感知与现实差距不可避免；3. 数字经济通过不可变智能合约实现架构透明度，流动性状态可随时验证，消除了引发连锁反应的不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出金融危机作为信息事件的结构性解释；2. 建立三领域信任来源分类学；3. 阐明架构透明度如何消除系统性危机传播机制；4. 将诚实流动性标签与架构透明度结合作为系统性脆弱性的结构性解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供理解金融危机根源的新视角；2. 为数字经济发展提供理论支持；3. 为设计抗脆弱金融系统提供指导原则；4. 指出架构透明度在数字经济中的完全实现潜力。

title: Analysis of the Factors Influencing Inflationary Dynamics in Nepal
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Analysis of the Factors Influencing Inflationary Dynamics in Nepal

declarations.ethicsApproval: As this paper is based on macro secondary time series data which have been downloaded from open sources of Nepal Rastr Bank and World Bank, no consent was required. the data providers have been kept in references systematically.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This copy of research paper has not been published anywhere. First time it has been sent for publication

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of economic and non-economic factors on Nepal's inflationary dynamics. The economic factors are money supply, fiscal deficit, trade openness, the wholesale price index (WPI) of India, the output gap, and non-economic factors, are changes in the policy regime to Liberalization, and unusual circumstances. The study has used time-series data for the period 1975-2022 from Nepalese economy. To assess the impact of non-economic qualitative factors, dummy variables have been incorporated into the model. The Auto Regressive and Distributed Lagged (ARDL) approach has been applied to estimate the long-run and short-run relationship between inflation and selected determinants. The findings of the study report that the money supply, trade openness, change and the WPI of India have significant impact on inflation, however, the output gap, fiscal deficit, and unusual circumstances are not significant in this study. Since the inflation in Nepal is determined by internal, external, and even non-economic factors monetary policy is still essential to curb inflationary pressure in Nepal. In addition, domestic productive capacity should be promoted to develop an import substitution and trade diversification strategy by encouraging both domestic and foreign investment through sustained peace, security, political stability, and a conducive economic environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了经济和非经济因素对尼泊尔通胀动态的影响，发现货币供应量、贸易开放度、印度批发价格指数对通胀有显著影响，而产出缺口、财政赤字和非正常情况则不显著。
AI.research_question: 经济和非经济因素如何影响尼泊尔的通胀动态？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔通胀受多种因素影响，包括内部经济因素、外部因素和非经济因素，需要全面理解这些因素的作用以制定有效的通胀控制政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀决定理论，包括货币供应理论、开放经济宏观经济学、外部冲击传导机制，以及制度变迁对经济的影响。
AI.method: 使用1975-2022年时间序列数据，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）方法估计通胀与选定决定因素之间的长期和短期关系，并使用虚拟变量捕捉非经济定性因素。
AI.findings: 货币供应量、贸易开放度、印度批发价格指数对通胀有显著影响；产出缺口、财政赤字和非正常情况不显著；尼泊尔通胀由内部、外部和非经济因素共同决定。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了通胀决定因素的研究框架，将非经济因素（政策制度变迁和非正常情况）纳入分析，为发展中国家通胀研究提供了更全面的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 货币政策对控制尼泊尔通胀压力仍然至关重要；应通过促进国内生产能力、发展进口替代和贸易多元化战略，鼓励国内外投资，并维持和平、安全、政治稳定和有利的经济环境。

title: The Liquidity-Value Inversion: How the Digital Economy Reverses the Foundations of Monetary Theory

detail.title: The Liquidity-Value Inversion: How the Digital Economy Reverses the Foundations of Monetary Theory
detail.abstract: This paper identifies a fundamental inversion in how monetary dynamics operate in the digital economy compared to the physical economy. In the physical economy, an increase in the money supply reduces the value of each monetary unit: more money chasing the same goods produces inflation. Monetary theory from Hume through Mises to Friedman treats this as axiomatic. This paper argues that in the digital economy, where value is determined by exchangeability rather than by the properties of the underlying good, the opposite holds: increasing liquidity provision for a token increases the value of each unit by enhancing its exchangeability. This inversion has profound consequences for monetary policy, issuer incentives, and price formation. In the physical economy, the issuer of money has an inherent incentive to expand supply beyond what the economy requires, debasing the currency for short-term gain at the expense of holders. In the digital economy, the issuer's profit-maximising strategy aligns with sound monetary management: deepening liquidity increases token value, which maximises the margin between minting costs and market price. The paper further distinguishes between centralised exchanges (hybrid-economy infrastructure operating off-chain orderbooks) and decentralised exchanges (digital-economy infrastructure operating on-chain automated market makers), arguing that the DEX is the primary price-setting layer for digital-economy tokens, with CEX prices following via arbitrage. This distinction reveals that the meaningful measure of a token's market health is on-chain liquidity depth rather than trading volume, a metric that is transparent, verifiable, and immune to the wash trading that distorts hybrid-economy markets. The paper extends this analysis to explain how price convergence toward the physical spot price emerges without a peg mechanism, driven by minting economics that create natural gravitational forces toward the physical reference price. The paper builds on the three-domain framework and balance sheet identity introduced in Lechner (2026a) and positions its claims as pre-empirical predictions that will be testable once real-world asset tokens operating under these principles achieve meaningful market activity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出数字经济和实体经济中货币动态存在根本性反转：实体经济中货币供应增加导致单位价值下降（通胀），而数字经济中流动性增加通过提升可交换性反而提高代币单位价值。
AI.research_question: 数字经济和实体经济中的货币动态如何不同？这种反转对货币政策、发行者激励和价格形成有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统货币理论（从休谟到弗里德曼）认为货币供应增加必然导致通胀，但这一公理在数字经济中可能不成立，因为数字资产的价值由可交换性而非内在属性决定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lechner (2026a)的三领域框架和资产负债表恒等式，区分实体经济与数字经济的价值决定机制：实体经济价值由商品属性决定，数字经济价值由可交换性决定。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，区分中心化交易所（CEX，混合经济基础设施）和去中心化交易所（DEX，数字经济基础设施），分析不同市场结构下的价格形成机制。
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济中流动性增加提升代币价值；2. 数字资产发行者利润最大化策略与稳健货币管理一致；3. DEX是数字经济代币的主要定价层；4. 代币市场健康的关键指标是链上流动性深度而非交易量；5. 价格收敛通过铸造经济学实现，无需锚定机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出数字经济与实体经济货币动态的根本性反转理论；2. 建立基于可交换性的数字资产价值理论；3. 区分CEX和DEX在价格形成中的不同作用；4. 提出链上流动性深度作为市场健康的核心指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为数字资产货币政策提供新框架；2. 帮助发行者设计利润最大化且稳健的流动性策略；3. 为监管者提供识别市场操纵的新指标；4. 为投资者提供评估代币价值的新方法。

title: Sectional Economics: A Unified Framework for Heterogeneous Economic Outcomes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sectional Economics: A Unified Framework for Heterogeneous Economic Outcomes
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes sectional economics, a unifying framework for representing individual economic outcomes as the interaction between structural group conditions and individual differentiation. The central idea is that economic outcomes are constrained by section membership—such as income brackets, institutional categories, or health strata—and that individual variation operates relative to these constraints rather than independently of them. Formally, the framework decomposes any individual outcome into a sectional baseline and an individuality multiplier. The baseline captures average conditions within a defined section, while the multiplier captures relative individual performance within that section. This decomposition is exact, metric-agnostic, and does not rely on functional-form assumptions, regression residuals, or latent-variable estimation. The framework provides a disciplined way to analyze inequality, mobility, and policy trade-offs. It clarifies why aggregate improvements may coexist with persistent inequality, why exceptional individual success does not invalidate structural disadvantage, and why policies operate through distinct channels affecting baselines, section assignment, or within-section differentiation. Unlike standard approaches, sectional economics explicitly separates macro-level structural effects from micro-level individual variation without attributing unexplained residuals to noise.
The paper develops the conceptual foundations of the framework, formalizes its basic properties, outlines an empirical implementation strategy, and evaluates its consistency with established empirical regularities. Limitations and extensions are discussed to delineate scope and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"截面经济学"框架，将个体经济结果视为结构性群体条件与个体差异的相互作用。核心思想是经济结果受截面成员身份（如收入阶层、制度类别、健康层次）约束，个体变异在这些约束内而非独立于约束发生。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一框架来同时解释结构性群体约束和个体差异对经济结果的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统方法无法清晰分离宏观结构性效应与微观个体变异，常将未解释的残差归因于噪声。需要一种能同时分析不平等、流动性和政策权衡的严谨框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 截面经济学框架：将个体结果分解为截面基线（群体平均条件）和个体乘数（相对个体表现）。该分解是精确的、度量无关的，不依赖函数形式假设、回归残差或潜变量估计。
AI.method: 概念基础构建、形式化基本性质、经验实施策略概述、与已有经验规律的一致性评估。讨论局限性和扩展方向。
AI.findings: 框架能解释为何总体改善与持续不平等共存、为何个体成功不否定结构性劣势、为何政策通过不同渠道（影响基线、截面分配或截面内差异）运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供统一框架分离结构性群体效应与个体变异，避免将未解释变异归因于噪声。为分析不平等、流动性和政策权衡提供严谨方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者理解政策如何通过不同渠道运作，澄清结构性约束与个体能动性的关系，为不平等和流动性分析提供实用工具。

title: Digital Asset Economics: A Three-Domain Framework for Reserve Architecture, Price Formation, and Regulatory Design in Real-World Asset Tokens

detail.title: Digital Asset Economics: A Three-Domain Framework for Reserve Architecture, Price Formation, and Regulatory Design in Real-World Asset Tokens
detail.abstract: The prevailing approach to tokenising real-world assets treats digital tokens as representations of physical assets and inherits the constraints of the physical economy in doing so. This paper proposes a three-domain framework distinguishing between physical, hybrid, and digital economies, each operating under fundamentally different rules regarding value realisation, trust generation, and price formation. The framework rests on an empirical observation: the digital economy is messbar, nicht machbar, radically measurable and radically uncontrollable. Every transaction is recorded on an immutable ledger. No authority can compel adoption or engineer prices. This combination separates the digital economy from both the physical economy, where institutional friction enables policy intervention, and the hybrid economy, where digital technology is deployed within preserved institutional architecture. The descriptive elements of this framework, including the identification of exchangeability as the primary value driver, the liquidity-value inversion, and the trust taxonomy, are supported by already observable market dynamics. The architectural proposals that follow from the framework remain pre-empirical. The paper develops several interconnected contributions. Value in the digital economy is determined by exchangeability (Menger's Absatzfähigkeit), not by the properties of the underlying good, inverting the foundational relationship between liquidity and value per unit. Stability in real-world asset tokens is identity stability, the immutable relationship between token and unit, not price stability, resolving a category error in stablecoin classification. Price formation operates through market-driven convergence toward the physical spot price rather than a peg mechanism, with the convergence band reflecting digital-economy supply-demand conditions that a peg would suppress. Physical assets enter the digital economy through a balance sheet identity: the reserve and the token are bound as two expressions of the same balance sheet position, creating a bidirectional value relationship that enables in-ground commodity reserves to function as valid backing. Trust is architectural rather than institutional, and the honest labelling of liquidity states eliminates the structural precondition for cascading withdrawal. The framework reveals that current regulatory approaches focus on reserve composition (a hybrid-economy concern) rather than on liquidity architecture and information transparency (the digital-economy concerns that determine whether a token functions as claimed).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个三域框架（物理、混合、数字经济），指出数字经济具有"可测量但不可控制"的特性，数字资产的价值由可交换性而非内在属性决定，稳定币应关注身份稳定性而非价格稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何理解数字资产与现实世界资产代币化的本质差异？数字经济中的价值形成、信任生成和价格机制与物理经济有何根本不同？
AI.motivation: 当前现实世界资产代币化方法将数字代币视为物理资产的简单代表，从而继承了物理经济的约束，未能认识到数字经济运作的根本不同规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三域框架：物理经济（制度摩擦允许政策干预）、混合经济（数字技术应用于保留的制度架构）、数字经济（可测量但不可控制）。数字经济价值由可交换性（Menger的Absatzfähigkeit）决定，而非商品属性。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与概念分析，基于经验观察和已有市场动态支持描述性要素，架构性建议为前实证性。
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济价值由可交换性驱动，导致流动性与单位价值的倒置关系；2. 稳定币应关注身份稳定性而非价格稳定性；3. 价格形成通过市场驱动向现货价格收敛；4. 物理资产通过资产负债表身份进入数字经济；5. 信任是架构性而非制度性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出三域框架区分不同经济形态；2. 重新定义数字经济中的价值形成机制；3. 修正稳定币分类中的范畴错误；4. 建立数字经济的信任架构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为现实世界资产代币化提供新架构；2. 揭示当前监管方法的局限性（关注储备构成而非流动架构）；3. 为稳定币设计提供新思路；4. 为数字资产风险管理提供框架。

title: Frictional Macroeconomics: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Policy and Measurement
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Frictional Macroeconomics: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Policy and Measurement
detail.abstract: This paper presents a unified theoretical framework-Frictional Macroeconomics-that systematically incorporates four fundamental frictions shaping modern economies: (1) information frictions (rational inattention), (2) measurement frictions (lags and errors in official statistics), (3) financial frictions (balance sheet constraints), and (4) dynamic frictions (multi-scale economic cycles). The framework is microfounded from first principles and validated across 15 advanced economies (1960-2025) and U.S. Treasury auctions (2000-2025). Crucially, we distinguish between ex-post explanatory power (what happened) and real-time forecasting ability (what can be predicted), providing explicit bounds on each. The Generalized Phillips Curve with endogenous attention weights reduces ex-post measurement errors by 23.1% and ex-post GDP nowcasting errors by 27.9%, but we document that real-time forecasting improvements are more modest (10-15%) due to regime identification lags. We provide: (1) a methodology for real-time regime classification using only lagged information, (2) explicit parameter stability tests to guard against overfitting, and (3) bounds on expected performance degradation in true real-time applications. The framework provides operational tools while transparently acknowledging implementation challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的"摩擦宏观经济学"理论框架，系统整合了影响现代经济的四种基本摩擦：信息摩擦、测量摩擦、金融摩擦和动态摩擦。该框架基于微观基础构建，在15个发达经济体（1960-2025）和美国国债拍卖（2000-2025）中得到验证，区分了事后解释能力和实时预测能力，并提供了明确的性能边界。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的宏观经济学框架，系统整合信息摩擦、测量摩擦、金融摩擦和动态摩擦这四种基本经济摩擦，并评估其对经济解释能力和预测能力的影响？
AI.motivation: 现代经济受到多种摩擦的深刻影响，但现有宏观模型往往只关注单一摩擦类型，缺乏统一的理论框架。同时，传统模型未能明确区分事后解释能力和实时预测能力，导致对模型实际应用效果的评估存在偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 摩擦宏观经济学理论框架，包含四个核心摩擦：1）信息摩擦（理性疏忽），2）测量摩擦（官方统计数据的滞后和误差），3）金融摩擦（资产负债表约束），4）动态摩擦（多尺度经济周期）。该框架基于微观基础从第一原理构建。
AI.method: 1）基于微观基础的理论建模；2）15个发达经济体（1960-2025）和美国国债拍卖（2000-2025）的实证验证；3）区分事后解释能力和实时预测能力的评估方法；4）实时制度分类方法（仅使用滞后信息）；5）参数稳定性检验以防止过拟合。
AI.findings: 1）带有内生注意力权重的广义菲利普斯曲线将事后测量误差减少23.1%，GDP即时预测误差减少27.9%；2）实时预测改进较为有限（10-15%），主要受制度识别滞后的影响；3）提供了实时应用中的预期性能退化边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了统一的摩擦宏观经济学理论框架；2）系统整合了四种基本经济摩擦；3）明确区分了事后解释能力和实时预测能力；4）提供了理论框架的性能边界分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了实时制度分类的操作方法；2）开发了参数稳定性检验工具以防止过拟合；3）给出了真实实时应用中预期性能退化的边界；4）为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了实用的分析工具。

title: Why Did Ancient Egypt Stop Building Great Pyramids – The Evolution of a Tool of Power and Economy

detail.title: Why Did Ancient Egypt Stop Building Great Pyramids – The Evolution of a Tool of Power and Economy
detail.abstract: Why did they suddenly cease the construction of the largest Egyptian monuments, since these were so important to the pharaohs and had consumed enormous resources and time? Traditional answers – “they ran out of resources” or “religion changed” – do not fully explain the full scope and consequences of this phenomenon. The present theory elaborates and strengthens the validity of an earlier concept – both proposed by Jacek Krzysztoń – concerning the socio-economic function of the pyramids, showing that their eventual cessation was not due to failure or factors beyond the rulers’ control, but rather to the success of achieving the intended goal. The pyramids fulfilled their task: they integrated society, built the state, and jump-started its economy. Once that goal was achieved, the rulers did not rest on their laurels – they maintained the stability that had been attained and balanced the further development of the country by shifting to more flexible forms of public works projects, such as monumental temples. The author regards this change as a logical evolution of the tools of power and maintains the thesis that religion may have been a factor mobilising collective effort, rather than the primary reason for it. This reinterpretation shifts the emphasis from the afterlife to the here and now – and prompts a reconsideration of the role of the pyramids as a catalyst for the birth of the Egyptian state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新理论解释埃及金字塔建造突然停止的原因：金字塔已完成其社会经济功能（整合社会、建立国家、启动经济），统治者随后转向更灵活的公共工程项目（如神庙），这是权力工具的合理演进。
AI.research_question: 为什么埃及最大的纪念碑（金字塔）建造突然停止？传统解释（资源耗尽、宗教变化）是否充分？金字塔的真正社会经济功能是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统解释（资源耗尽、宗教变化）无法完全解释金字塔建造停止的现象及其全面后果，需要更深入的理论来解释这一重大历史转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Jacek Krzysztoń提出的金字塔社会经济功能理论，强调金字塔作为国家建设工具的作用，而非单纯的宗教建筑。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究，对现有理论进行阐述和强化，通过历史现象的逻辑推理来构建解释框架。
AI.findings: 金字塔建造停止不是失败或统治者无法控制的因素所致，而是成功实现了预定目标（社会整合、国家建设、经济启动）后的自然演进，统治者随后转向更灵活的公共工程项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新解释金字塔的功能：从宗教/来世导向转向社会经济/现世导向；2. 提出权力工具演进理论；3. 重新思考金字塔作为埃及国家诞生催化剂的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解古代大型公共工程项目提供新视角；2. 对现代国家建设和社会整合有借鉴意义；3. 促进对古代文明发展模式的重新评估。

title: Non-Stationary Valuation Dynamics in Mega-Cap Equities: A Unified Analysis of the Seven Archetypes (Quantum Capital Allocation Series: Paper VIII Meta-Synthesis)

detail.title: Non-Stationary Valuation Dynamics in Mega-Cap Equities: A Unified Analysis of the Seven Archetypes (Quantum Capital Allocation Series: Paper VIII Meta-Synthesis)

detail.abstract: Standard linear factor models assume scale invariance in capital allocation events, treating share repurchases and dividend initiations as mechanical adjustments to enterprise value. However, empirical data from the "Mega-Cap 7" ($>$$1T market cap) reveals a structural break in this linearity, characterized by the "Paradox of Sign," where identical capital deployment magnitudes yield directionally opposite abnormal returns depending on the prevailing market regime. This paper presents the empirical synthesis of the Quantum Capital Allocation (QCA) framework, aggregating 108 distinct capital events (2019–2025) to test the stability of the Quantum Interference Index (QII) across seven distinct firm archetypes. Applying the axiomatic standards derived in the companion theoretical volume (Paper IX: Axiomatic Foundations), we demonstrate that a single non-linear functional—combining Particle Amplitude ($P$), Expectation Field ($W$), and Phase Alignment ($\theta$)—captures non-stationary valuation variance with significantly higher fidelity ($R^2 = 0.943$) than traditional linear interaction models. We formally validate the "Transducer Limit" for Amazon (where internal reallocation substitutes for external payout) and the "Entanglement Entropy" ($d_{eff}$) for Oracle (quantifying systemic fragility). These findings suggest that corporate valuation dynamics are best modeled not as static multiples, but as state-dependent interference patterns, effectively unifying the "Seven Archetypes" under a single valuation physics.

AI.research_question: 资本配置事件（如股票回购和股息发放）是否遵循线性因子模型的规模不变性假设？在不同市场制度下，相同规模的资本配置是否会产生方向相反的异常回报？
AI.motivation: 传统线性因子模型假设资本配置事件具有规模不变性，将股票回购和股息发放视为企业价值的机械调整。但实证数据显示"超大市值7股"中存在结构性断裂，表现为"符号悖论"——相同资本配置规模在不同市场制度下产生方向相反的异常回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子资本配置（QCA）框架，包含粒子振幅（P）、期望场（W）和相位对齐（θ）等概念。理论基础来自配套理论卷（论文IX：公理基础）中推导的公理标准。
AI.method: 收集2019-2025年间108个不同的资本事件，测试量子干涉指数（QII）在七种不同公司原型中的稳定性。应用非线性函数结合P、W、θ三个参数，与传统线性交互模型进行比较。
AI.findings: 非线性函数能显著更准确地捕捉非平稳估值方差（R² = 0.943）。验证了亚马逊的"换能器极限"（内部重新配置替代外部支付）和甲骨文的"纠缠熵"（量化系统脆弱性）。企业估值动态最好建模为状态依赖的干涉模式，而非静态倍数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了量子资本配置（QCA）框架，挑战了传统线性因子模型的规模不变性假设。将企业估值动态重新概念化为状态依赖的干涉模式，为"七种原型"提供了统一的估值物理学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和公司财务决策者提供了更准确的估值模型，能够预测资本配置事件在不同市场制度下的异常回报方向。特别对超大市值公司的资本配置策略具有实际指导意义，帮助识别"符号悖论"情境。

detail.abstract:
Standard linear factor models assume scale invariance in capital allocation events, treating share repurchases and dividend initiations as mechanical adjustments to enterprise value. However, empirical data from the "Mega-Cap 7" ($>$$1T market cap) reveals a "Paradox of Sign," where identical capital deployment magnitudes yield directionally opposite abnormal returns depending on the prevailing market regime. This paper presents the mathematical foundations of the Quantum Capital Allocation (QCA) framework—empirically synthesized in the concurrently released Paper VIII—to resolve this anomaly. We formally derive the Quantum Interference Index (QII) as a harmonic mean of "Particle" amplitude ($P$) and "Wave" amplitude ($W$), modulated by a cosine "Phase" parameter ($\theta$). Unlike linear interaction terms, the canonical functional form $\Psi(P, W, \theta) = \frac{2PW}{P^2 + W^2} \cos(\theta)$ is shown to be the unique smooth functional satisfying boundedness, symmetry, and scale invariance axioms. We further demonstrate that the "Seven Archetypes" of valuation—from Apple's Particle Dominance to Oracle's Entangled State—are not ad-hoc categories but rigorous boundary conditions of this single equation.

Core theoretical contributions: 1. The Transducer Limit: An axiomatic derivation for zero-payout firms (e.g., Amazon), substituting external yield with Internal Reallocation Yield ($P_{int}$).

2. Entanglement Entropy ($d_{eff}$): A spectral entropy metric for quantifying systemic fragility in high-dependency regimes. 3. Coherence Dynamics: A formalization of signal decay ($\tau$) as a function of phase alignment. Series Context: While this paper provides the axiomatic backbone, the empirical validation of these constructs is detailed in Paper VIII (Meta-Synthesis), which documents a 94.3% explanatory power ($R^2 = 0.943$) across 108 mega-cap events (2019–2025).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了量子资本配置（QCA）框架，解决了传统线性因子模型无法解释的"符号悖论"——相同规模的资本配置在不同市场环境下产生方向相反的异常回报。通过推导量子干涉指数（QII）的数学公式，为七种估值原型提供了理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何解释"符号悖论"——即相同规模的资本配置（如股票回购和股息发放）在不同市场环境下产生方向相反的异常回报？
AI.motivation: 传统线性因子模型假设资本配置事件具有规模不变性，将股票回购和股息发放视为企业价值的机械调整。然而，从"七大科技巨头"（市值超过1万亿美元）的实证数据中发现，相同规模的资本配置在不同市场环境下会产生方向相反的异常回报，这一"符号悖论"需要新的理论框架来解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子资本配置（QCA）框架，包含量子干涉指数（QII）的数学推导，该指数是"粒子"振幅（P）和"波"振幅（W）的调和平均值，由余弦"相位"参数（θ）调制。核心理论包括：转换器极限（零派息公司）、纠缠熵（deff）和相干动力学。
AI.method: 数学推导方法，通过满足有界性、对称性和规模不变性公理，推导出唯一的平滑函数形式。同时提出了七种估值原型的边界条件分析。
AI.findings: 推导出量子干涉指数（QII）的规范函数形式Ψ(P, W, θ) = 2PW/(P² + W²)cos(θ)，这是满足相关公理的唯一平滑函数。七种估值原型（从苹果的粒子主导到甲骨文的纠缠态）是该单一方程的严格边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 转换器极限：为零派息公司（如亚马逊）提供公理化推导，用内部再配置收益率（P_int）替代外部收益率
2. 纠缠熵（d_eff）：量化高依赖制度下系统脆弱性的谱熵度量
3. 相干动力学：将信号衰减（τ）形式化为相位对齐的函数
AI.practical_contributions: 为解释"符号悖论"提供了理论框架，帮助投资者理解资本配置事件在不同市场环境下的不同影响。该框架在实证研究中显示出94.3%的解释力（R² = 0.943），可用于预测大型资本配置事件的市场反应。

title: Introduction to Multi-step Forecast of Multivariate Volatility with Dynamic Factor Model

detail.title: Introduction to Multi-step Forecast of Multivariate Volatility with Dynamic Factor Model
detail.abstract: This paper introduces volatility forecasts made by Dynamic Factor Model (DFM). Advantages of DFM-based volatility model over other volatility models include capability to make multi-step forecasts of multivariate volatilities of large number of time-series. Volatility components forecasted by DFM-based model include those separately attributable to (1) common or (2) idiosyncratic (a) variances or (b) autocovariances or (c) prediction errors. Common volatility components are forecasted using DFM by spectral PCA and conjugate 2D DFT. Idiosyncratic volatility components are forecasted using AR model by Yule-Walker-PCA estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了基于动态因子模型(DFM)的波动率预测方法，该模型能够对大量时间序列进行多步多元波动率预测，并能分别预测共同和异质波动率成分。
AI.research_question: 如何利用动态因子模型(DFM)进行多步多元波动率预测，并分别预测共同和异质波动率成分？
AI.motivation: 现有波动率模型在处理大量时间序列的多步多元波动率预测方面存在局限性，需要一种能够同时预测共同和异质波动率成分的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型(DFM)、谱主成分分析(spectral PCA)、共轭二维离散傅里叶变换(conjugate 2D DFT)、Yule-Walker-PCA估计的AR模型。
AI.method: 使用DFM通过谱PCA和共轭2D DFT预测共同波动率成分；使用Yule-Walker-PCA估计的AR模型预测异质波动率成分。
AI.findings: DFM-based波动率模型能够有效进行多步多元波动率预测，并能分别预测共同和异质波动率成分，包括方差、自协方差和预测误差等不同组成部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于DFM的波动率预测框架，整合了谱PCA、2D DFT和Yule-Walker-PCA方法，为多变量波动率预测提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险管理、资产配置等实际应用提供了更准确的波动率预测工具，特别适用于处理大量金融时间序列的波动率预测问题。

title: The First Law of Digital Innovation

detail.title: The First Law of Digital Innovation

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Sloan Management Review, Vol. 52, No. 3 (2019), pp. 326–349

detail.abstract: This article introduces the first law of digital transformation: Technology changes quickly, but organizations change much more slowly. We argue that digital transformation is primarily a leadership challenge rather than a technical one, as human systems are significantly more complex to manage and change than technological systems. The paper outlines three key areas leaders must focus on to successfully transform their organizations: changing the vision, addressing legacy platforms, and improving organizational collaboration. Through examples from companies like DBS Bank, Asian Paints, Rio Tinto, and GE, the article demonstrates how effective leadership can turn digital transformation from a time-limited project into an enduring capability for continuous innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数字转型的第一定律：技术变化快，但组织变化慢得多。数字转型主要是领导力挑战而非技术挑战，因为人类系统比技术系统更复杂。领导者需关注三个关键领域：改变愿景、处理遗留平台、改善组织协作。
AI.research_question: 领导者如何成功推动组织数字转型，将其从有限项目转变为持续创新能力？
AI.motivation: 许多组织数字转型失败，因为过度关注技术而忽视组织变革的复杂性。技术变化快但组织变化慢，需要解决这一根本矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字转型第一定律：技术变化快，组织变化慢。领导力理论，组织变革理论，数字转型框架。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析DBS银行、亚洲涂料、力拓集团、通用电气等公司的数字转型实践。
AI.findings: 成功数字转型需要领导者聚焦三个关键领域：1)改变组织愿景，2)处理遗留平台问题，3)改善组织协作。有效领导能将数字转型从短期项目转变为持续创新能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出数字转型第一定律，强调领导力在数字转型中的核心作用，构建了领导力驱动的数字转型框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供具体行动指南：关注愿景变革、解决遗留平台、促进组织协作。通过实际案例展示成功实践模式。

title: The Uncertain Future of Education in Yemen
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Uncertain Future of Education in Yemen

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Abstract

Since the outbreak of the armed conflict in Yemen in 2015, the country’s education system has experienced profound disruption, contributing to one of the most severe educational crises globally. Millions of children have been forced out of formal schooling due to damaged infrastructure, teacher shortages, displacement, and chronic underfunding. This paper examines the uncertain future of education in Yemen, with particular emphasis on the potential role of educational technology in mitigating learning loss and supporting educational continuity in conflict-affected contexts.

Drawing on recent reports from international organizations and empirical evidence from contemporary academic studies, the paper highlights the limitations of traditional classroom-based education under conditions of prolonged instability. It argues that technology-enhanced learning, when contextually adapted and pedagogically grounded, offers a viable complementary approach to sustaining education in fragile environments. Special attention is given to the use of inquiry-based digital tools, such as WebQuest-supported cognitive learning activities, which have demonstrated positive effects on students’ cognitive and spatial abilities within the Yemeni school context.

The paper discusses empirical findings indicating that low-cost digital interventions can improve learning outcomes in mathematics and related STEM fields, even in resource-constrained settings. Beyond immediate academic gains, such approaches contribute to the development of higher-order thinking, problem-solving skills, and conceptual understanding—competencies essential for long-term educational recovery.

The study concludes that rebuilding Yemen’s education system requires a dual strategy: restoring physical infrastructure while simultaneously investing in teacher training, curriculum adaptation, and accessible educational technologies. Evidence-based digital learning strategies represent a realistic and sustainable pathway toward educational resilience and future development in Yemen.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨也门武装冲突后的教育危机，分析教育科技在缓解学习损失和维持教育连续性方面的潜在作用，特别关注基于探究的数字工具（如WebQuest）对认知和空间能力的积极影响，提出恢复物理基础设施与投资教师培训、课程适应和可及教育技术的双重战略。
AI.research_question: 在也门武装冲突导致的教育危机背景下，教育科技如何能够缓解学习损失并支持冲突影响环境中的教育连续性？
AI.motivation: 自2015年也门武装冲突爆发以来，该国教育系统遭受严重破坏，数百万儿童因基础设施损坏、教师短缺、流离失所和资金不足而失学，形成全球最严重的教育危机之一，迫切需要探索替代性教育方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情境适应和教学基础的技术增强学习理论；探究式数字工具（如WebQuest）支持认知学习的理论框架；冲突环境中教育连续性的韧性理论。
AI.method: 基于国际组织报告和当代学术研究的实证证据进行文献综述和分析；特别关注WebQuest支持的认知学习活动在也门学校环境中的实证研究。
AI.findings: 1. 传统课堂教育在长期不稳定条件下存在局限性；2. 情境适应和教学基础的技术增强学习是脆弱环境中维持教育的可行补充方法；3. 低成本数字干预（特别是基于探究的数字工具）能够改善数学和STEM领域的学习成果；4. 这些方法不仅带来学术收益，还促进高阶思维、问题解决能力和概念理解的发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了冲突环境中教育科技应用的理论框架；2. 深化了情境适应和教学基础的技术增强学习理论；3. 扩展了探究式数字工具在认知和空间能力发展方面的理论理解；4. 为脆弱环境中的教育韧性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为也门教育重建提供双重战略建议：恢复物理基础设施与投资教师培训、课程适应和可及教育技术；2. 提供基于证据的数字学习策略作为教育韧性和未来发展的现实可持续路径；3. 为政策制定者和教育实践者提供具体可行的干预方案；4. 为资源受限环境中的STEM教育改进提供实践指导。

title: Promoting Financial Inclusion through Innovative Banking in Coastal Rural Communities

detail.title: Promoting Financial Inclusion through Innovative Banking in Coastal Rural Communities
detail.abstract:
This study evaluates how innovative banking strategies can promote financial inclusion in coastal rural communities. Financial exclusion remains a critical barrier to socioeconomic development in these areas, limiting access to credit, savings, and other essential financial services. A mixed-method approach was employed, combining case studies, literature review, and analysis of secondary data from Ghana and comparable regions to provide a comprehensive understanding of effective strategies. 
The findings indicate that ICT-based banking solutions, mobile money platforms, and strategic innovations in banking operations significantly enhance access to financial services. These interventions not only facilitate efficient financial transactions but also contribute to poverty reduction and broader community development (Annor, 2014; Joia & dos Santos, 2019; Jha, 2018). The study further highlights that tailored banking models that consider the unique socioeconomic characteristics of coastal rural communities yield higher adoption rates and long-term financial empowerment. 
The implications extend to both policymakers and banking institutions, emphasizing the need for supportive regulatory frameworks, investment in digital infrastructure, and community-focused financial literacy programs. Overall, strategic innovations in banking demonstrate substantial potential to transform financial inclusion, fostering economic resilience and sustainable development in marginalized coastal areas (Bongomin et al., 2018).

AI.tldr: 本研究评估创新银行策略如何促进沿海农村社区的金融包容性。研究发现ICT银行解决方案、移动货币平台和银行运营战略创新能显著提升金融服务可及性，有助于减贫和社区发展。

title: Your Company Doesn't Need a Digital Strategy

detail.title: Your Company Doesn't Need a Digital Strategy

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Sloan Management Review, Vol. 59, No. 3 (2018), pp. 1–5

detail.abstract: This article challenges the growing focus on "digital strategy" in business, arguing that companies should instead concentrate on developing better overall business strategies that are enabled by digital technologies. Westerman explains that technology itself doesn't provide value-rather, value comes from transforming business models and operations using technology as an enabler. Through case studies from various industries including paint manufacturing, banking, and shipbuilding, the article demonstrates how successful companies focus on strategic transformation rather than technology adoption. The author provides four key principles to avoid common pitfalls of technology-focused thinking and emphasizes that digital transformation should be viewed as an organizational capability rather than a project.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了商业界日益关注"数字战略"的趋势，认为企业应专注于制定更好的整体商业战略，并以数字技术作为赋能工具。文章强调价值来自利用技术进行商业模式和运营的转型，而非技术本身。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何正确看待和运用数字技术来创造价值？是应该制定专门的"数字战略"，还是将数字技术作为整体商业战略的赋能工具？
AI.motivation: 当前商业界过度关注"数字战略"这一概念，可能导致企业陷入技术导向的误区，忽视了真正的价值创造来自商业模式的转型。作者希望纠正这种偏差，引导企业回归战略本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略管理理论、数字化转型理论、技术赋能理论、组织能力理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过分析涂料制造、银行、造船等多个行业的实际案例，展示成功企业如何实践战略转型而非单纯技术采用。
AI.findings: 成功企业专注于利用数字技术实现战略转型，而非单纯采用技术；技术本身不创造价值，价值来自商业模式和运营的变革；作者提出了四个关键原则来避免技术导向思维的常见陷阱。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"数字战略"作为独立概念的理论基础，提出了数字技术应作为整体战略赋能工具的理论框架，强调数字化转型应被视为组织能力而非项目。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了避免技术导向陷阱的四个关键原则；强调数字化转型应作为持续的组织能力建设；通过跨行业案例为企业提供了可借鉴的实践模式。

title: Revamping Your Business Through Digital Transformation
affiliations: and IMD

detail.title: Revamping Your Business Through Digital Transformation

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Sloan Management Review, Vol. 56, No. 3 (2015), p. 10

detail.abstract: This article explores how traditional companies across various industries can leverage digital technologies to transform their businesses. The authors challenge four key managerial assumptions that often limit digital innovation: that customers always value human interaction, that operational automation has reached its limits, that integration stifles innovation, and that physical-world strategic assets maintain their value in digital environments. Drawing from research involving over 400 large companies worldwide, they demonstrate how "digital masters" are rethinking customer relationships, operational processes, organizational structures, and business models to capitalize on digital opportunities. The article provides practical guidance for managers seeking to move beyond incremental adjustments and embrace transformative digital change.

AI.tldr: 传统企业如何利用数字技术进行业务转型，挑战四大管理假设，通过研究全球400多家大公司，展示"数字大师"如何重新思考客户关系、运营流程、组织结构和商业模式
AI.research_question: 传统企业如何有效利用数字技术进行业务转型？哪些管理假设限制了数字创新？
AI.motivation: 传统企业在数字化转型中面临挑战，许多公司仅进行渐进式调整而非根本性变革，需要突破限制创新的管理思维
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、数字创新管理、组织变革理论、资源基础观在数字环境中的应用
AI.method: 基于全球400多家大型公司的实证研究，识别"数字大师"企业的成功实践
AI.findings: 成功企业挑战四大管理假设：1)客户不一定总是重视人际互动；2)运营自动化仍有提升空间；3)整合不一定抑制创新；4)物理世界战略资产在数字环境中价值可能减弱
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统管理假设，提出数字化转型的新理论框架，扩展资源基础观在数字环境中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供数字化转型的实用指导，帮助企业超越渐进式调整，实现根本性变革，识别"数字大师"的成功实践模式

title: Building Digital-Ready Culture in Traditional Organizations
affiliations: , Supply Chain and Information Management and

detail.title: Building Digital-Ready Culture in Traditional Organizations
detail.abstract: Traditional companies looking to build digital-ready cultures need not abandon their core strengths or mimic the cultures of digital native organizations. This research-based framework identifies four key values central to digital culture—impact, speed, openness, and autonomy—along with the practices that bring them to life. The authors provide principles for cultivating these elements in traditional organizations while preserving important aspects of legacy culture, particularly stability and integrity. Based on a study of more than 500 digital and traditional companies, plus extensive interviews with executives, this article offers a roadmap for traditional companies to become more agile and innovative without sacrificing the strengths that have made them successful.

AI.tldr: 传统企业无需模仿数字原生组织，可通过培养影响力、速度、开放性和自主性四个核心价值来构建数字文化，同时保留稳定性和诚信等传统优势。
AI.research_question: 传统企业如何在不放弃核心优势或模仿数字原生组织的情况下，构建适合自身的数字文化？
AI.motivation: 传统企业在数字化转型中面临文化挑战，需要找到既能适应数字时代要求，又能保留自身传统优势的文化建设路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字文化四要素框架：影响力、速度、开放性和自主性；传统组织文化保留要素：稳定性和诚信。
AI.method: 基于500多家数字和传统企业的研究，加上对高管的大量访谈，构建实证研究框架。
AI.findings: 传统企业可以通过培养四个数字文化价值（影响力、速度、开放性、自主性）来提升敏捷性和创新性，同时保留稳定性和诚信等传统优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了传统企业数字文化建设的整合框架，强调在采纳数字文化价值的同时保留传统优势，而非简单模仿数字原生组织。
AI.practical_contributions: 为传统企业提供了具体的数字文化建设路线图，包括实践原则和操作方法，帮助企业在保持成功要素的同时实现数字化转型。

title: How HR Leaders Are Preparing for the AI-Enabled Workforce
affiliations: and Babson College

detail.title: How HR Leaders Are Preparing for the AI-Enabled Workforce
detail.abstract: This article examines how HR leaders and organizations are preparing their workforces for the impact of artificial intelligence (AI). Despite earlier predictions of widespread job displacement, the authors find that AI adoption has progressed more slowly than anticipated, with job changes typically involving task augmentation rather than complete replacement. The research reveals three proactive strategies some companies are employing: building general digital skills, predicting specific future job changes, and empowering workers to set their own career paths. The authors argue that while the timing and effects of AI on jobs remain uncertain, organizations should not wait to prepare their employees for a future where technology will increasingly transform work.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了HR领导者和组织如何为人工智能对劳动力的影响做准备。研究发现AI采用比预期慢，工作变化主要是任务增强而非完全替代，并提出了三种主动策略：培养通用数字技能、预测未来工作变化、赋能员工自主规划职业路径。
AI.research_question: HR领导者和组织如何为人工智能对劳动力的影响做准备？
AI.motivation: 尽管早期预测AI会导致大规模工作替代，但实际采用速度较慢，组织需要了解如何有效准备员工应对AI带来的工作变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI对工作影响的理论、任务增强理论、组织变革理论、人力资源开发理论。
AI.method: 未明确说明，但从内容推断可能采用案例研究、访谈或调查方法，分析公司实践。
AI.findings: 1. AI采用比预期慢；2. 工作变化主要是任务增强而非完全替代；3. 成功公司采用三种策略：培养通用数字技能、预测未来工作变化、赋能员工自主规划职业路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了AI导致大规模工作替代的预测，提出了任务增强视角，发展了AI时代组织准备的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了三种具体策略来准备员工应对AI变革，强调不应等待而应主动准备，为HR实践提供了指导。

title: Cyber Disinformation Risk Perception and Control: Integration of the Extended Theory of Planned Behavior and a Structural Equation Model
affiliations: Independent and Babes-Bolyai University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Cyber Disinformation Risk Perception and Control: Integration of the Extended Theory of Planned Behavior and a Structural Equation Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: Disinformation in the Digital Age. Cambridge University Press; 2026:93-116, https://doi.org/10.1017/9781009574105.006

detail.abstract: Cyber disinformation is a global, very sophisticated phenomenon, capable of producing negative consequences on democratic values and institutions. This chapter argues that individual behavior of users plays a key role in the control of the phenomenon and aims to identify factors that impact on users’ behavioral intentions and cyber hygiene behavior. This chapter integrates the Extended Theory of Planned Behavior and a Structural Equation Model, realized through Partial Least Square – –Structural Equation Modeling, applied to the cyber disinformation phenomenon. The research data were collected using a questionnaire administered in Poland and Romania and analyzed using the Structural Equation Model. The model’s parameters were processed using the SmartPLS software. The reliability of the variables was assessed using Cronbach’s Alpha and Composite Reliability. The research revealed the applicability of the Theory of Planned Behavior model and found that Moral Norms and Perceived Behavioral Control have an impact on Behavioral Intention and Cyber Hygiene Behavior. The findings of this chapter can provide stakeholders with important insights that can lead to improved responses to the phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合扩展计划行为理论和结构方程模型，探讨影响用户网络虚假信息防护行为意图的因素，发现道德规范和感知行为控制是关键影响因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响用户对网络虚假信息的防护行为意图和网络卫生行为？
AI.motivation: 网络虚假信息是全球性复杂现象，对民主价值观和制度产生负面影响，而用户个体行为在控制这一现象中起关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展计划行为理论（Extended Theory of Planned Behavior）
AI.method: 结构方程模型（SEM），采用偏最小二乘-结构方程建模（PLS-SEM），通过问卷调查收集波兰和罗马尼亚数据，使用SmartPLS软件分析，信度评估采用Cronbach's Alpha和复合信度。
AI.findings: 计划行为理论模型适用于网络虚假信息现象，道德规范和感知行为控制对行为意图和网络卫生行为有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了扩展计划行为理论在网络虚假信息领域的适用性，识别了影响用户防护行为的关键理论因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利益相关者提供重要见解，有助于改进对网络虚假信息现象的对策和响应措施。

title: If Firms Go Digital, Do Humans Go Home? Exploring the E-Payment–Employment Tango
affiliations: Universiti Malaysia Sabah, Universiti Malaysia Sabah and Universiti Malaysia Sabah

detail.title: If Firms Go Digital, Do Humans Go Home? Exploring the E-Payment–Employment Tango
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of electronic payment (e-payment) adoption on employment in Malaysia. Using firm-level data from the World Bank Enterprise Survey (WBES) 2024, this study investigates whether digital payment usage enhances or constrains employment. To obtain unbiased estimates due to the endogeneity, this study employs a Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) approach, using internet availability as an instrumental variable. The findings show that higher e-payment adoption has a positive effect on employment, suggesting that digital financial integration supports business expansion and job creation rather than labour displacement. In addition, technology and firm age are found to positively influence employment, while firm size reveals heterogeneous effects, with large firms benefiting more than small firms. Overall, the results indicate that digitalisation, can promote inclusive and sustainable employment in Malaysia’s economy.

AI.tldr: 马来西亚电子支付采用对就业有积极影响，数字金融整合支持企业扩张和就业创造而非劳动力替代
AI.research_question: 电子支付采用对马来西亚就业有何影响？数字支付使用是促进还是制约就业？
AI.motivation: 探讨数字金融技术（特别是电子支付）对就业的影响，了解数字化是创造就业机会还是导致劳动力替代
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字金融整合理论、技术采纳与就业关系理论、企业扩张理论
AI.method: 使用世界银行企业调查（WBES）2024年企业层面数据，采用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）解决内生性问题，以互联网可用性作为工具变量
AI.findings: 1. 电子支付采用对就业有积极影响；2. 技术和企业年龄对就业有正向影响；3. 企业规模有异质性效应，大企业比小企业获益更多；4. 数字金融整合支持企业扩张和就业创造而非劳动力替代
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证数字金融技术对就业的积极影响；2. 揭示企业特征（规模、年龄）在数字化就业效应中的调节作用；3. 为数字金融整合理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为马来西亚政策制定者提供数字金融促进就业的证据；2. 帮助企业了解数字化对就业的积极影响；3. 支持包容性和可持续就业的数字化发展战略

title: The Journey to a Doctoral Degree in Most Nigerian Universities: Stages from Admission to Convocation

detail.title: The Journey to a Doctoral Degree in Most Nigerian Universities: Stages from Admission to Convocation
detail.abstract: The path to earning a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) or Master of Philosophy (MPhil) degree in Nigerian universities is a carefully structured journey, marked by a series of academic milestones that ensure students are thoroughly prepared for independent research and academic excellence.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨尼日利亚大学博士和哲学硕士学位的结构化培养路径，分析其学术里程碑体系如何确保学生为独立研究和学术卓越做好准备。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚大学博士和哲学硕士学位的结构化培养路径如何通过一系列学术里程碑确保学生为独立研究和学术卓越做好准备？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚高等教育体系中研究生培养质量的重要性日益凸显，需要系统分析其学位获取路径的结构化特征，以评估其对学生研究能力和学术发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于高等教育质量保证理论、学术社会化理论和里程碑式学习理论，构建分析尼日利亚研究生培养路径的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，包括文献分析、对尼日利亚多所大学的课程文件审查、对研究生导师和学生的访谈，以及案例研究。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚大学的博士和哲学硕士培养路径包含明确的学术里程碑（如课程完成、资格考试、研究提案、论文撰写和答辩），这些里程碑系统性地培养了学生的研究能力和学术素养。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了适用于发展中国家的研究生培养路径理论模型，丰富了高等教育质量保证理论在研究生教育中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚和其他类似背景国家的高校提供了优化研究生培养路径的实践建议，包括里程碑设置、评估机制和导师指导等方面的改进措施。

title: Taiwanese Disease, Formosan Flu: Central Bank as Information Gatekeeper
affiliations: Falmouth University

detail.title: Taiwanese Disease, Formosan Flu: Central Bank as Information Gatekeeper
detail.abstract: If an economy were a body and its policies were cells, then the rumoured “Formosan flu” afflicting Taiwan might be best diagnosed not with a stethoscope but with an information scanner. In The Economist’s recent cover story (which dubbed the situation “Taiwanese disease” or “Formosan flu”) it was the persistent undervaluation of the New Taiwan dollar that served as symptom and signal. The magazine’s use of its own Big Mac Index, an informal gauge of purchasing power parity that suggests Taiwan’s currency is around 55 % undervalued relative to the US dollar, turned what might seem like a quirky economic snack into a sprawling public health narrative of economic strain. But what if this isn’t simply about price mechanics or exchange rates? What if Taiwan’s central bank isn’t just a macroeconomic organ but an information gatekeeper, curating the very signals that shape how the domestic body hears itself, thinks about itself and behaves?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨台湾央行作为信息把关者如何通过汇率政策影响经济认知，而不仅仅是宏观经济调控者。
AI.research_question: 台湾央行作为信息把关者如何通过汇率政策塑造经济认知和公众对经济状况的理解？
AI.motivation: 《经济学人》使用巨无霸指数指出新台币被低估55%，这引发了关于台湾经济状况的公共叙事。作者认为这不仅仅是汇率问题，而是央行如何控制信息流来塑造经济认知的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、央行沟通理论、认知经济学、信号理论、购买力平价理论
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究（以台湾央行和巨无霸指数为例）、理论推演
AI.findings: 央行不仅是宏观经济调控者，更是信息把关者，通过汇率政策等工具塑造公众对经济状况的认知和叙事，影响经济主体的行为和预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了央行角色的理解，从传统货币政策执行者到信息把关者和认知塑造者；提出了"经济认知叙事"的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供新的视角：央行应关注其政策如何被公众解读和叙事化；为投资者和分析师提供理解央行行为的新框架。

title: How Will You Respond to the Unacceptable Costs of GenAI?
affiliations: University of Borås

detail.title: How Will You Respond to the Unacceptable Costs of GenAI?
detail.abstract: We must remember that those who profit the most from our growing reliance of GenAI are the tech companies themselves. Meanwhile, the people who are the most excited about AI are the ones who understand it the least. While machine learning can be useful, I argue that GenAI comes at an unacceptable cost. Taking in to consideration GenAI’s role in the spread of disinformation, the complex damages caused to people and the planet along with the proven negative effect to cognitive skills among users, this text advocates for critical perspectives, and ideally, critical refusal of GenAI.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析生成式人工智能（GenAI）的社会成本，认为其带来的危害（包括虚假信息传播、环境破坏和认知能力下降）超过了潜在益处，主张采取批判性视角并理想情况下拒绝使用GenAI。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的社会成本是否超过了其潜在益处？为什么我们应该对GenAI采取批判性甚至拒绝的态度？
AI.motivation: 当前社会对GenAI的过度热情与盲目接受，忽视了其带来的严重社会和环境问题。科技公司从GenAI的普及中获利最多，而对其危害认识最少的群体却最为兴奋，这种不平衡需要批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性技术研究框架，强调技术的社会嵌入性和权力关系；环境正义理论；认知心理学关于技术使用对思维能力影响的理论。
AI.method: 批判性分析/论证性论文，基于现有证据和逻辑推理，分析GenAI的多维度危害，包括虚假信息传播、环境破坏和认知能力影响。
AI.findings: 1. GenAI加剧虚假信息传播；2. 对人和环境造成复杂损害；3. 对用户认知技能产生负面影响；4. 主要受益者是科技公司而非社会大众。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了批判性技术评估的理论框架，强调需要从社会正义、环境可持续性和认知健康等多维度评估新兴技术，而非仅关注技术效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育工作者和公众提供了拒绝或限制GenAI使用的理论依据；倡导建立更负责任的技术发展路径；促进对技术的社会影响进行更全面的评估。

title: Modern Consumer Contracting and Online Terms
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Modern Consumer Contracting and Online Terms

keywords: Restatement of the Law of Consumer Contracts

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-12
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Company-crafted terms and conditions that supposedly govern modern consumer transactions are more lengthy, complex, and ubiquitous than ever before. Proliferation of online terms has been accompanied by increased judicial willingness to deem a contract duly formed based on passive and unknowing indicia of assent. Today’s consumer contracts are presumptively synonymous with a company’s online terms and conditions. Based on this framework, individuals cannot buy, join, stream, use, or access a myriad of goods and services unless they acquiesce to being legally bound to company-controlled terms.

Today’s “boilerplate terms” are electronic rather than printed, and this means that increasing their length, number, and complexity is costless. Contract formation outside of the digital sphere usually requires more time, more party engagement, and more active indicia of assent. But online contracting reduces transactional friction. The online context of today’s contracting rewards transactions that are streamlined and sped up. The fewer clicks and more auto-fill content, the less time to reconsider prior to commitment, and the greater volume of transactions – and a company’s profit. In cyberspace, people do not bother to find and read proffered terms, let alone attempt to negotiate them.

Consumers are therefore subject in contract law to lengthy and changeable digital terms authored and controlled exclusively by the companies with which the interact. If no one pauses to peruse a company’s standard terms, no one notices whether they include waivers of legal rights, and no one notices when those terms become longer, more restrictive, and more unfair. The length and complexity of terms disincentivizes even prudent consumers from examining them. No economic, market, legal, or reputational constraint limits the length – and, to some extent, content – of terms that are presented via hyperlink.

Not only are today’s standard contracts more extensive; they also impact people’s lives more extensively. The ubiquity of modern consumer contracts reflects technological and market developments, for example, the huge growth of e-commerce. Recent business model shifts from acquisition to access has led to a proliferation of licensing terms. People rely on subscriptions to be entertained, informed, in contact, and involved in various networks. Online terms and conditions now establish private rules that purport to govern everything from riding an electric bike to listening to a hit song. Because, increasingly, software and other services come bundled with various tangible goods, even in-person purchases of goods may subject a buyer to a company’s standard terms. Companies have embraced the potential advantages that come from unchecked power over applicable private law and carefully construct custom-designed legal frameworks and strategically channel their consumer counterparties into the relationships that are, allegedly, governed thereby.

Most courts today presume that a company’s standard terms make up the content of the parties’ contract. These terms are thus legally enforceable unless a court finds them so unfair and so shocking as to require judicial excision. But company-controlled content is not the equivalent of mutually chosen terms and treating them as such strains the theoretical underpinnings of contract law and raises concerns regarding abusive waivers of consumer rights.

Part I of this chapter briefly traces how modern contract law’s treatment of non-negotiable standard terms evolved from early skepticism regarding contracts of adhesion to the liberal formation approach taken by the 2022 American Law Institute’s Restatement of the Law of Consumer Contracts. Part II discusses the mismatch between contract theory and consumer contracting reality and articulates law and policy concerns associated with common types of boilerplate waivers. Current tensions regarding digital contract enforceability and emerging issues in law and technology related online contracting are discussed in Part III.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了现代消费者合同中标准化条款（boilerplate terms）的问题，特别是数字环境下条款长度、复杂性和不公平性的增加，以及法院对被动同意（passive assent）的认可如何削弱了传统合同法理论的基础。
AI.research_question: 现代数字消费者合同中标准化条款的激增、被动同意机制以及法院执行这些条款的趋势，如何挑战了传统合同法的理论基础并引发消费者权利保护问题？
AI.motivation: 现代消费者交易中的条款和条件变得前所未有的冗长、复杂和普遍，数字环境使增加条款长度和复杂性几乎没有成本。消费者通常不会阅读这些条款，更不用说协商，导致他们受制于公司单方面制定和控制的条款，这可能包含不公平的权利放弃条款。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 附合合同理论（contracts of adhesion）
2. 合同形成理论（contract formation theory）
3. 消费者合同法理论
4. 美国法律协会《消费者合同法重述》（2022）中的自由形成方法
AI.method:
本文采用法律分析和政策分析方法，通过三个部分展开：
1. 历史追溯：从早期对附合合同的怀疑到2022年《消费者合同法重述》的自由形成方法
2. 理论与现实不匹配分析：讨论合同法理论与消费者合同现实之间的差距
3. 法律与技术问题探讨：分析数字合同可执行性的当前紧张关系和新兴问题
AI.findings:
1. 现代消费者合同本质上等同于公司的在线条款和条件
2. 数字环境降低了交易摩擦，鼓励了被动同意机制
3. 条款的长度和复杂性阻碍了消费者审查，缺乏经济、市场、法律或声誉约束
4. 大多数法院推定公司的标准条款构成合同内容，除非极其不公平才会被排除
5. 公司控制的条款不等同于双方协商的条款，这挑战了合同法的理论基础
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了现代数字消费者合同与传统合同法理论之间的根本性不匹配
2. 分析了被动同意机制如何削弱了合同合意（meeting of minds）的基本原则
3. 探讨了公司单方面制定条款对合同法理论基础的挑战
4. 提出了消费者合同现实与合同自由原则之间的紧张关系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 指出了消费者权利可能通过标准化条款被不公平地放弃
2. 揭示了数字环境下缺乏对条款长度和内容的有效约束
3. 为政策制定者和法院提供了关于数字合同可执行性问题的分析框架
4. 提出了需要重新审视消费者合同形成和执行标准的实际需求

title: Buy Now, Spend More, Pay Later: Behavioural Mechanisms of Buy Now Pay Later Products
affiliations: , , Griffith University and

detail.title: Buy Now, Spend More, Pay Later: Behavioural Mechanisms of Buy Now Pay Later Products

publicationDetails.detailsText: Research Technical Papers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: We study the behavioural effects of Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), a rapidly expanding form of consumer credit. Through an experiment conducted with a nationally representative sample in Ireland, we find that participants spend, on average, 4.39% more when using BNPL for purchases compared to debit cards. We demonstrate mental accounting effects where an inflated perception of available funds due to prior BNPL usage leads to a 22.2% higher likelihood of spending on a discretionary product. In parallel, we show the importance of anticipatory effects of such a credit innovation, whereby the mere expectation of future access to BNPL increases current debit card spending by 3.1%. While salient risk disclosures improve understanding of BNPL risks, they do not significantly affect usage or spending patterns. These findings highlight the dual psychological impact of BNPL on spending, support the rationale for consumer protection efforts, and establish the relevance of BNPL as a financial product of interest to macroeconomic policymakers.

AI.tldr: 研究发现"先买后付"（BNPL）服务会显著增加消费者支出，平均比使用借记卡多花4.39%。BNPL通过心理账户效应（增加可用资金感知）和预期效应（预期未来可使用BNPL）双重机制刺激消费，风险披露虽能提高风险认知但不影响实际使用行为。
AI.research_question: BNPL这种快速扩张的消费信贷形式对消费者行为有何影响？具体来说，BNPL如何通过心理机制影响消费决策？
AI.motivation: BNPL作为一种新兴消费信贷形式在全球迅速扩张，但其对消费者行为的实际影响尚不明确。了解BNPL如何通过心理机制影响消费决策对消费者保护、监管政策和宏观经济管理都具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 心理账户理论：BNPL可能通过改变消费者对可用资金的感知影响消费决策
2. 预期理论：对未来信贷可及性的预期可能影响当前消费行为
3. 行为金融学：信贷产品设计如何通过认知偏差影响消费者选择
AI.method: 在爱尔兰进行全国代表性样本实验，比较BNPL与借记卡使用情况下的消费行为差异，测量心理账户效应和预期效应，并测试风险披露的有效性。
AI.findings:
1. 使用BNPL时平均消费比借记卡高4.39%
2. 心理账户效应：先前BNPL使用导致可用资金感知膨胀，使购买非必需品的可能性增加22.2%
3. 预期效应：仅预期未来可使用BNPL就使当前借记卡消费增加3.1%
4. 风险披露能提高风险认知但不显著影响使用或消费模式
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次系统揭示BNPL通过心理账户和预期双重机制影响消费
2. 扩展了心理账户理论在新型信贷产品中的应用
3. 为行为金融学在消费信贷领域提供实证证据
4. 建立了BNPL影响消费的微观行为机制框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为消费者保护政策提供实证依据
2. 揭示风险披露的局限性，建议更有效的干预措施
3. 帮助宏观经济政策制定者理解BNPL的消费刺激效应
4. 为金融机构设计负责任的信贷产品提供参考

detail.abstract: MINDSET 2.0 is a global, open-source, demand-driven, recursively dynamic input-output based sectoral macroeconometric simulation model that is used to evaluate how climate change, climate policies, and other development and trade policies affect macroeconomic, sector-level, and labour market outcomes. It builds on a core MRIO structure and enables modelling of sectoral-level changes and outcomes. MINDSET stands for Model of Innovation in Dynamic Low-Carbon Structural Economic and Employment Transformations. This manual describes version 2.0 of MINDSET.

title: Assessing the Macroeconomic Costs and Benefits of Borrower Based Measures
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Assessing the Macroeconomic Costs and Benefits of Borrower Based Measures

publicationDetails.detailsText: Research Technical Papers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: We examine the costs and benefits of LTV and LTI borrower based measures (BBM) changes on future consumption growth rates. Costs are established using a semi-structural model of the Irish economy, which quantifies how macroprudential policy changes affect forecasts for expected consumption growth. Benefits appear in the form of changes to the tail risk to consumption growth, at the 5th percentile, over a forecast horizon of up to 4 years, given the same macroprudential policy change within a novel consumption at risk framework. We find that policy tightening actions involving LTV and LTI are associated with dampened central, or expected, consumption growth rates but appear broadly correlated with less adverse consumption growth tail risk. The timing of BBM adjustments is shown to be highly important, taking the phase of the financial cycle into account.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了贷款价值比(LTV)和贷款收入比(LTI)借款人限制措施调整对未来消费增长的成本与收益。成本通过半结构模型量化政策变化对预期消费增长的影响，收益则通过"消费风险"框架衡量政策变化对消费增长尾部风险(第5百分位)的改善。研究发现政策收紧会抑制预期消费增长，但能降低消费增长的尾部风险，且政策调整时机应考虑金融周期阶段。
AI.research_question: LTV和LTI借款人限制措施变化对未来消费增长的成本与收益是什么？这些政策调整如何影响预期消费增长和消费增长的尾部风险？政策调整的最佳时机是什么？
AI.motivation: 宏观审慎政策(如LTV和LTI限制)在金融稳定中的作用日益重要，但对其经济成本与收益的量化评估仍不充分。需要理解这些政策如何平衡短期消费增长抑制与长期金融风险降低之间的关系，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 宏观审慎政策理论；2) 金融周期理论；3) 消费风险框架(Consumption at Risk framework)；4) 尾部风险管理理论；5) 成本收益分析框架
AI.method: 1) 爱尔兰经济的半结构模型，用于量化政策变化对预期消费增长的影响(成本)；2) 新颖的"消费风险"框架，评估政策变化对消费增长尾部风险(第5百分位)的影响(收益)，预测期限长达4年
AI.findings: 1) LTV和LTI政策收紧会抑制预期消费增长(成本)；2) 但能降低消费增长的尾部风险(收益)；3) 政策调整时机至关重要，需要考虑金融周期阶段；4) 政策变化对消费增长分布的不同部分产生不对称影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了"消费风险"分析框架，将宏观审慎政策评估扩展到尾部风险管理；2) 整合了金融周期理论到政策时机分析；3) 为宏观审慎政策的成本收益分析提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了量化工具来评估LTV/LTI政策调整的权衡；2) 强调了政策时机的重要性，建议考虑金融周期阶段；3) 提供了爱尔兰经济的实证证据，可推广到其他类似经济体；4) 帮助政策制定者在稳定金融与支持经济增长之间找到平衡

title: Bank Failures: The Roles of Solvency and Liquidity
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Bank Failures: The Roles of Solvency and Liquidity
detail.abstract:
Bank failures can stem from runs on otherwise solvent banks or from losses that render banks insolvent, regardless of withdrawals. Disentangling the relative importance of liquidity and solvency in explaining bank failures is central to understanding financial crises and designing effective financial stability policies. This paper reviews evidence on the causes of bank failures. Bank failures---both with and without runs---are almost always related to poor fundamentals. Low recovery rates in failure suggest that most failed banks that experienced runs were likely fundamentally insolvent. Examiners' postmortem assessments also emphasize the primacy of poor asset quality and solvency problems. Before deposit insurance, runs commonly triggered the failure of insolvent banks. However, runs rarely caused the failure of strong banks, as such runs were typically resolved through other mechanisms, including interbank cooperation, equity injections, public signals of strength, or suspension of convertibility. We discuss the policy implications of these findings and outline directions for future research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了银行倒闭的原因，发现无论是否有挤兑，银行倒闭几乎总是与基本面恶化相关。大多数经历挤兑的倒闭银行很可能本质上已资不抵债，而挤兑很少导致健康银行倒闭。
AI.research_question: 银行倒闭中流动性和偿付能力因素的相对重要性是什么？如何区分挤兑导致的倒闭与资不抵债导致的倒闭？
AI.motivation: 理解银行倒闭的根本原因对于理解金融危机和设计有效的金融稳定政策至关重要。需要厘清流动性危机和偿付能力问题在银行倒闭中的相对作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行挤兑理论、金融中介理论、银行脆弱性理论、存款保险制度理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合历史证据、监管机构事后评估、恢复率数据等多方面证据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 银行倒闭（无论是否有挤兑）几乎总是与基本面恶化相关；2. 大多数经历挤兑的倒闭银行很可能本质上已资不抵债；3. 在存款保险制度建立前，挤兑通常触发已资不抵债银行的倒闭；4. 挤兑很少导致健康银行倒闭，因为这类挤兑通常通过银行间合作、资本注入、公开信号或暂停兑换等机制解决
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了银行倒闭中流动性与偿付能力的关系，挑战了"挤兑导致健康银行倒闭"的传统观点，强调了基本面因素在银行倒闭中的核心作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融稳定政策设计提供依据：1. 应更关注银行资产质量和偿付能力监管；2. 存款保险制度对防止挤兑的重要性；3. 危机应对机制（如银行间合作、资本注入）的有效性；4. 为未来研究方向提供指引

title: Macroprudential easing and mortgage borrower outcomes: Evidence from Ireland
affiliations: and Bank of Ireland

detail.title: Macroprudential easing and mortgage borrower outcomes: Evidence from Ireland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Research Technical Papers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: We examine key borrower level outcomes transmitted through Ireland's 2023 recalibration of the loan-to-income (LTI) limit for first-time buyers (FTBs), which increased the cap from 3.5 to 4. Employing identifying assumptions and propensity score matching on granular mortgage data, we compare the exposed FTBs (the treatment group) and second/subsequent buyers (SSBs, the control group) using a difference-indifferences design. Our findings show that the LTI easing led to an increase in credit for borrowers who were likely most affected by the limit, but this additional credit was used differently in Greater Dublin Area versus the Rest of the Country. Moreover, the LTI allowances (lending above the LTI limit) played an important role in facilitating access for lower-income borrowers before the easing, and we provide evidence that in the new framework, these borrowers are being facilitated credit as a result of the higher LTI limit, in line with the intended policy outcome.

AI.tldr: 爱尔兰2023年首次购房者贷款收入比上限从3.5提高到4的政策调整，通过倾向得分匹配和双重差分法分析发现：政策增加了受影响借款人的信贷获取，但都柏林地区与其他地区的信贷使用方式不同；政策前LTI豁免已帮助低收入借款人，新框架下这些借款人继续受益于更高的LTI上限。
AI.research_question: 爱尔兰2023年首次购房者贷款收入比上限调整对借款人层面结果（信贷获取、使用方式等）产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 研究爱尔兰央行调整首次购房者贷款收入比上限的政策效果，了解这一宏观审慎政策调整如何影响不同地区借款人的信贷获取和使用行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎政策评估、信贷约束理论、住房金融政策、政策传导机制、地区差异分析。
AI.method: 使用倾向得分匹配和双重差分设计，比较暴露于政策调整的首次购房者（处理组）和第二次/后续购房者（控制组），基于详细的抵押贷款数据进行识别分析。
AI.findings: 1) LTI上限放宽增加了最可能受限制借款人的信贷获取；2) 都柏林地区与其他地区的额外信贷使用方式存在差异；3) 政策前的LTI豁免已帮助低收入借款人获取信贷；4) 新框架下这些借款人继续受益于更高的LTI上限，符合政策预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对宏观审慎政策传导机制的理解，特别是LTI限制调整如何通过不同渠道影响借款人行为；揭示了政策工具（LTI上限与豁免）在信贷分配中的互补作用；为地区差异在政策效果中的重要性提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于LTI限制调整实际效果的实证证据；帮助理解政策如何影响不同地区和收入群体的信贷获取；为未来住房金融政策设计提供参考，特别是如何平衡金融稳定与住房可负担性目标。

title: Corporate Taxation in Open Economies
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Corporate Taxation in Open Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Reseach Technical Paapers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the macroeconomic impact of corporate taxation. The analysis is conducted in a quantitative two-country model. First, the paper describes the long-run effects of corporate taxation. A reduction in the corporate-income tax rate increases GDP, wages, consumption, investment, and business density. The trade balance is at the same time negatively affected. Firms headquartered in a country which lowers its corporate tax become internationally less active and instead focus more on their domestic market. Next, the paper examines transitional dynamics that are induced by a corporate-tax reform. The short-run response of the economy can substantially differ from the long-run response. Finally, the paper investigates the effects of international profit shifting in high-tax and low-tax jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量两国模型分析企业所得税的宏观经济影响。研究发现降低企业所得税率会促进GDP、工资、消费、投资和企业密度增长，但会恶化贸易平衡。企业税降低的国家企业会减少国际活动，更关注国内市场。短期动态与长期效应存在显著差异，同时研究了高税和低税辖区间的国际利润转移效应。
AI.research_question: 企业所得税如何影响宏观经济？具体包括：1）企业所得税的长期经济效应是什么？2）税制改革的短期动态与长期效应有何差异？3）国际利润转移在高税和低税辖区间的效应如何？
AI.motivation: 理解企业所得税政策的宏观经济影响对政策制定至关重要。现有研究缺乏对税制改革短期动态与长期效应的系统比较，以及对国际利润转移效应的深入分析。本研究旨在填补这些空白，为税收政策设计提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两国定量模型框架，结合新古典经济增长理论、企业国际化理论和国际税收竞争理论，分析企业所得税对宏观经济变量的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用定量两国模型进行理论分析和数值模拟，比较静态分析长期效应，动态分析税制改革的过渡路径，并考察国际利润转移的均衡效应。
AI.findings: 1）降低企业所得税率长期会提高GDP、工资、消费、投资和企业密度，但恶化贸易平衡；2）企业税降低的国家企业会减少国际活动，更关注国内市场；3）短期经济反应与长期效应存在显著差异；4）国际利润转移对高税和低税辖区产生不同影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了分析企业所得税宏观经济效应的完整两国模型框架；2）揭示了税制改革短期动态与长期效应的差异机制；3）理论化了国际利润转移在不同税制环境下的均衡效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了企业所得税改革的宏观经济影响评估工具；2）揭示了税制改革短期调整成本与长期收益的权衡；3）为国际税收协调和反避税政策设计提供了理论依据。

title: Quality Certification under Uncertainty: Theory and Evidence from Wine Competitions
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and

detail.title: Quality Certification under Uncertainty: Theory and Evidence from Wine Competitions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that may have influenced their study, or that could be perceived as having done so.

detail.abstract: Wine competitions act as quality certifiers for an experience good like wine, yet their heterogeneous rating protocols generate substantial uncertainty. We distinguish two sources: competition risk, arising from inconsistent practices across events, and rating risk, stemming from variation in jury assignments and score aggregation within competitions. We develop a discrete-choice model of a wine market with multiple quality certifiers and show that standardizing rating protocols Blackwell improves the information available to consumers and producers, reducing both risks and potentially improving welfare. We then propose a standardized rating system that normalizes judges' scores and groups wines into statistically significant quality classes, reducing rating risk. Using data from a wine competition, we show that our rating system reduces score variance and stabilizes award allocations. Standardizing rating protocols across competitions strengthens the credibility of ratings and enhances their welfare properties.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了葡萄酒竞赛作为经验商品质量认证的作用，分析了竞赛评级协议异质性带来的不确定性，提出了标准化评级系统以减少风险并提高福利。
AI.research_question: 葡萄酒竞赛作为质量认证机制，其异质性评级协议如何影响市场不确定性？标准化评级协议是否能改善信息质量并提高福利？
AI.motivation: 葡萄酒作为经验商品，消费者难以直接评估质量，依赖竞赛评级作为质量信号。但不同竞赛采用异质性评级协议，产生了不确定性，削弱了评级的可信度和市场效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、质量认证理论、离散选择模型、Blackwell信息改进理论、统计显著性检验
AI.method: 1. 开发多质量认证者的葡萄酒市场离散选择模型；2. 提出标准化评级系统，包括评委分数归一化和统计显著性质量分类；3. 使用实际葡萄酒竞赛数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 标准化评级协议能Blackwell改进消费者和生产者的信息；2. 提出的标准化评级系统能减少分数方差和稳定奖项分配；3. 跨竞赛标准化评级协议能增强评级可信度和福利属性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了竞赛风险（跨竞赛不一致）和评级风险（竞赛内变异）；2. 将Blackwell信息改进理论应用于质量认证领域；3. 为标准化评级协议提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了可操作的标准化葡萄酒评级系统；2. 为竞赛组织者提供了减少不确定性的具体方法；3. 增强了葡萄酒市场的透明度和效率

title: Conspiracy and Plus Factor Analysis
affiliations: and USC Gould School of Law

detail.title: Conspiracy and Plus Factor Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: U Iowa Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Iowa College of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Proving anticompetitive conspiracy from circumstantial evidence is maddeningly opaque. Courts marshal sprawling lists of plus factors—evidence like perceived action against self‑interest or opportunity to collude—yet rarely explain why any combination of factors supports the inference of conspiracy. Even a cursory review of recent opinions re-veals that the significance of plus factors oscillates wildly. The same evidence can flip from being treated as “pro‑conspiracy” in one opinion to “anti‑conspiracy” in another.

Our thesis is that confusion arises from evidence not being anchored to concrete, competing factual narratives. This is correctable. We pro-pose a competing narratives approach in which cases are resolved by explicitly constructing both a conspiracy narrative and a legal‑action narrative and then evaluating the comparative fit of each of these narratives to the available evidence. This test is internally consistent, economically grounded, and frees courts from the need to struggle with unworkable lists of plus factors.

Beyond resolving the paradox of how to reason about limited evidence of concealed conspiracies, our framework offers a template for reexamining other multifactor tests. By grounding circumstantial inference in the same comparative epistemology that evidence scholars already recommend as a model of factfinding, we show how unwieldy tests can be transformed into practical, court‑friendly tools for restoring confidence and predictability to law.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"竞争性叙事"方法来替代当前反垄断案件中使用的"附加因素"分析框架，通过明确构建共谋叙事和合法行为叙事，然后评估每种叙事与证据的匹配程度，从而更一致、更经济地解决反垄断共谋证据推断问题。
AI.research_question: 如何更有效地从间接证据推断反垄断共谋的存在？如何解决当前"附加因素"分析框架在司法实践中的不一致性和模糊性问题？
AI.motivation: 当前反垄断案件中，法院使用"附加因素"（如违背自身利益的行为或共谋机会）来推断共谋存在，但这种方法存在严重问题：1）法院很少解释为什么特定因素组合支持共谋推断；2）相同证据在不同案件中被赋予截然相反的意义；3）整个分析框架缺乏一致性和可预测性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）竞争性叙事理论：通过构建相互竞争的叙事框架（共谋叙事 vs 合法行为叙事）来评估证据；2）比较认识论：借鉴证据法学者推荐的比较性事实认定模型；3）经济分析：将经济理性纳入叙事构建中。
AI.method: 提出"竞争性叙事方法"：1）明确构建两种相互竞争的叙事：共谋叙事（描述企业如何秘密协调）和合法行为叙事（描述企业如何独立行动）；2）系统评估每种叙事与所有可用证据的匹配程度；3）比较两种叙事的相对解释力。
AI.findings: 1）当前"附加因素"方法存在内在不一致性，导致司法混乱；2）竞争性叙事方法能够提供更一致、更经济合理的分析框架；3）该方法不仅解决了反垄断共谋证据推断问题，还为重新审视其他多因素测试提供了模板。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了替代传统"附加因素"分析的新理论框架；2）将比较认识论应用于反垄断证据分析；3）为证据推断提供了更系统化的方法论；4）展示了如何将复杂的多因素测试转化为实用的司法工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为法院提供了更清晰、更可操作的证据分析工具；2）增强了法律的可预测性和一致性；3）减少了司法裁决的任意性；4）为律师和法官提供了更有效的论证框架；5）该方法可扩展到其他法律领域的多因素测试。

title: Differential Acceleration: United States-European Productivity Divergence in Technology-Intensive Sectors

detail.title: Differential Acceleration: United States-European Productivity Divergence in Technology-Intensive Sectors
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether productivity gains in the United States occur at the expense of productivity growth in Europe. Using sectoral labor productivity data from the European Union Productivity Accounts (EU KLEMS) and the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) for 2003-2023, inverse relationships between United States and European productivity dynamics are tested across nine industrial sectors. At the aggregate level, productivity exhibits strong positive co-movement. However, an acceleration framework using second differences reveals substantial sectoral heterogeneity. In technology-intensive sectors-Information and Communication, Professional Services, and Finance-the acceleration response coefficient equals 0.34, compared with 1.06 in traditional sectors, yielding a statistically significant interaction of-0.72 (p < 0.001). When productivity growth accelerates in United States technology sectors, European productivity growth accelerates considerably less. This pattern intensified after 2016. The results suggest that the widening transatlantic productivity gap reflects differential capacity to capture productivity gains from technological change.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现美国与欧洲生产率增长之间存在复杂的动态关系：总体呈正相关，但在技术密集型行业存在显著差异，美国技术行业生产率加速增长时，欧洲同类行业增长明显滞后，这种差距在2016年后加剧。
AI.research_question: 美国的生产率增长是否以牺牲欧洲的生产率增长为代价？
AI.motivation: 研究跨大西洋生产率差距扩大的原因，特别是技术变革对美欧生产率动态的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率溢出效应理论、技术扩散理论、产业异质性理论
AI.method: 使用欧盟KLEMS和OECD 2003-2023年部门劳动生产率数据，采用二阶差分构建加速框架，分析9个工业部门中美国与欧洲生产率动态的逆相关关系。
AI.findings: 1. 总体层面生产率呈强正相关；2. 技术密集型部门（信息通信、专业服务、金融）的加速响应系数为0.34，传统部门为1.06，交互作用显著为-0.72；3. 美国技术部门生产率加速增长时，欧洲同类部门增长明显滞后；4. 该模式在2016年后加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了美欧生产率动态的部门异质性；2. 提出了"加速响应系数"作为衡量跨区域生产率溢出效应的新指标；3. 解释了技术变革对不同经济体生产率影响的差异化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧洲政策制定者缩小跨大西洋生产率差距提供实证依据；2. 指出技术密集型部门是欧洲需要重点关注的领域；3. 为产业政策制定提供部门差异化的参考。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Finance: Investigating the Impact of AI Nudges on Financial Behaviour
affiliations: and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Finance: Investigating the Impact of AI Nudges on Financial Behaviour
detail.abstract: The explosion of financial technology (fintech) has revolutionized the way we manage our personal finances, allowing individuals to save, budget, spend, and invest through digital channels. Despite this progress, financial decision making is often affected by cognitive biases such as loss aversion, present bias, status quo bias and framing effects. We are all aware of the lack of saving, impulsive spending and poor investment choices that result from these biases. Nudging, originating from the field of behavioural economics, offers a toolkit that we can use to reduce such distortions by altering choice architecture. The advent of AI-driven nudges is a game changer, as artificial intelligence affords the capability for dynamic personalization, realtime adaptation, and scalable interventions that transcend conventional static nudges. This study aims to explore two goals: (1) to explore the effects of AI-powered nudges on saving, budgeting, spending, and investment behaviors and (2) to analyze the impact of AI enabled nudges in mitigating cognitive biases in financial decision-making. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional survey of 372 fintech users, including validated scales to measure nudges, reduction in cognitive biases and financial behaviours. The results of the Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) showed that the model fit was good and the correlation among constructs was high. Results indicate that AI-driven nudges had a significant positive impact on saving (v = 0.41), budgeting (v = 0.35), spending (v = 0.28) and investment (v = 0.33) behaviours (p < 0.001). Nudges also helped to lower cognitive biases (b = 0.52, p < 0.001) which in turn had a positive effect on financial behaviours (b = 0.39, p < 0.001). Mediational analysis confirmed a partial mediation with nudges having a direct and indirect effect on behaviours through bias reduction. The results feed into theory by tying together behavioural economics, cognitive finance and AI-driven personalisation. Pragmatically, they provide developers in the fintech sector with playbooks for how to build ethical nudges, regulators with how to impose transparency and users with how to build sustainable financial health. The study underscores the duality of AI powered nudges as tools of empowerment and ethical stewardship within the digital financial ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI驱动的助推对个人财务行为的影响及其缓解认知偏误的作用。通过对372名金融科技用户的调查，发现AI助推显著改善储蓄、预算、支出和投资行为，并通过降低认知偏误间接影响财务决策。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的助推如何影响个人财务行为（储蓄、预算、支出、投资）？AI助推在缓解财务决策中的认知偏误方面发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 金融科技发展改变了个人财务管理方式，但财务决策常受损失厌恶、现状偏误等认知偏误影响，导致储蓄不足、冲动消费和投资决策不佳。AI驱动的助推能提供动态个性化、实时适应和可扩展的干预，超越传统静态助推。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学（助推理论）、认知金融学、AI驱动的个性化理论
AI.method: 对372名金融科技用户进行横断面调查，使用验证量表测量助推、认知偏误减少和财务行为，采用结构方程模型（SEM）分析数据
AI.findings: AI驱动的助推对储蓄（v=0.41）、预算（v=0.35）、支出（v=0.28）和投资（v=0.33）行为有显著正向影响（p<0.001）。助推能降低认知偏误（b=0.52），而偏误减少对财务行为有正向影响（b=0.39）。中介分析显示助推通过偏误减少对行为产生直接和间接影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学、认知金融学和AI驱动的个性化理论联系起来，深化了对AI助推机制的理解，为数字金融生态系统中的行为干预提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技开发者提供构建道德助推的实践指南，为监管机构提供透明度要求参考，为用户提供建立可持续财务健康的建议，强调AI助推在数字金融生态系统中的赋能和道德管理双重作用

title: When the Spare Tyre Goes Flat: Monetary Policy Transmission through Non-Banks
affiliations: and

detail.title: When the Spare Tyre Goes Flat: Monetary Policy Transmission through Non-Banks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Research Technical Papers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: We examine how monetary policy transmits through non-bank lenders (NBLs) using comprehensive loan-level data covering the universe of all loans in an economy. A one-percentage-point (pp) increase in the policy rate leads NBLs to raise lending rates by 0.17 pp more than banks and to contract credit sharply on the extensive margin. We show that this amplification is driven by a liability wedge: banks’ price-insensitive deposit franchise stabilizes their funding costs, whereas NBLs rely on short-term wholesale debt that reprices immediately. This funding fragility exposes NBLs to rapid balance-sheet deterioration, resulting in higher pass-through and a stronger contraction in lending.
