AI.method: 历史档案分析、案例研究（爱尔兰作为"实验室"）、比较法分析、话语分析
AI.findings: 国际能源法起源于殖民和后殖民历史，爱尔兰的独特地位揭示了能源治理中的历史断层和身份矛盾
AI.theory_contributions: 为国际能源法研究提供了后殖民视角，挑战了传统能源法起源叙事，揭示了历史缺失对现代能源治理的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供历史视角理解能源治理，帮助后殖民国家在能源转型中定位自身角色

title: The Long-Run Effects of Fiscal Rebalancing in a Heterogeneous-Agent Model
affiliations: Banque de France and Banque de France

detail.title: The Long-Run Effects of Fiscal Rebalancing in a Heterogeneous-Agent Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1028
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the long-run macroeconomic effects of a Fiscal Rebalancing reform that shifts taxation from payroll to consumption under a balanced-budget constraint. Using a heterogeneousagent model calibrated to French data, we compare pre-and post-reform steady states. The reform increases both aggregate labor and capital, with a stronger impact on capital in the heterogeneousagent model than in its representative-agent counterpart. It also heightens wealth inequality, as a disproportionate share of the increase in aggregate wealth accrues to wealthier households. A welfare analysis that accounts for the transition dynamics reveals a positive average welfare effect overall, although high-wealth and, separately, low-productivity households experience welfare losses. The results are robust across alternative calibrations and model specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在预算平衡约束下，将税收从工资税转向消费税的财政再平衡改革的长期宏观经济效应。使用法国数据校准的异质性主体模型显示，改革增加了总劳动力和资本，对资本的影响在异质性主体模型中比代表性主体模型更强，同时加剧了财富不平等。福利分析显示总体平均福利效应为正，但高财富和低生产率家庭遭受福利损失。
AI.research_question: 在预算平衡约束下，将税收从工资税转向消费税的财政再平衡改革对长期宏观经济、财富分配和福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解税收结构改革（从工资税转向消费税）的宏观经济和分配效应对于政策制定至关重要，特别是在法国等面临财政挑战的国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体模型（Heterogeneous-agent model），与代表性主体模型对比，包含财富不平等和生产率差异。
AI.method: 使用法国数据校准的异质性主体模型，比较改革前后的稳态，分析过渡动态，并进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 改革增加总劳动力和资本；2. 对资本的影响在异质性主体模型中更强；3. 加剧财富不平等（财富增加主要流向富裕家庭）；4. 总体平均福利效应为正，但高财富和低生产率家庭遭受福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 展示了异质性主体模型在分析税收改革分配效应方面的重要性；2. 揭示了税收结构变化对财富不平等的非对称影响；3. 强调了过渡动态在福利评估中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了税收改革对宏观经济和分配的全面评估；2. 识别了改革中的赢家和输家（高财富和低生产率家庭）；3. 为法国等国家的财政改革提供了实证依据。

title: Deposit Funding and the Credit Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Banque de France, Banque de France, Banque de France and European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Market Operations

detail.title: Deposit Funding and the Credit Channel of Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1029
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How does heterogeneity in deposit funding among banks influence the transmission of monetary policy to loan supply? To address this question, we exploit a bank-level panel dataset of more than 450 banks from 19 euro-area countries from 2007 to 2023. Our empirical findings reveal that banks with a higher reliance on deposit funding exhibit a more muted increase in lending rates following monetary policy tightening. These results are consistent with a mechanism in which deposit funding shapes bank loan supply.

AI.tldr: 研究银行间存款资金异质性如何影响货币政策向信贷供给的传导，基于欧元区450多家银行的面板数据分析发现，依赖存款融资的银行在货币政策收紧时贷款利率上升幅度较小
AI.research_question: 银行间存款资金异质性如何影响货币政策向信贷供给的传导？
AI.motivation: 理解银行融资结构差异对货币政策传导机制的影响，特别是存款融资依赖度不同的银行如何应对货币政策变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷渠道理论，存款融资异质性对货币政策传导的影响机制
AI.method: 使用2007-2023年19个欧元区国家450多家银行的银行层面面板数据集进行实证分析
AI.findings: 存款融资依赖度较高的银行在货币政策收紧时，贷款利率上升幅度较为温和
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对银行融资结构异质性在货币政策传导中作用的理解，揭示了存款融资如何塑造银行信贷供给机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定更精准的货币政策提供参考，帮助理解不同融资结构银行对政策变化的反应差异

title: Inferring Prices from Quantities
affiliations: Yale University, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Inferring Prices from Quantities

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-26
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Measuring aggregate inflation is subject to two opposing biases: unobserved quality and variety growth, and the use of incorrect weights when new varieties are misclassified. We show that it is possible to measure an aggregate price index free of these biases when we have a subset of products where these two errors average to zero. This procedure does not require us to distinguish new from existing goods, measure quality attributes directly, or classify new varieties into the appropriate category. We implement this approach using BEA data from 1959 to 2019, approximating the official PCE price index with a CES aggregate of BEA prices at the product level. Our estimate of the inflation rate exceeds the CES aggregate of BEA prices by 0.3 to 1.0 percentage points per year on average. The aggregate bias was close to zero prior to the BLS introducing hedonic adjustments, which suggests that only adjusting for quality bias can lead to an underestimation of overall inflation, particularly in quality-adjusted categories.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种测量总体价格指数的新方法，能够同时纠正未观测到的质量/品种增长和使用错误权重带来的偏差。通过使用BEA数据（1959-2019年），研究发现实际通胀率比传统CES聚合方法高出0.3-1.0个百分点。
AI.research_question: 如何测量一个不受质量偏差和权重偏差影响的总体价格指数？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀测量面临两个相反偏差：未观测到的质量和品种增长（导致高估通胀），以及新品种被错误分类时使用错误权重（导致低估通胀）。需要一种方法同时纠正这两种偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CES（常替代弹性）聚合框架，利用产品子集偏差平均为零的特性来构建无偏价格指数。
AI.method: 使用BEA（经济分析局）1959-2019年数据，将官方PCE价格指数近似为产品层面BEA价格的CES聚合，然后应用新方法进行估计。
AI.findings: 1. 新方法估计的通胀率比传统CES聚合方法平均高出0.3-1.0个百分点/年；2. 在BLS引入享乐调整之前，总体偏差接近零；3. 仅调整质量偏差可能导致对总体通胀的低估，特别是在质量调整类别中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种无需区分新旧商品、直接测量质量属性或正确分类新品种就能获得无偏总体价格指数的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的通胀测量工具，揭示了传统方法可能系统性地低估通胀，特别是在质量调整产品类别中。

title: Container or Content: from Flood Hazards on Firms' Physical Assets to Credit Risks
affiliations: Banque de France, Banque de France and Banque de France

detail.title: Container or Content: from Flood Hazards on Firms' Physical Assets to Credit Risks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1022
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the potential flood risks for the banking system in France through the nonfinancial corporation channel. We show the importance of going granular in assessing physical risk. First, the aggregate economic losses at the establishment level appear much higher than at the headquarter level. Second, the losses associated with transferable assets (machines and equipment) are greater than those related to real estate assets. The deterioration of these two types of assets affects the banking system through different channels. Property damages reduce the owner NFC's assets and increase the Loss Given Default (LGD) associated to the premise, while transferable damages can affect the cash position and leverage of the occupier NFC and thus the probability of default. Bank losses associated with transferable assets (the content) are more severe than those affecting properties (the container). Current insurance schemes in France reduce flood vulnerability not only directly for firms but also limit the amplification of vulnerability through the banking system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非金融企业渠道评估法国银行系统的潜在洪水风险，强调评估物理风险时需要细粒度分析。研究发现：1）企业分支机构层面的经济损失远高于总部层面；2）可转移资产（机器设备）的损失大于房地产资产；3）这两类资产通过不同渠道影响银行系统；4）法国现有保险方案能降低企业洪水脆弱性并限制银行系统的风险放大。
AI.research_question: 洪水风险如何通过非金融企业渠道影响法国银行系统？不同资产类型（房地产vs可转移资产）对银行风险的传导机制有何差异？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致极端天气事件增加，洪水等物理风险对金融系统的威胁日益凸显。现有研究多关注宏观层面，缺乏对风险传导机制和不同资产类型影响的细粒度分析，需要更精确的风险评估来支持金融稳定政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理风险传导理论、企业金融理论（资产结构、杠杆率、违约概率）、银行风险管理理论（LGD、PD），以及保险在风险缓释中的作用。
AI.method: 采用细粒度分析方法，对比企业总部层面和分支机构层面的经济损失，区分房地产资产和可转移资产（机器设备）的损失评估，分析不同资产类型对银行风险的传导渠道。
AI.findings: 1）分支机构层面的经济损失远高于总部层面；2）可转移资产的损失大于房地产资产；3）房地产损坏通过降低所有者资产价值和增加LGD影响银行，而可转移资产损坏通过影响占用者现金流和杠杆率增加违约概率；4）可转移资产相关的银行损失更严重；5）法国保险方案能有效降低企业脆弱性并限制银行系统风险放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了物理风险通过不同资产类型传导至金融系统的细粒度分析框架；2）区分了房地产和可转移资产对银行风险的不同影响机制；3）扩展了气候变化金融风险的研究维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为银行风险管理提供更精确的洪水风险评估方法；2）为监管机构制定气候相关金融风险政策提供依据；3）为企业资产配置和保险决策提供参考；4）验证了现有保险方案在降低系统性风险方面的有效性。

title: Retirement Under Policy Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Bergamo - Department of Economics, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), Bocconi University and

detail.title: Retirement Under Policy Uncertainty
detail.abstract: This paper examines how policy uncertainty influences retirement decisions. We develop a simple model in which individuals face a one-time choice between immediate retirement and continued employment until the statutory retirement age. In the absence of policy uncertainty, retirement decisions depend solely on the standard income–leisure trade-off. When future pension reforms are uncertain, however, individuals also take into account the perceived risk of increases in the retirement age or reductions in benefit generosity, and may choose to accept the offer in order to lock in current pension rules. Using administrative data from a large Italian bank that offered a one-time early-retirement scheme in 2017, we find that acceptance rates decline with the expected income loss but rise with the number of years to retirement. These patterns are consistent with workers using early retirement as an insurance against potential policy changes, underscoring the importance of incorporating behavioural responses to policy uncertainty in the design of pension systems. Our findings suggest that individuals with an average annual income of €35,000 are willing to pay an annual premium of €481 to insure against the probability that the pension system is reformed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究政策不确定性如何影响退休决策。研究发现，当未来养老金改革存在不确定性时，个体会将提前退休作为锁定当前养老金规则的保险机制，愿意支付年保费来规避政策风险。
AI.research_question: 政策不确定性如何影响个人的退休决策？个体是否会使用提前退休作为应对潜在养老金政策变化的保险机制？
AI.motivation: 养老金系统面临持续改革压力，但政策不确定性对个人退休决策的影响尚未得到充分研究。理解个体如何应对政策风险对养老金系统设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收入-闲暇权衡的标准退休决策模型，加入政策不确定性因素。个体面临一次性选择：立即退休或继续工作至法定退休年龄。政策不确定性表现为未来退休年龄提高或福利减少的风险。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析政策不确定性下的退休决策，使用意大利大型银行2017年一次性提前退休计划的行政数据进行实证分析。通过接受率与预期收入损失、距离退休年限的关系检验理论预测。
AI.findings: 接受率随预期收入损失增加而下降，但随距离退休年限增加而上升。这表明工人将提前退休作为应对潜在政策变化的保险。年收入35,000欧元的个体愿意支付481欧元年保费来规避养老金改革风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政策不确定性纳入退休决策理论框架，提出提前退休作为保险机制的概念，扩展了传统收入-闲暇权衡模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为养老金系统设计提供重要启示：需要考虑个体对政策不确定性的行为反应。政策制定者应意识到提前退休计划可能被用作规避政策风险的工具，影响改革效果。

title: Contesting an International Environmental Agreement
affiliations: ,  and University of Exeter Business School

detail.title: Contesting an International Environmental Agreement
detail.abstract: International environmental agreements (IEAs) often condition entry into force on ratification by a minimum number of countries, yet deep environmental commitments frequently face strong domestic political resistance. We study how IEA breadth, through minimum ratification thresholds (MRTs), and depth are jointly determined when domestic ratification incentives are endogenous. In our model, lobbying competition between pro- and anti-environmental interest groups shape domestic ratification outcomes, and lobbying incentives depend on expectations about ratification in other countries. MRTs affect domestic political incentives by altering the pivotality of a country’s ratification for entry into force and the extent to which global emissions externalities are internalized. As a result, deeper agreements optimally feature lower MRTs: governments relax breadth requirements to offset endogenous domestic political resistance to more ambitious environmental commitments. Our analysis provides a political-economy foundation for the breadth–depth trade-off and offers a novel perspective on free riding that operates through domestic political effort rather than participation or enforcement mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了国际环境协议（IEAs）中广度（通过最低批准门槛MRTs）和深度如何共同决定，当国内批准激励是内生时。研究发现，更深度的协议最优地需要更低的MRTs，政府通过放宽广度要求来抵消对更雄心勃勃环境承诺的内生国内政治阻力。
AI.research_question: 国际环境协议的广度（通过最低批准门槛）和深度如何在内生国内政治激励下共同决定？
AI.motivation: 国际环境协议经常面临深度环境承诺与国内政治阻力之间的矛盾，而现有研究未能充分解释广度（参与国家数量）和深度（承诺严格程度）之间的权衡关系，特别是在考虑国内政治过程内生性时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架，结合游说竞争模型，其中支持和反对环境的利益集团通过游说影响国内批准决策，游说激励取决于对其他国家批准情况的预期。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含内生游说竞争的政治经济学模型，分析最低批准门槛如何通过改变国家批准的关键性和全球排放外部性内部化程度来影响国内政治激励。
AI.findings: 更深度的协议最优地需要更低的MRTs；政府通过放宽广度要求来抵消对更雄心勃勃环境承诺的内生国内政治阻力。MRTs通过两个渠道影响国内政治激励：1）改变国家批准对协议生效的关键性；2）影响全球排放外部性的内部化程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为广度-深度权衡提供了政治经济学基础；提出了通过国内政治努力而非参与或执行机制运作的新型搭便车视角；将内生游说竞争纳入国际环境协议分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际环境协议设计者提供政策启示：在设计深度环境承诺时，应考虑降低批准门槛以克服国内政治阻力；帮助理解为什么雄心勃勃的环境协议往往需要更少的参与国家才能生效。

title: Putting the "Finance" Into "Public Finance": A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
affiliations: Princeton University, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) and University of Zurich

detail.title: Putting the "Finance" Into "Public Finance": A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
detail.abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors ("discount rates''). We show that a combination of realization-based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset-price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so-called lock-in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig-Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual-based capital gains taxes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在资产价格波动的环境中最优再分配税收政策，提出了一种结合实现型资本利得税和现金流税的最优税收组合，能够避免投资组合选择的扭曲效应。
AI.research_question: 在资产价格波动的环境中，如何设计最优的再分配税收政策？特别是，如何对资本利得和财富征税以实现最优分配，同时避免投资组合选择的扭曲？
AI.motivation: 传统的资本税理论忽略了资产价格波动，无法有效处理资本利得和财富税问题。现代金融观点认为资产价格波动不仅源于现金流变化，还受其他因素（如"贴现率"）影响，需要新的税收框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代金融理论，区分资产价格波动的不同来源（现金流变化vs.贴现率变化）；采用最优税收理论框架，考虑再分配目标；对比Haig-Simons综合所得税概念和财富税/应计制资本利得税提案。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含资产价格波动的经济环境模型，分析不同税收工具（实现型资本利得税、现金流税）对投资组合选择和分配结果的影响，推导最优税收组合。
AI.findings: 1. 实现型资本利得税和现金流税的组合能够实现最优分配，无论资产价格波动的来源是什么；2. 通过针对总净交易而非单个资产销售收益征税，资本利得税可以避免投资组合选择的扭曲（即锁定效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将资产价格波动纳入最优税收理论框架；2. 提出新的税收设计原则，区分现金流税和资本利得税的不同功能；3. 挑战传统Haig-Simons综合所得税概念和近期财富税提案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体的税收设计建议；2. 展示了如何设计资本利得税以避免锁定效应；3. 为资本利得和财富税改革提供了理论依据。

title: Climate Change, Climate Policy, and the Macroeconomy
affiliations: University of Oxford and Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Climate Change, Climate Policy, and the Macroeconomy
detail.abstract: A review is presented of the macroeconomics of climate change and policy. The review starts with a tractable workhorse model of the macroeconomics of climate and carbon pricing. It then discusses extensions to multiple countries. A discussion of the effects of macroeconomic and climate uncertainties and tipping points on asset pricing and the carbon price is given, including a discussion of stranded assets and the run on oil. Attention is then paid to green technical progress and to the effects of climate change and climate policy on different generations and the income distribution. The review concludes with a discussion of the effects of climate shocks and carbon pricing shocks on unemployment, inflation, and the role of networks in the transmission of these shocks, and borrowing constraints and sovereign risk in the face of climate shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了气候变化与政策的宏观经济学研究，从基础模型扩展到多国分析，探讨了不确定性、资产定价、技术进步、代际公平、收入分配以及气候冲击对失业、通胀和金融稳定的影响。
AI.research_question: 气候变化及其政策如何影响宏观经济？具体包括：碳定价的宏观经济效应、多国协调问题、不确定性与资产定价、技术进步、代际公平与收入分配、以及气候冲击对失业、通胀和金融稳定的影响。
AI.motivation: 气候变化已成为全球性挑战，需要从宏观经济角度理解其影响和政策应对。现有研究分散，需要系统性综述来整合气候变化宏观经济学的主要议题，为政策制定提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化宏观经济学的工作模型，扩展至多国模型；结合不确定性经济学、资产定价理论、技术进步理论、代际公平理论、收入分配理论以及宏观冲击传导理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理气候变化宏观经济学的理论模型和实证研究，从基础模型逐步扩展到复杂议题，构建完整的分析框架。
AI.findings: 1. 碳定价是应对气候变化的核心政策工具；2. 多国协调面临集体行动问题；3. 不确定性和临界点显著影响资产定价和碳价；4. 绿色技术进步对减排至关重要；5. 气候变化政策对代际公平和收入分配有重要影响；6. 气候冲击通过多种渠道影响失业、通胀和金融稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了气候变化宏观经济学的理论框架；2. 扩展了不确定性下的资产定价理论；3. 发展了气候冲击的宏观传导理论；4. 提出了代际公平和收入分配的分析框架；5. 构建了多国协调的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为碳定价政策设计提供理论指导；2. 帮助理解气候风险对金融稳定的影响；3. 为绿色技术投资决策提供参考；4. 指导气候变化政策的公平性设计；5. 为应对气候冲击的宏观经济政策提供依据。

title: Searching for Fish in Trees? Economic Development when Context Matters
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), University of British Columbia (UBC) and University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy

detail.title: Searching for Fish in Trees? Economic Development when Context Matters

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-27
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this chapter, we develop a framework for analyzing the determinants of economic development and their implications for policy. We distinguish between classical determinants-such as inputs into education and health, access to credit, and geography-and non-classical determinantsincluding cultural values, social norms, beliefs, identity, and social organization. We classify these determinants along two policy-relevant dimensions: whether they can be clearly ranked in terms of their contribution to development (vertical versus horizontal) and whether they can be directly altered through policy intervention (manipulable versus non-manipulable).We show that even for classical determinants, policy impacts are often hard to predict and are mediated by local social and cultural context. These issues are more pronounced for non-classical determinants, which are more complicated to change through policy intervention and more difficult to rank in welfare terms. In some cases, traits commonly viewed as obstacles to development may be welladapted to local conditions or even supportive of economic performance, a possibility we refer to as "reverse vertical." Building on Hirschman's (1967) distinction between trait-making and traittaking policymaking, we argue that interventions that attempt to directly transform non-classical determinants often rest on fragile assumptions about ranking and manipulability and risk generating unintended or adverse effects. By contrast, many of the most successful development episodes of the past several decades relied on policies that took existing social and cultural traits as given and designed institutions, technologies, and incentives that worked within those contexts rather than attempting to overturn them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析经济发展决定因素及其政策含义的框架，区分了古典和非古典决定因素，并基于可排序性和可操纵性两个维度进行分类，指出政策干预需考虑当地社会文化背景，直接改变非古典因素可能产生意外后果。
AI.research_question: 经济发展决定因素如何影响政策制定？特别是古典与非古典决定因素在可排序性和可操纵性方面的差异如何影响政策效果？
AI.motivation: 传统发展政策往往忽视社会文化等非古典因素的重要性，直接干预可能产生意外后果，需要更细致的分析框架来指导发展政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hirschman(1967)的"特质创造"与"特质接受"政策制定区分，构建了经济发展决定因素的双维度分类框架（垂直vs水平、可操纵vs不可操纵）。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论分析，通过分类和比较方法分析不同决定因素的政策含义。
AI.findings: 1) 即使古典决定因素的政策影响也受当地社会文化背景调节；2) 非古典因素更难通过政策改变且更难进行福利排序；3) 某些被视为发展障碍的特质可能适应当地条件甚至支持经济发展（"反向垂直"现象）；4) 直接改变非古典因素的政策基于脆弱的假设且风险高；5) 最成功的发展案例往往接受现有社会文化特质并设计相应制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济发展决定因素的双维度分析框架，区分了古典与非古典因素，引入了"反向垂直"概念，丰富了发展经济学的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更谨慎的发展干预框架，强调应更多采用"特质接受"而非"特质创造"的政策方法，避免对非古典因素的直接干预风险。

title: How Absolute and Relative Payoffs Shape Dishonesty
affiliations: Centre de Recherche en Économie et Management (CREM) and Ludwig Erhard ifo Center for Social Market Economy and Institutional Economics

detail.title: How Absolute and Relative Payoffs Shape Dishonesty
detail.abstract: We examine how absolute and relative gains within reward schemes influence dishonesty. In our online experiment, we vary two payoff dimensions in a cheating mind game: the payoff level and the absolute payoff difference between being successful or not. A higher payoff level has a negative impact on dishonesty, while a greater absolute payoff difference has a positive impact. Variations in these dimensions also affect the relative payoff difference: we observe the largest decrease in dishonesty when moving from the highest to the lowest relative gain. A potential implication is that reward schemes with a reasonable amount from low performance and a relatively small bonus from high performance are least prone to cheating, and this can be achieved in a cost-neutral way.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在线实验探讨了奖励方案中绝对收益和相对收益如何影响不诚实行为。研究发现，较高的收益水平会减少不诚实行为，而较大的绝对收益差异会增加不诚实行为。当相对收益从最高降至最低时，不诚实行为下降最明显。
AI.research_question: 奖励方案中的绝对收益和相对收益如何影响不诚实行为？
AI.motivation: 理解奖励方案设计如何影响道德决策和不诚实行为，为组织设计更有效的激励机制提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和道德决策理论，探讨绝对收益水平、绝对收益差异和相对收益差异对不诚实行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 在线实验方法，在作弊心理游戏中操纵两个收益维度：收益水平和成功与否的绝对收益差异，测量参与者的不诚实行为。
AI.findings: 1. 较高的收益水平对不诚实行为有负面影响（减少不诚实）；2. 较大的绝对收益差异对不诚实行为有正面影响（增加不诚实）；3. 从最高相对收益到最低相对收益的变化导致不诚实行为最大幅度下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了绝对收益水平和绝对收益差异对不诚实行为的不同影响；2. 揭示了相对收益变化对道德决策的非线性影响；3. 为奖励方案设计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议设计奖励方案时，低绩效提供合理报酬，高绩效提供相对较小的奖金，这样最不容易引发作弊；2. 这种方案可以在成本中性的情况下实现；3. 为组织设计道德风险较低的激励机制提供实践指导。

title: How Does AI Distribute the Pie? Large Language Models and the Ultimatum Game
affiliations: and University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: How Does AI Distribute the Pie? Large Language Models and the Ultimatum Game

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-29
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with autonomous decisionmaking, understanding their behavior in strategic settings is crucial. We investigate the choices of various LLMs in the Ultimatum Game, a setting where human behavior notably deviates from theoretical rationality. We conduct experiments varying the stake size and the nature of the opponent (Human vs. AI) across both Proposer and Responder roles. Three key results emerge. First, LLM behavior is heterogeneous but predictable when conditioning on stake size and player types. Second, while some models approximate the rational benchmark and others mimic human social preferences, a distinct "altruistic" mode emerges where LLMs propose hyper-fair distributions (greater than 50%). Third, LLM Proposers forgo a large share of total payoff, and an even larger share when the Responder is human. These findings highlight the need for careful testing before deploying AI agents in economic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型在最后通牒博弈中的战略决策行为，发现LLM行为具有异质性但可预测，部分模型接近理性基准，部分模仿人类社会偏好，还存在独特的"利他"模式，且LLM提议者会放弃大量收益，特别是当回应者为人类时。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在最后通牒博弈中的战略决策行为如何？其行为是否受赌注大小和对手性质（人类vs.AI）的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地承担自主决策任务，理解它们在战略环境中的行为变得至关重要。最后通牒博弈是人类行为明显偏离理论理性的经典场景，研究LLM在此类博弈中的表现有助于评估AI在经济社会环境中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最后通牒博弈理论、理性选择理论、行为经济学中的社会偏好理论、AI决策行为研究框架。
AI.method: 实验方法：在最后通牒博弈中测试多种LLM，操纵两个关键变量：赌注大小（stake size）和对手性质（人类vs.AI），涵盖提议者和回应者两种角色。
AI.findings: 1. LLM行为具有异质性但可预测，受赌注大小和玩家类型影响；2. 部分模型接近理性基准，部分模仿人类社会偏好，还存在独特的"利他"模式（提出超公平分配>50%）；3. LLM提议者放弃大量总收益，当回应者为人类时放弃更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究LLM在最后通牒博弈中的战略行为；2. 识别LLM独特的"利他"决策模式；3. 建立LLM战略行为与人类行为差异的理论框架；4. 为AI决策理论提供实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示在经济社会环境中部署AI代理前需要仔细测试；2. 为AI系统设计提供行为基准；3. 帮助理解AI在战略互动中的潜在风险；4. 为AI伦理和政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Lobbying for Data: The Political Economy of Open Banking Regulation
affiliations: University of Miami, School of Law

detail.title: Lobbying for Data: The Political Economy of Open Banking Regulation
detail.abstract: This Article examines the political economy of Open Banking regulation in the United States and its implications for consumer financial regulation in the digital age. Drawing on a novel dataset of federal lobbying disclosure reports and associated public comments on the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's Open Banking rulemaking, the Article examines which interest groups sought to influence Open Banking regulation through lobbying and with what apparent success. It finds that firms positioned as net data recipients in Open Banking—primarily, financial software companies and other nonbank fintechs—lobbied more intensively than actors positioned as net data providers—primarily, traditional incumbent banks. Data recipients also advanced policy positions more closely aligned with the core design choices of the final Open Banking Rule, such as cost-free data access. Many of the most active data-recipient lobbyists are themselves incumbents in infrastructural financial software markets. Consumers, meanwhile, were largely absent. Viewed alongside post-rulemaking developments, such as litigation by incumbent banks and the reopening of the rulemaking by the Bureau, the findings suggest not a wholesale displacement of incumbent bank power, but a reordering of influence toward fintech firms, including incumbents, whose business models and technical expertise position them as key interlocutors in the regulation of technologically complex financial markets. At the same time, the turn to litigation highlights the strategic substitution of institutional venues through which political influence is exercised. The Article concludes by exploring the implications of these shifts for how the consumer interest is defined and protected in digital financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国开放银行监管的政治经济学，分析不同利益集团通过游说影响监管政策的效果，发现数据接收方（金融科技公司）比数据提供方（传统银行）更积极地游说，且其政策立场更接近最终规则的核心设计。消费者利益在游说过程中基本缺席。
AI.research_question: 哪些利益集团试图通过游说影响美国开放银行监管？他们的游说效果如何？这对数字时代的消费者金融监管有何启示？
AI.motivation: 开放银行作为数字金融的重要监管框架，其制定过程涉及多方利益博弈。理解不同利益集团如何通过游说影响监管政策，对于分析数字时代金融监管的政治经济学具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论、利益集团理论、监管捕获理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 使用联邦游说披露报告和消费者金融保护局开放银行规则制定相关公开评论的新数据集，进行定量和定性分析
AI.findings: 1. 数据接收方（金融软件公司和非银行金融科技公司）比数据提供方（传统银行）游说更积极；2. 数据接收方的政策立场更接近最终规则的核心设计（如免费数据访问）；3. 许多活跃的数据接收方游说者本身就是金融软件市场的基础设施在位者；4. 消费者利益在游说过程中基本缺席；5. 规则制定后，传统银行转向诉讼，表明政治影响力的制度场所发生了战略替代
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了数字金融监管中利益集团影响力的重新排序；2. 提出了"技术复杂性"作为金融科技公司在监管中发挥关键作用的理论解释；3. 扩展了制度场所战略替代的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解开放银行监管的利益博弈提供实证依据；2. 揭示了消费者利益在监管过程中的代表性不足问题；3. 为金融科技公司和传统银行制定监管策略提供参考；4. 对如何更好地保护数字金融市场中的消费者利益提出政策建议

title: Income Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Executive Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Becker Friedman Institute for Economics, University of Chicago and University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy

detail.title: Income Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Executive Function

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-30
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Early childhood executive function (EF), the cognitive control processes underlying working memory, inhibitory control, and cognitive flexibility, is associated with later-life health and economic outcomes. Using data from Baby's First Years, a randomized trial of unconditional cash transfers to low-income mothers, we examine intergenerational EF transmission from mothers to their four-year-old children (n=769). Cash transfers do not significantly moderate this transmission in the full sample, but among low-EF mothers, where transmission is strongest, transfers attenuate the mother-child association to the point of statistical nonsignificance. Exploratory analysis suggests that increased cognitive stimulation and structured routines may mediate this process. Income support for low-income families may foster intergenerational mobility by weakening the transmission of low self-regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验发现，向低收入母亲提供无条件现金转移支付可以减弱低执行功能母亲向子女的代际传递效应，可能通过增加认知刺激和结构化日常活动实现。
AI.research_question: 无条件现金转移支付是否能够调节低收入家庭中母亲执行功能向4岁子女的代际传递？
AI.motivation: 幼儿执行功能与未来健康和经济成果相关，而低收入家庭中可能存在低自我调节能力的代际传递，阻碍社会流动性。现金转移支付可能通过缓解经济压力来打破这种传递。
AI.theoretical_framework: 执行功能代际传递理论、家庭压力模型、投资模型、自我调节发展理论
AI.method: 使用"宝宝的第一年"随机对照试验数据，对769对低收入母亲-4岁子女进行干预研究，实验组母亲每月获得无条件现金转移支付
AI.findings: 1. 现金转移支付在全样本中未显著调节代际传递；2. 在低执行功能母亲中，代际传递最强，现金转移支付使母子关联减弱至统计不显著水平；3. 探索性分析表明认知刺激增加和结构化日常活动可能中介这一过程
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次通过实验证据表明现金转移支付可以减弱低执行功能的代际传递；2. 揭示了经济干预影响儿童发展的具体机制路径；3. 为家庭压力模型提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为针对低收入家庭的政策设计提供了科学依据；2. 表明收入支持可能促进代际社会流动性；3. 强调了早期干预对打破贫困循环的重要性

title: Dynamic Complementarity
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago, Columbia University and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Dynamic Complementarity

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-31
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at one age promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and provide evidence on dynamic complementarity using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用中国农村家访项目数据，探讨动态互补性概念——即早期技能投资能促进后续投资的效果，并分析无干预情况下天赋、父母和环境因素对学习成长的影响。
AI.research_question: 动态互补性如何影响儿童技能发展？在无正式干预情况下，天赋、父母和环境因素如何促进学习成长？
AI.motivation: 理解早期投资对后续技能发展的促进作用，以及自然状态下影响儿童学习的关键因素，为儿童发展干预提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态互补性理论（早期技能积累促进后续投资效果），人力资本发展理论，儿童发展生态模型。
AI.method: 使用中国农村家访项目的独特数据，分析早期干预对后续技能发展的影响，并考察自然状态下天赋、父母和环境因素的作用。
AI.findings: 早期技能投资确实存在动态互补效应，能显著增强后续投资的效果；天赋、父母投入和环境因素在无干预情况下也对学习成长有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为动态互补性概念提供了实证证据，深化了对早期投资长期效应的理解，完善了儿童技能发展理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童早期干预项目设计提供依据，强调早期投资的重要性，帮助政策制定者优化资源分配以最大化儿童发展效果。

title: Inform and Persuade
affiliations: ,  and CMCC - Centro Euro-Mediterraneo sui Cambiamenti Climatici

detail.title: Inform and Persuade
detail.abstract: Advice plays a central role in health, personal finance, and energy-efficiency decisions. We study how a benevolent expert should design verifiable advice—such as whether to commission a diagnostic test of different accuracy—when the agent is behaviorally biased, either neglecting payoff-relevant considerations or updating beliefs in a systematic, non-Bayesian way. The expert both informs the agent about underlying risk and persuades the agent away from choices driven by bias. In a Bayesian persuasion framework with a binary safe-versus-risky decision and moderate (monotone) distortions, we show that the expert’s payoff need not be monotone in informativeness: intermediate information can reduce welfare relative to no information. Nonetheless, full disclosure remains optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究行为偏差代理人情境下，善意专家如何设计可验证的建议（如不同准确度的诊断测试）。专家既要告知代理人潜在风险，又要引导其避免由偏差驱动的决策。研究发现，专家的收益不一定随信息量增加而单调增长，中间程度的信息可能比无信息更差，但完全披露仍是最优策略。
AI.research_question: 当代理人存在行为偏差（忽视收益相关因素或非贝叶斯信念更新）时，善意专家应如何设计可验证的建议（如不同准确度的诊断测试）？
AI.motivation: 建议在健康、个人理财和能效决策中起核心作用。现实中代理人常存在行为偏差，而专家既要提供信息又要纠正偏差，这提出了如何设计有效建议的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯说服框架，包含二元安全vs风险决策和适度（单调）偏差。专家作为信息发送者，代理人为存在行为偏差的接收者。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，在贝叶斯说服框架下研究专家如何设计信息结构（如诊断测试的准确度），分析不同信息水平对代理人福利的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 专家的收益不一定随信息量增加而单调增长；2. 中间程度的信息可能比无信息更差，降低福利；3. 完全披露（full disclosure）仍是最优策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为偏差纳入贝叶斯说服框架，揭示了信息量与福利之间的非单调关系，挑战了"更多信息总是更好"的传统观点，同时证明了完全披露的最优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为健康、金融、能效等领域的专家提供建议设计指导：在代理人存在行为偏差时，应优先考虑完全披露信息，避免提供可能适得其反的中间程度信息。

title: Does Experience Matter? Past Fraud Experiences, Data Compromises, and Credit Market Behavior *
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City

detail.title: Does Experience Matter? Past Fraud Experiences, Data Compromises, and Credit Market Behavior *

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP26-01
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how past experiences with fraud affect individuals' likelihood of taking precautionary action in credit markets when faced with a new shock that raises their fraud risks. We focus on two kinds of past experiences with fraud: direct experience with fraud and a "near-miss" experience that increased fraud risk but did not directly lead to fraud. Using the 2017 Equifax data breach announcement, we show that individuals with either type of prior experience with fraud were more likely to take a precautionary action-freezing their credit report-than individuals with no prior experience with fraud. We also find that individuals with past direct experience with fraud were more likely to freeze their credit report than individuals who had a past near-miss experience. The individuals who froze their credit report had fewer total accounts and credit inquiries than those who did not, but this reduction in credit did not reduce their credit scores.

AI.tldr: 研究过去欺诈经历如何影响个人在面临新欺诈风险时的预防行为，发现直接欺诈经历和"擦肩而过"经历都会增加信用冻结的可能性，且直接经历比擦肩而过经历影响更大。
AI.research_question: 过去的欺诈经历（直接经历和"擦肩而过"经历）如何影响个人在面临新欺诈风险时采取预防措施（信用冻结）的可能性？
AI.motivation: 理解个人在面对欺诈风险时的行为反应，特别是过去经历如何塑造风险感知和预防决策，这对信用市场参与者和政策制定者有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和风险感知理论，探讨过去经历（特别是负面经历）如何影响个体的风险认知和预防行为决策。
AI.method: 利用2017年Equifax数据泄露公告作为自然实验，比较有不同欺诈经历（直接经历、擦肩而过经历、无经历）的个体在公告后采取信用冻结行为的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 有过去欺诈经历（直接或擦肩而过）的个体比无经历者更可能冻结信用报告；2. 直接经历者比擦肩而过经历者更可能冻结信用；3. 冻结信用者总账户和信用查询较少，但信用评分未受影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险感知理论，区分了不同类型欺诈经历对预防行为的影响差异，特别是直接经历与"擦肩而过"经历的不同效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和监管者提供洞察：过去欺诈经历显著影响消费者行为，预防措施可能减少信用活动但不损害信用评分，有助于制定更有效的欺诈预防策略。

title: "HR Practices in Mega Coal Mining Projects: A Case Study"
affiliations: Coal India Limited

detail.title: "HR Practices in Mega Coal Mining Projects: A Case Study"
detail.abstract: Coal India Limited a State Run Coal Miner no1 in the World striving for 1 BT production by 2029 with 2.25 Lakhs of manpower for meeting energy security of India. Around 233 mines are being operated under CIL Subsidiaries in 8 states of Coal India Limited.

AI.tldr: 印度国有煤炭企业Coal India Limited（CIL）作为全球最大的煤炭生产商，计划到2029年实现10亿吨产量目标，拥有22.5万员工，在8个邦运营233个矿山，旨在保障印度能源安全。
AI.research_question: Coal India Limited如何通过现有资源和运营结构实现2029年10亿吨产量目标，以保障印度能源安全？
AI.motivation: 印度作为快速发展的经济体，能源需求持续增长，煤炭在能源结构中仍占主导地位。CIL作为国有煤炭企业，承担着保障国家能源安全的重要使命，需要提高产量以满足国内需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础理论、国有企业治理理论、能源安全理论、大规模生产运营管理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过分析CIL的组织结构、生产能力、人力资源配置和运营管理实践，评估其实现产量目标的可行性。
AI.findings: CIL拥有庞大的组织规模（22.5万员工）和广泛的地理分布（8个邦233个矿山），具备实现10亿吨产量目标的资源基础。其国有属性使其在政策支持和资源获取方面具有优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国有企业能源安全战略实施的理论框架，提供了大型资源型企业产能扩张的案例分析，拓展了发展中国家能源企业治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CIL制定具体实施计划提供参考，为印度能源政策制定者提供决策依据，为其他发展中国家国有能源企业提供可借鉴的运营模式。

title: Les Misérables? Labour Market Outcomes Among Artists in Europe
affiliations: and

detail.title: Les Misérables? Labour Market Outcomes Among Artists in Europe
detail.abstract: This paper documents the labour market position of artists across Europe and examines how it co-varies with public cultural spending. Using EU-LFS micro-data for 2009-2023, we compare artists to non-artists using harmonised measures of wage rank, employment, and non-standard work. Using within-country variation and controlling for demographic factors, artists rank substantially lower in the wage distribution: in the pooled sample, the estimated penalty is about 0.46 wage deciles relative to other salaried workers and about 0.28 deciles relative to other professionals. These earnings gaps coexist with higher exposure to non-standard employment, including part-time work, temporary contracts, and multiple job holding, with patterns that persist over the life cycle and appear in most countries. We then link individual outcomes to a country-year panel of real per capita public expenditure on cultural services. Higher cultural spending is associated with modest improvements in aggregate employment and lower part-time incidence, but these associations do not systematically differ for artists or arts graduates. The only consistent differential correlation is an increase in multiple job holding among arts graduates in higher-spending environments. Thus, changes in aggregate cultural spending are not sufficient on their own to narrow wage or job-quality gaps for artists, motivating a rethinking of cultural policy instruments toward mechanisms that more directly address labour market risks faced by cultural workers.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2009-2023年欧盟劳动力调查数据，发现欧洲艺术家的工资排名显著低于非艺术家，且面临更多非标准就业形式。虽然更高的公共文化支出与就业改善相关，但并未显著缩小艺术家与非艺术家之间的工资差距。
AI.research_question: 欧洲艺术家的劳动力市场地位如何？公共文化支出如何影响艺术家的就业和工资状况？
AI.motivation: 了解艺术家在欧洲劳动力市场中的相对地位，以及公共文化政策是否有效改善艺术家的就业和收入状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分层理论、文化经济学、公共政策评估框架
AI.method: 使用2009-2023年欧盟劳动力调查（EU-LFS）微观数据，采用工资分位数排名、就业状况和非标准工作等标准化指标，通过国家内变异分析和人口因素控制，比较艺术家与非艺术家的差异，并将个体结果与人均公共文化支出面板数据关联分析。
AI.findings: 1. 艺术家在工资分布中排名显著较低：相对于其他受薪工作者约低0.46个十分位数，相对于其他专业人士约低0.28个十分位数；2. 艺术家面临更高的非标准就业风险，包括兼职工作、临时合同和多份工作，这种模式在生命周期中持续存在且出现在大多数国家；3. 更高的文化支出与总体就业改善和兼职发生率降低相关，但这些关联对艺术家或艺术专业毕业生并无系统性差异；4. 唯一一致的差异关联是：在支出较高的环境中，艺术专业毕业生的多份工作持有率增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了欧洲艺术家劳动力市场地位的实证证据；2. 揭示了公共文化支出对艺术家就业结果的有限影响；3. 挑战了单纯增加文化支出就能改善艺术家经济状况的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者需要重新思考文化政策工具，转向更直接解决文化工作者劳动力市场风险的机制；2. 建议开发针对艺术家特定需求的政策干预措施，而非仅仅依赖总体文化支出增加。

title: Social Media vs. Democracy: Evidence from the January 6th Insurrection
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Finance, Bocconi University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Social Media vs. Democracy: Evidence from the January 6th Insurrection
detail.abstract: Social media platforms are often credited with empowering grassroots movements in the pursuit of political freedoms. In this paper, we show how social media can also be exploited by political elites to undermine democratic institutions, using the January 6th, 2021 Capitol insurrection as a case study. We present three main findings. First, by exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in Twitter usage, we document that social media exposure predicts participation in the Capitol attack, donations for anti-democratic causes, beliefs in election fraud, and support for the January 6th rioters. Second, Donald Trump's tweets questioning the election's integrity were followed by spikes in "Stop the Steal" activity on Twitter and pro-Trump donations originating from high Twitter usage counties. Third, the insurrection and Trump's account deletion were followed by a decrease in the public expression of toxic political and "Stop the Steal" messaging by pro-Trump users on Twitter, but had little effect on privately held beliefs about the election outcome and pro-Trump donations.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过2021年1月6日国会大厦骚乱案例，发现社交媒体不仅可赋能草根运动，也能被政治精英利用破坏民主制度。研究显示社交媒体暴露度预测了参与国会攻击、反民主捐款、选举欺诈信念和对骚乱者的支持；特朗普推文引发"停止偷窃"活动激增；骚乱和特朗普账号删除减少了公开的毒性政治言论，但对私人信念和捐款影响有限。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体如何被政治精英利用来破坏民主制度？具体来说，社交媒体在2021年1月6日国会大厦骚乱中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注社交媒体赋能草根运动的积极作用，但忽视了其被政治精英利用破坏民主制度的潜在风险。2021年1月6日国会大厦骚乱为研究这一问题提供了重要案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体与政治动员理论、精英操纵理论、民主制度脆弱性理论、信息传播与信念形成理论
AI.method: 利用Twitter使用的准外生变异进行因果推断分析，结合事件研究法，分析社交媒体暴露度与政治行为、信念的关系，追踪特朗普推文与"停止偷窃"活动的关联
AI.findings: 1. 社交媒体暴露度预测了国会攻击参与、反民主捐款、选举欺诈信念和对骚乱者的支持；2. 特朗普质疑选举的推文引发"停止偷窃"活动激增和高Twitter使用县区的亲特朗普捐款；3. 骚乱和特朗普账号删除减少了公开的毒性政治言论，但对私人信念和捐款影响有限
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了社交媒体政治影响的理论框架，强调其破坏民主的"黑暗面"；2. 揭示了精英操纵社交媒体破坏民主的机制；3. 区分了社交媒体对公开表达与私人信念的不同影响
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者监管社交媒体政治操纵提供证据；2. 帮助平台设计更有效的干预措施；3. 提高公众对社交媒体政治风险的认识；4. 为民主制度保护提供实证依据

title: Should Public Company Pay be More Like Private Equity Pay?
affiliations: Shareholder Value Advisors, Inc.

detail.title: Should Public Company Pay be More Like Private Equity Pay?
detail.abstract: Public companies and private equity funds have common investors, shared compensation objectives-providing strong incentives to increase shareholder value, retaining key talent and limiting shareholder cost-and similar management responsibilities, but very different pay systems.  Public companies are focused on maintaining target dollar pay that is competitive in the labor market, having a high percentage of pay at risk and limiting the impact of market and industry factors on pay.  Private equity fund pay is focused on fixed sharing and front-loaded incentives.  It typically provides an annual fee of 2% of committed capital and a 20% carried interest, that is, a 20% share of the gains achieved by the fund.  This paper presents a common framework for measuring the success of the two approaches in achieving their three shared compensation objectives.  The common framework plots relative pay against relative performance to quantify four pay dimensions: pay leverage (a measure of incentive strength), pay alignment, the pay premium at expected performance and relative pay risk.  A key finding is that the pay mix and structure of private equity fund pay does a better job than average public company CEO pay of achieving the three basic objectives.  This is so because the positive effect of front-loading incentive pay-the carried interest-more than offsets the negative impacts of rewarding the gross, not relative, return and having a lower percent of pay at risk.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了上市公司与私募股权基金的薪酬体系，发现私募基金的薪酬结构（2%管理费+20%业绩提成）在实现三大薪酬目标方面优于上市公司CEO薪酬。
AI.research_question: 上市公司与私募股权基金在薪酬体系设计上如何实现共同的薪酬目标？哪种薪酬结构更有效地实现这些目标？
AI.motivation: 上市公司和私募基金有共同的投资者、相似的薪酬目标（激励股东价值增长、留住关键人才、控制股东成本）和管理责任，但薪酬体系差异巨大，需要系统比较其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、激励理论、薪酬设计理论、绩效薪酬关联理论
AI.method: 构建统一的薪酬评估框架，通过相对薪酬与相对绩效的关系图，量化四个薪酬维度：薪酬杠杆（激励强度）、薪酬对齐度、预期绩效下的薪酬溢价、相对薪酬风险
AI.findings: 私募股权基金的薪酬结构（2%管理费+20%业绩提成）在实现三大薪酬目标方面优于上市公司CEO薪酬。业绩提成的前置激励效应足以抵消其基于绝对回报而非相对回报、风险薪酬比例较低的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的薪酬评估框架，能够跨不同薪酬体系比较有效性；揭示了前置激励在薪酬设计中的重要性；为理解不同组织形式的薪酬结构提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上市公司薪酬委员会提供了改进薪酬设计的参考；为投资者评估不同投资工具的薪酬效率提供了工具；为私募基金薪酬结构的设计提供了理论支持。

title: Behind Financial Distress: Involuntary Delisting Risk and its Broader Asset Pricing Implications

detail.title: Behind Financial Distress: Involuntary Delisting Risk and its Broader Asset Pricing Implications
detail.abstract: This paper studies the asset pricing implications of involuntary delisting risk, the exogenous component of financial distress risk that remains largely unexplored in prior literature. Applying the data before and after an involuntary delisting policy regime shift in the Chinese stock market at the end of 2020, I document a systematic market-wide effect of the policy tightening, and correspondingly construct a stock-level risk measure using a dynamic logit model. Involuntary delisting risk overshadows firm fundamentals in determining the nature of distress risk. Prior to 2020, when policy strength was relatively weak, the risk of stocks' heterogeneous exposure to future policy regime shift delivered a significant premium, with the long-short portfolio constructed from firms with high versus low involuntary delisting propensity generating an average annualized return of 16.73%, that largely underpinned the size effect. After the strict policy took effect in 2020, as stocks started to face the risk of imminent involuntary delisting, this premium largely disappeared. Finally, I find that involuntary delisting risk significantly influences the short-term return reversal anomaly in the Chinese stock market, both from the time-series and cross-sectional perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非自愿退市风险的资产定价影响，这是财务困境风险中尚未充分研究的外生成分。利用2020年底中国股市非自愿退市政策收紧前后的数据，作者发现政策收紧具有系统性市场效应，并构建了股票层面的风险度量。研究发现，在政策较弱时期，非自愿退市风险产生显著溢价（年化16.73%），支撑了规模效应；政策收紧后该溢价消失。此外，非自愿退市风险显著影响中国股市的短期反转异象。
AI.research_question: 非自愿退市风险（财务困境风险的外生成分）对资产定价有何影响？特别是在中国股市政策收紧前后，这种风险如何影响股票收益和定价异象？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对财务困境风险的研究主要关注内生因素，而忽视了非自愿退市这一外生成分。中国股市2020年底的政策收紧为研究这一外生风险提供了自然实验机会，有助于理解政策变化如何影响市场定价机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论，特别是风险溢价理论和政策冲击对市场定价的影响框架。非自愿退市风险作为外生政策风险，可能影响投资者对股票的风险认知和定价。
AI.method: 采用2020年底中国股市非自愿退市政策收紧前后的数据，构建动态logit模型度量股票层面的非自愿退市风险。通过事件研究法分析政策冲击的市场效应，并构建多空组合检验风险溢价的存在性。
AI.findings: 1. 非自愿退市风险比企业基本面更能决定困境风险的性质；2. 2020年前政策较弱时，该风险产生显著溢价（年化16.73%），支撑了规模效应；3. 2020年政策收紧后，该溢价基本消失；4. 该风险显著影响中国股市的短期反转异象。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究非自愿退市风险这一财务困境风险的外生成分，拓展了资产定价理论中对政策风险的认知。揭示了政策制度转变如何改变风险定价机制，为理解中国股市的规模效应和反转异象提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别和管理非自愿退市风险的工具，帮助理解政策变化对投资组合的影响。为监管机构评估政策效果提供了实证依据，有助于优化退市制度设计。

title: Principle G: A Minimal Generative Formalism for the Evolution of Forms
affiliations: Independent Research Center "Meta-Algorithmics"

detail.title: Principle G: A Minimal Generative Formalism for the Evolution of Forms
detail.abstract: We introduce Principle G, a minimal generative formalism describing the evolution of forms independently of any specific domain of knowledge. The formalism is not reducible to logic, optimization, learning, or semantics. Instead, it defines a universal generative step acting on triples (∆, F, O), where ∆ is a space of distinctions, F a stabilization rule, and O an observation operator. We show that any meaningful domain implicitly realizes such a structure, that the generative step stabilizes at a non-trivial canonical form, and that global evolution proceeds along a critical trajectory rather than converging to a global fixed point. Denial of Principle G is shown to be self-defeating, establishing it as a condition of possibility for formal systems rather than a domain-specific hypothesis.

AI.tldr: Principle G 是一个描述形式演化的最小生成形式主义，它独立于任何特定知识领域，基于三元组（∆, F, O）的通用生成步骤，展示了形式演化沿着临界轨迹而非收敛到全局固定点。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一个独立于特定知识领域的通用形式演化原则？这个原则如何描述形式的生成和演化过程？
AI.motivation: 当前的形式系统研究往往依赖于特定领域（如逻辑、优化、学习或语义），缺乏一个跨领域的通用形式演化理论。需要建立一个最小生成形式主义来描述形式演化的基本原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: Principle G 形式主义，基于三元组（∆, F, O）的生成步骤，其中 ∆ 是区分空间，F 是稳定化规则，O 是观察算子。该理论强调形式演化沿着临界轨迹而非收敛到全局固定点。
AI.method: 形式化建模和理论证明方法。通过构建 Principle G 的形式主义框架，证明任何有意义的领域都隐含地实现了这种结构，并展示生成步骤稳定在非平凡规范形式。
AI.findings: 1. Principle G 是一个独立于特定领域的通用形式演化原则；2. 任何有意义的领域都隐含地实现了（∆, F, O）三元组结构；3. 生成步骤稳定在非平凡规范形式；4. 全局演化沿着临界轨迹进行而非收敛到全局固定点；5. 否定 Principle G 是自相矛盾的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个跨领域的通用形式演化理论框架，为形式系统的研究提供了新的理论基础。Principle G 不是领域特定的假设，而是形式系统的可能性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同领域的形式系统设计提供了统一的框架，有助于跨学科的形式演化研究。该理论可用于理解复杂系统的演化模式，为人工智能、复杂系统科学等领域提供新的分析工具。

title: Split between Accelerationists, Pivoters, and the Unwavering: CEE Energy Policy Responses to Russia’s 2022 Invasion
affiliations: ELTE - Institute of World Economics, ELTE Centre for Economic and Regional Studies,  and ELTE - Institute of World Economics, ELTE Centre for Economic and Regional Studies

detail.title: Split between Accelerationists, Pivoters, and the Unwavering: CEE Energy Policy Responses to Russia’s 2022 Invasion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare they have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Research, Development and Innovation Office of Hungary: John Szabo under Grant No. PD 146507, Csaba Weiner under Grant No. FK 146590, and András Deák under Grant No. FK 138317.

detail.abstract: The European Commission proposed to accelerate the EU's energy transition and phase out Russian gas in response to Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, prompting different reactions from Central and Eastern European Member States. This paper explores the responses from these countries by tracing the institution-altering effects of politicisation and securitisation. It proposes a taxonomy based on state actions: 'accelerationists' align with the Commission's ambition to hasten the green transition and reduce the role of Russian natural gas; 'pivoters' acknowledge the security threat and have eliminated Russian imports but seek to retain natural gas as a transition fuel by turning to alternative suppliers; and 'the unwavering' do not securitise the issue and thus resist change. The paper draws on the comparison of original National Energy and Climate Plans published in 2019 and their post-invasion updates to explore how the energy transition interacts with external shocks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了俄乌战争后欧盟能源转型政策在中东欧国家的不同反应，提出了基于国家行动的三种类型分类：加速派、转向派和坚定派，探讨了政治化和安全化对制度变革的影响。
AI.research_question: 俄乌战争后，中东欧成员国对欧盟加速能源转型和淘汰俄罗斯天然气的政策有何不同反应？这些反应如何受到政治化和安全化进程的影响？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯2022年全面入侵乌克兰后，欧盟委员会提出加速能源转型并淘汰俄罗斯天然气，但中东欧成员国对此反应不一。理解这些不同反应对于分析外部冲击如何影响能源转型进程至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治化理论和安全化理论，探讨制度变革效应；能源转型与外部冲击相互作用的理论框架。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比2019年原始国家能源与气候计划及其在入侵后的更新版本；基于国家行动的分类学方法（加速派、转向派、坚定派）。
AI.findings: 中东欧国家对欧盟能源转型政策呈现三种不同反应模式：1) 加速派：支持委员会加速绿色转型和减少俄罗斯天然气的目标；2) 转向派：承认安全威胁并已淘汰俄罗斯进口，但寻求保留天然气作为过渡燃料，转向替代供应商；3) 坚定派：未将问题安全化，因此抵制变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于国家行动的分类学框架，用于分析外部冲击下的能源政策反应；2) 深化了政治化和安全化理论在能源转型领域的应用；3) 揭示了外部冲击如何通过政治化和安全化进程影响制度变革。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了理解不同国家反应模式的框架；2) 有助于设计更具包容性和有效性的欧盟能源政策；3) 为应对未来能源安全危机提供参考；4) 帮助识别能源转型中的阻力和推动因素。

title: Regulating Healthcare Technologies in a Post-FDA World
affiliations: Washington University in Saint Louis - School of Law

detail.title: Regulating Healthcare Technologies in a Post-FDA World

publicationDetails.detailsText: Washington University in St. Louis Legal Studies Research Paper No. 26-02-01
publicationDetails.journalName: Washington University in St. Louis School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: For over sixty years, the Food & Drug Administration (FDA) has had the authority to review the safety and efficacy of new prescription drugs before they enter the United States market. Given recent legal and political events, this Article explores a no-longer hypothetical question: what would happen to the regulation of prescription drugs and other healthcare technologies in a world without the FDA? Who – if anyone – could determine whether or not healthcare technologies are safe and effective? This Article examines not only critical actions that FDA takes to ensure the safety and efficacy of new healthcare technologies, but also the reasons why FDA exists in the first place and the theories motivating those actions. Analyzing FDA’s functions and its animating goals allows for the identification of other institutional actors and legal tools whose work overlaps with FDA’s, however partially. This Article concludes that at present, no other institutional actor has the resources and institutional capabilities to fully replace FDA, and a post-FDA world would be harmful to patient safety, to innovation, and to the development of information about the safety and efficacy of new healthcare technologies. In a limited set of cases, however, there may be potential for different actors – most likely, other countries’ pharmaceutical regulators, but potentially insurance companies or independent non-profit entities – to limit the damage posed by ongoing events. Going forward, rebuilding – or replacement – will be needed to provide the infrastructure to perform the agency’s functions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如果FDA不存在，处方药和其他医疗技术将如何监管，分析FDA的核心功能及其替代可能性，结论是目前没有其他机构能完全替代FDA，FDA缺失将对患者安全、创新和信息发展造成危害。
AI.research_question: 如果没有FDA，处方药和其他医疗技术的监管将如何运作？哪些机构或法律工具可以替代FDA的功能？
AI.motivation: 基于近期法律和政治事件，FDA的监管权威面临挑战，需要探讨FDA缺失后的监管真空问题及其对医疗技术安全性和有效性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管理论、机构能力理论、替代性监管机制理论、患者安全与创新平衡理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析、机构功能分析、比较制度分析、替代方案评估
AI.findings: 1. 目前没有其他机构具备FDA的资源与能力来完全替代其功能；2. FDA缺失将损害患者安全、创新和信息发展；3. 在有限情况下，其他国家药品监管机构、保险公司或非营利实体可能部分缓解损害；4. 需要重建或替代机构来执行FDA的核心功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统分析了FDA的多重监管功能及其理论基础；2. 提出了评估监管机构替代性的分析框架；3. 识别了FDA功能的不可替代性特征；4. 为监管机构设计提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了FDA缺失情景下的风险评估；2. 指出了可能的临时替代方案；3. 强调了重建监管基础设施的必要性；4. 为医疗技术监管改革提供了实践参考。

title: Dissecting Trade and Business Cycle Co-movement
affiliations: Swarthmore College

detail.title: Dissecting Trade and Business Cycle Co-movement
detail.abstract: International business cycles are synchronized across developed economies. To understand this empirical phenomenon, I develop a multi-country real business cycle model with trade that embeds a comprehensive set of shocks. I match the data exactly with the endogenous outcomes of the model so that shocks fully account for the data, including GDP and bilateral trade shares. Quantifying the model to a panel of G7 countries and the rest of the world during 1992–2014, I find that shocks to bilateral trade linkages are largely responsible for the business cycle synchronization. In contrast, country-specific correlated shocks play relatively minor roles. Additionally, I find that trade-linkage shocks help to resolve the trade co-movement puzzle, by predicting a much stronger link between trade and cross-country GDP correlations.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建多国真实商业周期模型，发现双边贸易联系冲击是发达国家商业周期同步化的主要驱动因素，而非国家特定的相关冲击，同时解决了贸易协同难题。
AI.research_question: 发达国家间商业周期同步化的主要驱动因素是什么？双边贸易联系冲击与国家特定相关冲击各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 国际商业周期在发达经济体间高度同步，但传统模型难以完全解释这一现象，特别是贸易与跨国GDP相关性之间的弱联系（贸易协同难题）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多国真实商业周期模型，包含贸易和全面的冲击集，能够精确匹配GDP和双边贸易份额等数据。
AI.method: 构建多国RBC模型，量化校准至G7国家和世界其他地区（1992-2014年），通过内生结果精确匹配数据，识别不同冲击的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 双边贸易联系冲击是商业周期同步化的主要驱动因素；2. 国家特定的相关冲击作用相对较小；3. 贸易联系冲击有助于解决贸易协同难题，预测出贸易与跨国GDP相关性之间更强的联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出贸易联系冲击作为商业周期同步化的核心机制；2. 解决了传统模型中贸易与GDP相关性弱联系的难题；3. 为国际商业周期理论提供了新的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者识别商业周期同步化的主要来源提供依据；2. 有助于预测国际经济冲击的传导路径；3. 为国际贸易政策协调提供理论支持。

title: Monetary Policy Exposure of Banks and Loan Contracting
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and University of Missouri at Columbia

detail.title: Monetary Policy Exposure of Banks and Loan Contracting

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-008, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.008]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We provide evidence that banks use loan covenants to prepare for future monetary policy tightening, thereby facilitating the bank lending channel of monetary policy transmission. Specifically, banks with greater monetary policy exposure—those whose lending capacity contracts more as the federal funds rate increases—include stricter financial covenants in loan contracts, granting them flexibility to reduce existing loan commitments during monetary policy tightening when firms breach covenants. The resulting credit reductions to covenant violators by high-exposure banks account for over one-third of the total decline in credit during recent federal funds rate hikes.

AI.tldr: 银行利用贷款契约条款为未来货币政策紧缩做准备，这促进了货币政策传导的银行信贷渠道。货币政策风险敞口较大的银行在贷款合同中包含更严格的财务契约，使其在货币政策紧缩期间能够灵活减少对违约企业的信贷承诺。
AI.research_question: 银行如何利用贷款契约条款来应对未来货币政策紧缩，以及这种机制如何影响货币政策传导的银行信贷渠道？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策通过银行信贷渠道传导的具体机制，特别是银行如何通过合同设计来管理货币政策风险，从而影响信贷供给。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷渠道理论、契约理论、货币政策传导机制、银行风险管理
AI.method: 实证分析，通过分析银行货币政策风险敞口与贷款契约严格程度的关系，以及联邦基金利率上升期间信贷减少的情况
AI.findings: 货币政策风险敞口较大的银行在贷款合同中包含更严格的财务契约；这些银行对契约违约企业的信贷减少占近期联邦基金利率上升期间总信贷下降的三分之一以上
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行通过合同设计主动管理货币政策风险的新机制，丰富了银行信贷渠道理论，提供了货币政策传导微观机制的新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助银行管理者更好地设计贷款合同以管理货币政策风险，为监管机构理解货币政策传导提供新视角，为企业融资决策提供参考

title: Inequality in Comprehensive Wealth
affiliations: Federal Reserve Board of Governors,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Inequality in Comprehensive Wealth

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-007, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.007]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We create an annualized measure of comprehensive household wealth using the 1998–2022 waves of the Health and Retirement Study and examine heterogeneity in retirement resources across households, cohorts, and time. We augment traditional net worth with the actuarial present values of expected future payment streams from labor-market earnings, Social Security, defined-benefit pensions, annuities, life insurance, and government transfers. We then calculate an annualized measure of that lump sum by converting it into an actuarially fair joint life annuity that we call annualized comprehensive wealth (ACW). We find that the median ACW increases throughout retirement, indicating that the median household is spending down its total resources more slowly than its joint life expectancy is shortening. In addition, we document considerable heterogeneity in the levels and trajectories of ACW across cohorts, education groups, and race. Notably, we find that the pattern of rising ACW is largely driven by college-educated and white households. Other groups show relatively flat or declining trajectories of ACW after retirement. We further explore the heterogeneity of ACW with the help of recentered influence function regressions. We show that inequality in ACW is associated with higher household-specific rates of return, higher education, and greater concentrations of single-headed and Black and Hispanic households.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1998-2022年健康与退休研究数据，创建了年度化综合财富(ACW)指标，发现中位数家庭的ACW在退休期间持续增长，表明其资源消耗速度慢于预期寿命缩短速度。但存在显著的群体异质性：大学学历和白人家庭驱动了ACW上升趋势，而其他群体则呈现相对平稳或下降的轨迹。
AI.research_question: 不同家庭、世代和时间在退休资源方面存在怎样的异质性？年度化综合财富(ACW)在退休期间如何变化？哪些因素驱动了ACW的不平等？
AI.motivation: 传统净资产指标未能充分捕捉家庭退休资源的全貌，忽略了未来收入流（如社会保障、养老金等）的价值。需要更全面的财富衡量方法来理解退休资源分配的异质性和不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期消费理论、财富积累与消耗理论、退休资源分配不平等理论、人力资本与金融资本整合框架
AI.method: 使用1998-2022年健康与退休研究(HRS)数据；将传统净资产与未来收入流（劳动收入、社会保障、养老金、年金、寿险、政府转移支付）的现值相加，计算综合财富；通过精算公平联合生存年金将综合财富转换为年度化综合财富(ACW)；使用再中心化影响函数回归分析ACW异质性
AI.findings: 1. 中位数ACW在退休期间持续增长，表明家庭资源消耗速度慢于预期寿命缩短速度；2. ACW水平和轨迹存在显著的世代、教育程度和种族异质性；3. ACW上升趋势主要由大学学历和白人家庭驱动；4. ACW不平等与家庭特定收益率、教育程度、单亲家庭比例以及黑人和西班牙裔家庭集中度相关
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了年度化综合财富(ACW)这一新的退休资源衡量框架；2. 扩展了传统财富概念，整合了人力资本和金融资本；3. 揭示了退休资源消耗的动态模式与生命周期理论的偏差；4. 为理解退休资源不平等提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更全面的退休资源评估工具；2. 揭示了不同群体退休准备的不平等，有助于针对性政策设计；3. 为金融机构开发退休产品和服务提供参考；4. 帮助个人更好地规划退休财务

title: Lost in Monetary Translation: Monetary Singleness and Relative Price Distortions
affiliations: Waseda University - School of Commerce and Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Lost in Monetary Translation: Monetary Singleness and Relative Price Distortions
detail.abstract: This paper studies how currency conversion can disrupt relative prices by impairing the unit-of-account function of money. We examine Okinawa's 1972 conversion from the U.S. dollar to the Japanese yen, following the collapse of a previously shared unit-of-account triggered by the Nixon shock. Using wholesale price data for perishable goods, we show that relative prices exhibited sharp changes despite flexible prices. By contrast, Okinawa's 1958 currency conversion used a single, clearly announced rate and left relative prices stable. The comparison highlights the importance of institutional clarity for a shared unit of account and stable relative prices.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过冲绳1972年从美元到日元的货币转换案例，展示了当货币单位功能受损时，相对价格会发生剧烈变化，而1958年使用单一明确汇率的转换则保持了相对价格稳定。
AI.research_question: 货币转换如何通过损害货币的记账单位功能来扰乱相对价格？
AI.motivation: 研究货币作为记账单位功能的重要性，特别是在货币转换过程中，当这一功能受损时对相对价格稳定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币的记账单位功能理论，相对价格稳定性理论，以及制度清晰度对经济协调的重要性。
AI.method: 使用冲绳1972年从美元到日元转换的自然实验，对比1958年货币转换案例，分析易腐商品的批发价格数据。
AI.findings: 1972年货币转换导致相对价格出现急剧变化，尽管价格本身是灵活的；而1958年使用单一明确汇率的转换保持了相对价格稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了共享记账单位和制度清晰度对维持相对价格稳定的重要性，为货币功能理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于货币转换过程中保持制度清晰度的重要性，特别是在汇率转换机制设计方面的实践指导。

title: A Decomposition of Balance Sheet Reduction
affiliations: , Independent and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: A Decomposition of Balance Sheet Reduction

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Since the Global Financial Crisis, central banks have used the size and composition of their balance sheets to influence financial conditions and economic activity when policy rates are constrained by the effective lower bound. A common measure of the size of the Federal Reserve's balance sheet is the System Open Market Account (SOMA) securities holdings expressed as a share of nominal gross domestic product (NGDP).

title: The No-Poverty Sustainable Development Goal in OIC: Measuring Vulnerability to Poverty and Poverty Transition Using Cross-Sectional Welfare Survey
affiliations: Istanbul University

detail.title: The No-Poverty Sustainable Development Goal in OIC: Measuring Vulnerability to Poverty and Poverty Transition Using Cross-Sectional Welfare Survey

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: Achieving the "No-Poverty" goal in 2030 is the first Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) set by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015. Recent progress reports show that more action is needed in the developing regions of the world to achieve the full implementation of the SDGs. Accelerating the pace of progress is mandatory, particularly in member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC). The availability of reliable and accessible timely data is mandatory for tracing the pace of progress in the implementation of the SDGs. Challenges to statistical systems in developing countries represent hindrances to the effective tracking of SDGs implementation progress. Evaluating development prospects and poverty eradication efforts in OIC countries compels observing the dynamics of changes in the main indicators of well-being. This study aims to provide a dynamic measure of well-being that fits in with the current transitional context of the Islamic world. It is also intended to incorporate innovative empirical approaches that accommodate the lack of panel data required for making transitional analyses. It employs the dynamic nature of vulnerability measures to evaluate the changes in levels of well-being in a sample of OIC countries. Vulnerability to poverty is measured in terms of the variation in the household's expected expenditure relative to an expenditure threshold measured at the poverty line.

AI.tldr: 该研究为伊斯兰合作组织成员国开发了一个动态福祉衡量框架，利用脆弱性测量评估福祉变化，以追踪可持续发展目标中"无贫困"目标的进展。

AI.motivation: 联合国2030年可持续发展目标中"无贫困"目标在发展中国家进展缓慢，特别是在伊斯兰合作组织成员国。缺乏可靠及时的数据阻碍了对进展的有效追踪，需要创新的方法来评估福祉变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于脆弱性理论，将贫困脆弱性定义为家庭预期支出相对于贫困线支出阈值的变化。该框架适应缺乏面板数据的情况，提供动态的福祉变化评估。
AI.method: 采用动态脆弱性测量方法，评估伊斯兰合作组织成员国样本中福祉水平的变化。通过测量家庭预期支出相对于贫困线支出阈值的变化来量化贫困脆弱性。
AI.findings: 研究提出了一个适应伊斯兰世界当前转型背景的动态福祉衡量框架，能够克服面板数据缺乏的限制，为追踪可持续发展目标进展提供实证工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了适应发展中国家统计系统限制的动态福祉测量理论框架，将脆弱性概念应用于可持续发展目标进展评估，为缺乏面板数据情况下的过渡分析提供方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰合作组织成员国提供了实用的动态福祉监测工具，帮助政策制定者追踪可持续发展目标进展，特别是在"无贫困"目标方面，支持更有效的减贫政策制定和实施。

title: A State Theory of Price Levels
affiliations: Banque de France, HEC Paris - Economics & Decision Sciences and Sciences Po

detail.title: A State Theory of Price Levels

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. No. 1023
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a general and parsimonious framework to study whether a state can control the value of its currency by declaring it to be the legal tender for claims between itself and the private sector, and by trading it for desirable commodities according to a mechanism of its choice. In an economy in which all agents are price-setters, we identify when such policies elicit a single equilibrium price level. For policies that fail to do so, for example because different official and unofficial prices may coexist in equilibrium, we still offer tight restrictions on the set of predictable price levels. We discuss how our framework sheds light on common mechanisms driving various historical and recent forms of monetary or/and fiscal instability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用简约的框架，研究国家能否通过宣布其货币为法定货币并在与私营部门的交易中按自选机制兑换商品来控制货币价值。在价格设定者经济中，识别政策何时能引发单一均衡价格水平，并对失败政策提供严格的价格水平限制。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用简约的分析框架，统一研究法定货币政策和商品交易机制对货币价值控制的影响，深化了对价格水平决定机制的理论理解。

title: More Hours, More Work: Head Start Expansions Boost Maternal Employment
affiliations: Department of Economics, University of Notre Dame, University of California, Merced and University of Delaware

detail.title: More Hours, More Work: Head Start Expansions Boost Maternal Employment
detail.abstract:
Women’s employment remains highly sensitive to childcare constraints, making childcare availability a critical lever for supporting mothers’ labor force attachment. We study the effects of expanded full-day programming in Head Start, using the 2016 federal funding initiative that targeted grantees with low full-day enrollment. Linking administrative program data, geo-coded center locations, and household data on employment, we estimate a difference-in-differences design by comparing mothers of young children in treated and untreated areas. The policy increased full-day enrollment by 19 percent and raised single mothers’ employment (1.9%), hours (2.5%), and earnings (6.5%). Results show that extending program duration meaningfully improves maternal labor market outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过联邦资金扩大Head Start项目的全日制服务，能显著提高单亲母亲的就业率、工作时间和收入，证明延长托儿服务时长对支持母亲劳动力参与有实质性影响。
AI.research_question: 扩大Head Start项目的全日制服务对母亲（特别是单亲母亲）的劳动力市场参与有何影响？
AI.motivation: 女性就业对托儿限制高度敏感，托儿服务的可获得性是支持母亲劳动力参与的关键杠杆。然而，关于延长托儿项目时长如何影响母亲就业的研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力供给理论，特别是托儿约束对女性劳动力参与的影响；同时运用公共政策评估框架，分析托儿服务扩展对家庭经济行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法，将2016年联邦资金针对全日制入学率低的Head Start机构的政策作为自然实验，比较受政策影响和未受影响地区的母亲就业情况。结合行政项目数据、地理编码的中心位置和家庭就业数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 政策使全日制入学率提高19%，单亲母亲的就业率提高1.9%，工作时间增加2.5%，收入增长6.5%。结果表明延长项目时长能显著改善母亲的劳动力市场结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为托儿服务时长与母亲劳动力参与的因果关系提供了实证证据；扩展了关于公共托儿政策对家庭经济行为影响的理论理解；验证了劳动力供给理论中托儿约束的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体证据，支持扩大全日制托儿服务的投资；展示了如何通过有针对性的资金分配改善低收入家庭的经济状况；为Head Start项目的优化提供了实证依据。

title: Gender Norms and Development
affiliations: Duke University, Fuqua School of Business-Economics Group, Dartmouth College and Stanford University

detail.title: Gender Norms and Development
detail.abstract:
Gender norms—shared expectations about appropriate behavior by gender—shape the outcomes of men and women across societies, and are correlated with GDP per capita. This chapter surveys the literature on gender norms and economic development, focusing on the pervasive and traditional ‘male breadwinner norm’ that assigns men to market work and women to domestic responsibilities. We review empirical approaches to measuring norms, including direct survey questions on attitudes, second-order beliefs about others' views, and behavioral proxies. Establishing causal effects of norms on behavior poses significant challenges, and we review a range of approaches to identify this link. We then present the leading hypotheses about the origins of gender norms in different forms of biological comparative advantage. We discuss societal forces sustaining norms, including self-reinforcing feedback between behavior and beliefs, other institutions, and backlash against norm violations. We highlight the bidirectional relationship between norms and development: economic growth can liberalize norms through structural transformation, legal reforms, and diffusion mechanisms, whereas talent misallocation stemming from gender norms may constrain growth. We conclude by discussing gender norms beyond the breadwinner domain, including norms around kinship, property, leadership, violence, mobility, sexuality, appearance, and behavior, and identify promising directions for future research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了性别规范与经济发展的关系，重点探讨了"男性养家糊口"规范如何影响男女行为，分析了测量方法、因果关系识别、规范起源、维持机制，以及规范与发展之间的双向关系。
AI.research_question: 性别规范如何影响经济发展？经济发展又如何影响性别规范的变化？性别规范的起源、维持机制是什么？如何测量性别规范及其对行为的影响？
AI.motivation: 性别规范深刻影响男女在社会中的行为和结果，并与人均GDP相关。理解性别规范与经济发展的双向关系对于促进性别平等和经济增长至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 男性养家糊口规范理论；2. 生物比较优势理论（解释规范起源）；3. 社会规范维持理论（自我强化反馈、制度互补、违规抵制）；4. 经济发展与规范变迁的双向关系理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理现有实证研究。包括：1. 规范测量方法（直接态度调查、二阶信念、行为代理变量）；2. 因果关系识别方法（实验、自然实验、工具变量等）；3. 跨文化比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 性别规范与经济发展存在双向因果关系；2. 经济增长可通过结构转型、法律改革和扩散机制使规范自由化；3. 性别规范导致的人才错配可能制约经济增长；4. 规范通过行为-信念反馈循环、制度互补和违规抵制得以维持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统整合性别规范与经济发展的理论框架；2. 提出规范起源的生物比较优势假说；3. 阐明规范维持的社会机制；4. 构建规范与发展双向关系的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供促进性别平等的干预策略；2. 识别影响经济发展的关键性别规范领域；3. 提供测量和评估性别规范的有效方法；4. 指出未来研究方向，包括亲属关系、财产、领导力、暴力等领域的性别规范研究。

title: Using Life Satisfaction Data to Measure Parents' Child Gender Preferences
affiliations: , Princeton University and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Using Life Satisfaction Data to Measure Parents' Child Gender Preferences
detail.abstract:
Can questions about life satisfaction be used to measure parental preferences for daughters versus sons? Daughter preference has rarely been documented in the literature, even in matrilineal settings. One possible reason is that the commonly used measures of parental gender preference, such as fertility-stopping rules and sex ratio at birth, are ill-suited to high-fertility settings. We instead assess maternal preferences in Malawi by examining the life satisfaction of women who currently have one child, comparing those with a daughter to those with a son. We find that in matrilineal (but not patrilineal) households, having a daughter increases mothers' life satisfaction, relative to having a son.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在马拉维的母系家庭中，拥有女儿（相比儿子）会提高母亲的生活满意度，但在父系家庭中则没有这种效应。这表明生活满意度问题可以作为测量父母性别偏好的有效工具。
AI.research_question: 生活满意度问题能否用来测量父母对女儿与儿子的偏好？特别是在母系社会中是否存在女儿偏好？
AI.motivation: 现有文献很少记录女儿偏好，即使在母系社会中也是如此。这可能是因为常用的父母性别偏好测量方法（如生育停止规则和出生性别比）不适用于高生育率环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别偏好理论、母系社会与父系社会差异、生活满意度作为偏好测量工具的理论基础。
AI.method: 比较马拉维目前只有一个孩子的女性的生活满意度，分析拥有女儿与拥有儿子的母亲之间的差异，并区分母系和父系家庭背景。
AI.findings: 在母系家庭中，拥有女儿（相比儿子）显著提高母亲的生活满意度；但在父系家庭中，这种效应不存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了女儿偏好的实证证据；2）验证了生活满意度作为测量父母性别偏好的有效工具；3）揭示了母系社会结构对性别偏好的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的性别偏好测量方法，有助于理解不同社会结构下的性别偏好模式，对促进性别平等有实践意义。

detail.abstract:
This paper tests whether the arrival of mass media triggers a decline in fertility, a central prediction of modernization theory. Using a field experiment, we vary exposure to mass media and its content in a quarter of Burkina Faso. We provide radios to 1,600 women without previous access to mass media. Half live in status quo areas and half in areas where the local radio station was randomly selected to air a science-based family planning campaign. Contrary to modernization theory and previous literature, gaining access to status quo mass media decreases contraception use by 14 percent and reinforces traditional gender norms. In contrast, receiving a radio in campaign areas boosts contraception use by 16 percent. The campaign also led to a 9 percent reduction in births and a 0.3 standard deviation increase in reported welfare. Reduced belief in misinformation rather than shifts in attitudes and preferences drives the result.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在布基纳法索进行的田野实验发现，接触大众媒体并不总是降低生育率。传统媒体接触反而减少避孕使用14%，强化传统性别规范；而结合计划生育宣传的媒体接触则增加避孕使用16%，减少生育9%，提高福利0.3个标准差。
AI.research_question: 大众媒体的到来是否会触发生育率下降？这是现代化理论的核心预测。
AI.motivation: 现代化理论预测大众媒体传播会降低生育率，但这一预测缺乏严格的实证检验。研究旨在通过随机实验验证媒体接触对生育行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代化理论（预测媒体接触会降低生育率），以及媒体内容对行为改变的重要性。
AI.method: 在布基纳法索进行的田野实验，向1600名之前无法接触大众媒体的女性提供收音机。一半在现状区域，一半在随机选择播放计划生育宣传的区域。
AI.findings: 1. 接触现状媒体减少避孕使用14%，强化传统性别规范；2. 接触计划生育宣传媒体增加避孕使用16%；3. 宣传活动减少生育9%，提高福利0.3个标准差；4. 效果主要来自减少错误信息而非态度偏好改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战现代化理论关于媒体接触必然降低生育率的预测，强调媒体内容的重要性而非单纯接触。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展政策提供重要启示：单纯提供媒体接触可能适得其反，需要结合科学宣传内容才能促进计划生育和福利改善。

title: GPT as a Measurement Tool
affiliations: OpenAI,  and Harvard University - Department of Economics

detail.title: GPT as a Measurement Tool
detail.abstract:
We present the GABRIEL software package, which uses GPT to quantify attributes in qualitative data (e.g. how “pro innovation” a speech is). GPT is evaluated on classification and attribute rating performance against 1000+ human annotated tasks across a range of topics and data. We find that GPT as a measurement tool is accurate across domains and generally indistinguishable from human evaluators. Our evidence indicates that labeling results do not depend on the exact prompting strategy used, and that GPT is not relying on training data contamination or inferring attributes from other attributes. We showcase the possibilities of GABRIEL by quantifying novel and granular trends in Congressional remarks, social media toxicity, and county-level school curricula. We then apply GABRIEL to study the history of tech adoption, using it to assemble a novel dataset of 37,000 technologies. Our analysis documents a tenfold decline of time lags from invention to adoption over the industrial age, from ~50 years to ~5 years today. We quantify the increasing dominance of companies and the U.S. in innovation, alongside characteristics that explain whether a technology will be adopted slowly or speedily.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: GABRIEL软件包使用GPT量化定性数据属性，评估显示GPT作为测量工具准确度接近人类，可应用于国会演讲、社交媒体毒性、学校课程等分析，并构建了37,000项技术数据集，发现从发明到采用的时间从50年缩短到5年。
AI.research_question: GPT能否作为有效的测量工具来量化定性数据属性？GPT在分类和属性评分方面的表现如何？GPT能否应用于构建新颖数据集并分析技术创新采纳的历史趋势？
AI.motivation: 传统定性数据分析依赖人工标注，成本高、耗时长且存在主观性。需要开发自动化工具来量化文本属性，以支持大规模社会科学研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理和大语言模型理论，特别是GPT在文本理解和生成方面的能力。涉及测量理论、技术创新采纳理论和社会科学量化研究方法。
AI.method: 开发GABRIEL软件包，使用GPT进行属性量化。在1000+人工标注任务上评估GPT的分类和属性评分性能。应用GABRIEL分析国会演讲、社交媒体毒性、学校课程，并构建37,000项技术数据集分析技术采纳历史趋势。
AI.findings: 1) GPT作为测量工具在不同领域都准确，与人类评估者难以区分；2) 标注结果不依赖具体的提示策略；3) GPT不依赖训练数据污染或从其他属性推断；4) 技术从发明到采纳的时间从工业时代的约50年缩短到今天的约5年；5) 公司和美国在创新中的主导地位增强；6) 识别了影响技术采纳速度的特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证GPT作为社会科学量化测量工具的有效性；2) 证明大语言模型在属性量化任务上的鲁棒性；3) 为技术创新采纳理论提供新的实证证据；4) 拓展了自然语言处理在社会科学研究中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供开源的GABRIEL软件包；2) 展示在国会演讲、社交媒体毒性、学校课程等实际应用；3) 构建包含37,000项技术的新数据集；4) 为政策制定者提供技术创新采纳的历史趋势分析；5) 降低社会科学研究的定性数据分析成本。

title: A History of Economic Thought at the Frankfurt Institute: Beyond the Critical Theory of the Frankfurt School, 1923-1945

detail.title: A History of Economic Thought at the Frankfurt Institute: Beyond the Critical Theory of the Frankfurt School, 1923-1945
detail.abstract:
The Frankfurt Institute continues to command the interest of a wide range of scholars working in history, philosophy, sociology, and political science. Yet, the prevailing narrative about the Institute overlooks a crucial component of its history: the economic theories developed by its lesser-known members. This book presents the first comprehensive study of these overlooked contributions, providing a transformative account that repositions the Institute as a site of original and influential economic thought. Most research on the Frankfurt Institute remains narrowly focused on a select few members whose work developed methods of critiquing capitalism that were more philosophically oriented than empirically grounded in economic reality.

Drawing on new archival research, this book brings to the forefront the sidelined and long-neglected economic ideas of Franz L. Neumann, Otto Kirchheimer, Friedrich Pollock, Carl Grünberg, Henryk Grossmann, Arkadij Gurland, Gerhard Meyer, Kurt Mandelbaum, and Karl A. Wittfogel. Viewing the work of the Institute through these figures highlights the fact that material, historical, and empirical approaches to economic theory were central to its work. Being primarily a work of intellectual history, the book contextualises the Institute’s economic theories within the historical settings of the Weimar Republic and Nazi Germany.

The book emphasises the role of these underappreciated economists in shaping economic discourse around the structural characteristics of capitalist economies during the twentieth century and offers a renewed perspective on the intricate interplay between economics, politics, history, and epistemology, which lay at the heart of the Institute’s endeavours. This book will be of interest to researchers on twentieth-century economic history, intellectual history, political philosophy, history of economic thought, epistemology, and critical theory.

AI.tldr: 本书首次全面研究了法兰克福学派中被忽视成员的经济理论贡献，通过档案研究重新定位该学派作为原创且有影响力的经济思想发源地，强调其经济理论的历史唯物主义和实证基础。
AI.research_question: 法兰克福学派中被忽视成员的经济理论贡献是什么？这些贡献如何改变我们对法兰克福学派作为经济思想发源地的理解？
AI.motivation: 现有研究过度关注法兰克福学派少数哲学导向成员，忽视了该学派其他成员对经济理论的实质性贡献，导致对法兰克福学派经济思想的片面理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判理论、历史唯物主义、政治经济学、经济思想史、知识论、魏玛共和国和纳粹德国历史背景下的经济理论发展。
AI.method: 基于新档案研究的智识历史方法，对法兰克福学派被忽视成员的经济理论进行系统性分析，并将其置于历史语境中考察。
AI.findings: 揭示了法兰克福学派中Franz L. Neumann、Otto Kirchheimer等被忽视成员对经济理论的实质性贡献，表明该学派的经济思想具有深厚的历史唯物主义和实证基础，而非仅仅是哲学批判。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定位法兰克福学派作为经济思想的重要发源地，挑战了传统上将其视为纯粹哲学批判学派的观点，为理解20世纪资本主义经济结构特征提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济思想史、政治哲学、批判理论等领域的研究者提供了新的研究路径，重新评估法兰克福学派在经济理论和实证研究方面的遗产，促进跨学科对话。

title: The Price of Enterprise Entry: Evidence from Migrants Fragmentation
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology and Nanchang University

detail.title: The Price of Enterprise Entry: Evidence from Migrants Fragmentation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Chen Zhu: Data curation, Conceptualization, Supervision, Resources, Data curation, Visualization, Writing - Original Draft and Review & Editing. Chien-Chiang Lee: Corresponding author. Resources, Conceptualization, Supervision, Methodology, Writing - Review & Editing.

detail.abstract: From a transaction-costs perspective, we show that migration fragmentation hinders the entry of new registered companies by increasing both the formal and informal transaction costs. We find support for these arguments by matching industrial and commercial enterprise registration datasets with Mobile Signaling and Baidu migration datasets to obtain 2,405,188 samples. We highlight a potential new mechanism by which migration fragmentation reduces the rate of new business registrations.

AI.tldr: 从交易成本视角，研究发现迁移碎片化通过增加正式和非正式交易成本阻碍了新注册公司的进入
AI.research_question: 迁移碎片化如何影响新注册公司的进入率？
AI.motivation: 理解人口迁移模式对企业创建的影响，特别是迁移碎片化（非连续、分散的迁移）如何通过交易成本机制影响创业活动
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本理论，关注正式交易成本（如注册程序、合规成本）和非正式交易成本（如信息不对称、网络关系建立）
AI.method: 匹配工商企业注册数据集与移动信令和百度迁移数据集，获得2,405,188个样本进行实证分析
AI.findings: 迁移碎片化通过增加正式和非正式交易成本，显著降低了新企业的注册率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了迁移碎片化影响企业创建的新机制（交易成本渠道），丰富了人口迁移与创业关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化迁移政策、降低创业交易成本的政策启示，有助于促进区域创业活力

title: The Alignment Paradox: Empirical Evidence of Social Regression in Newest Large Language Models

detail.title: The Alignment Paradox: Empirical Evidence of Social Regression in Newest Large Language Models
