publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing (JTHSM), 11(2), 72–83. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17610990
publicationDetails.journalName: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study examines the transformation of Uzbekistan's tourism geography between 2010 and 2024, emphasizing the shift from rapid spatial expansion to strategic consolidation around heritage cities such as Samarkand, Bukhara, and Tashkent. It investigates how tourism functions as a spatial instrument of governance, identity construction, and economic diversification in a post-Soviet context. 

Methods: Using longitudinal visitor data, economic indicators, and spatial mapping generated through R and Python, the study analyzes evolving tourist flows, destination hierarchies, and the spatial concentration of tourism investments across Uzbekistan's regions. 

Results: Findings show that while the number of officially recognized destinations plateaued after 2016, tourist arrivals and receipts continued to increase, marking a transition from territorial expansion to qualitative consolidation. Tourism has evolved into a form of spatial storytelling that reinforces the visibility of core heritage centers while reproducing symbolic and infrastructural inequalities across the periphery. 

Implications: Beyond Uzbekistan, the findings offer insights for emerging tourism economies aiming to balance heritage valorization with regional inclusion, providing adaptable guidance for equitable destination planning aligned with SDGs 8, 9, and 11. By extending core-periphery theory to a post-socialist tourism context, the study reframes tourism as a territorial governance project that links cultural heritage, spatial inequality, and statecraft. It demonstrates that spatial inequality is not merely an economic outcome but a deliberate product of narrative and institutional governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了乌兹别克斯坦2010-2024年旅游地理的转型，从快速空间扩张转向以撒马尔罕、布哈拉和塔什干等遗产城市为核心的战略整合，探讨了旅游如何作为后苏联背景下的空间治理工具、身份建构和经济多元化手段。
AI.research_question: 乌兹别克斯坦旅游地理如何从空间扩张转向战略整合？旅游如何作为后苏联背景下的空间治理工具、身份建构和经济多元化手段？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴旅游经济体如何平衡遗产价值化与区域包容性，为符合可持续发展目标（SDGs 8、9、11）的公平目的地规划提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心-边缘理论在后社会主义旅游背景下的延伸，将旅游重构为连接文化遗产、空间不平等和国家治理的领土治理项目。
AI.method: 使用纵向游客数据、经济指标和通过R与Python生成的空间映射，分析乌兹别克斯坦各地区不断变化的旅游流量、目的地层级和旅游投资的空间集中度。
AI.findings: 2016年后官方认可的目的地数量趋于稳定，但游客数量和收入持续增长，标志着从领土扩张向质量整合的转变。旅游演变为一种空间叙事形式，强化核心遗产中心的可见性，同时在边缘地区复制象征性和基础设施不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将核心-边缘理论扩展到后社会主义旅游背景，重新构建旅游作为连接文化遗产、空间不平等和国家治理的领土治理项目，表明空间不平等不仅是经济结果，更是叙事和制度治理的有意产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴旅游经济体提供平衡遗产价值化与区域包容性的见解，为符合SDGs 8、9、11的公平目的地规划提供适应性指导。

title: Entrepreneurial Coaching and Migration Intentions: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in Senegal
affiliations: University of Luxemburg, ,  and

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Coaching and Migration Intentions: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in Senegal
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of a one-week entrepreneurial coaching program on overall and irregular migration intentions among young adults in the Dakar metropolitan area, Senegal. Using a randomized controlled trial implemented in partnership with an entrepreneurship training center in Dakar, we estimate treatment effects by comparing baseline and follow-up outcomes and address partial compliance using instrumental-variable methods. We find that participation in entrepreneurial coaching reduces emigration intentions by 12–20%, with effects concentrated among individuals connected to the labor market. The program indirectly reduces intended irregular migration by encouraging some individuals to remain in Senegal. We do not find that participation affected the migration mode of those who still intend to migrate. Overall, our findings provide experimental evidence from Senegal that entrepreneurship-based active labor market policies can shape migration aspirations by strengthening local economic attachment among working youth.

AI.tldr: 通过随机对照试验发现，为期一周的创业指导项目能够显著降低塞内加尔达喀尔地区年轻人的移民意愿（减少12-20%），特别是对已就业人群效果更明显，并间接减少了非正规移民意图。
AI.research_question: 创业指导项目如何影响塞内加尔达喀尔地区年轻人的整体移民意愿和非正规移民意图？
AI.motivation: 研究创业导向的积极劳动力市场政策是否能够通过增强当地经济依附来影响年轻人的移民愿望，特别是在移民压力较大的发展中国家背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于积极劳动力市场政策理论、移民决策理论，探讨创业干预如何通过增强当地经济机会和依附来影响移民意愿。
AI.method: 采用随机对照试验设计，与达喀尔创业培训中心合作，使用工具变量方法处理部分依从性问题，比较基线和随访结果。
AI.findings: 1. 创业指导参与使移民意愿降低12-20%；2. 效果主要集中在与劳动力市场有联系的个体；3. 间接减少非正规移民意图；4. 对仍计划移民者的迁移方式无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了创业导向的积极劳动力市场政策影响移民意愿的实验证据，验证了通过增强当地经济依附来塑造移民愿望的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家政策制定者提供了基于创业干预来管理移民压力的可行方案，特别是针对已就业年轻人的干预策略。

title: Tourism and economy: When growth starts to slow down
affiliations: University of Macedonia, University of Macedonia, University of Macedonia, Technological Educational Institute of Central Macedonia, Department of Accounting and Finance and International Hellenic University (IHU) - School of Economics, Business Administration and Legal Studies

detail.title: Tourism and economy: When growth starts to slow down

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing (JTHSM), 11(2), 84–89. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18657334
publicationDetails.journalName: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study investigates whether tourism's involvement to economic growth shows diminishing returns past a certain threshold and seeks to identify the point at which this transition occurs. Specifically, it examines whether the part of tourism in the economy eventually leads to reduced incremental gains for overall growth. 

Methods: A balanced panel threshold regression model is applied to data from 30 OECD countries spanning from 2008 to 2020. The analysis aims to clarify the association among tourism's economic share and aggregate economic growth. 

Results: The findings indicate that tourism significantly stimulates economic growth up to a defined threshold, after which the marginal benefits decline. This threshold is estimated at approximately 4.68. Below this value, a one-unit increase in tourism's share of the economy is connected with an average rise in economic growth of 3.5 percentage points. Beyond this threshold, the corresponding effect decreases to approximately 2.74 percentage points per additional unit. 

Implications: The results suggest that excessive reliance on tourism does not guarantee sustained economic growth. Expanding tourism beyond a certain level may generate negative externalities such as congestion, environmental degradation, and social costs that can offset economic gains. Accordingly, for stable and sustainable development, countries should pursue a balanced growth strategy that integrates tourism with other sectors.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用OECD国家数据发现，旅游业对经济增长的促进作用存在边际递减效应，当旅游业占经济比重超过4.68%时，其促进效果从3.5个百分点降至2.74个百分点。
AI.research_question: 旅游业对经济增长的促进作用是否存在边际递减效应？如果是，这个转折点在哪里？
AI.motivation: 许多国家依赖旅游业作为经济增长引擎，但过度依赖可能导致负面外部效应，需要研究旅游业对经济增长的边际效益变化规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际收益递减理论、阈值回归模型、旅游经济学中的过度旅游理论
AI.method: 使用平衡面板阈值回归模型分析30个OECD国家2008-2020年的数据
AI.findings: 旅游业显著促进经济增长，但存在阈值效应（约4.68%）。低于阈值时，旅游业占比每增加1单位，经济增长提高3.5个百分点；超过阈值后，效果降至2.74个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了旅游业对经济增长存在边际递减效应，为旅游经济学提供了实证支持，扩展了阈值回归模型在旅游研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体阈值参考（4.68%），建议采取平衡发展战略，避免过度依赖旅游业，实现可持续经济增长。

title: From Unstructured Data to Demand Counterfactuals: Theory and Practice
affiliations: Yale University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: From Unstructured Data to Demand Counterfactuals: Theory and Practice
detail.abstract: Empirical models of demand for differentiated products rely on low-dimensional product representations to capture substitution patterns. These representations are increasingly proxied by applying ML methods to high-dimensional, unstructured data, including product descriptions and images. When proxies fail to capture the true dimensions of differentiation that drive substitution, standard workflows will deliver biased counterfactuals and invalid inference. We develop a practical toolkit that corrects this bias and ensures valid inference for a broad class of counterfactuals. Our approach applies to market-level and/or individual data, requires minimal additional computation, is efficient, delivers simple formulas for standard errors, and accommodates data-dependent proxies, including embeddings from fine-tuned ML models. It can also be used with standard quantitative attributes when mismeasurement is a concern. In addition, we propose diagnostics to assess the adequacy of the proxy construction and dimension. The approach yields meaningful improvements in predicting counterfactual substitution in both simulations and an empirical application.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个工具包，用于修正因低维产品表示未能捕捉真实差异化维度而导致的偏差，确保在差异化产品需求模型中反事实分析和推断的有效性。
AI.research_question: 当使用机器学习方法从高维非结构化数据中提取的低维产品表示未能捕捉驱动替代的真实差异化维度时，如何修正由此产生的偏差并确保反事实分析和统计推断的有效性？
AI.motivation: 差异化产品需求模型依赖低维产品表示来捕捉替代模式，这些表示越来越多地通过机器学习方法从产品描述、图像等高维非结构化数据中提取。当这些代理变量未能捕捉驱动替代的真实差异化维度时，标准工作流程会产生有偏的反事实结果和无效的统计推断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异化产品需求模型、代理变量理论、偏差修正方法、统计推断理论
AI.method: 开发了一个实用的工具包，适用于市场层面和/或个人数据，需要最少的额外计算，效率高，提供简单的标准误差公式，并能容纳数据依赖的代理变量（包括来自微调机器学习模型的嵌入）。该方法也可用于存在测量误差的标准定量属性。
AI.findings: 该方法在模拟和实证应用中都显著改善了反事实替代预测。同时提出了诊断方法来评估代理构建和维度的充分性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为差异化产品需求模型中代理变量偏差问题提供了理论解决方案；2. 开发了适用于广泛反事实类别的偏差修正和有效推断方法；3. 提出了评估代理构建充分性的诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个实用的工具包，计算效率高且易于实施；2. 支持市场层面和个人数据；3. 兼容数据依赖的代理变量（包括机器学习嵌入）；4. 在模拟和实证应用中展示了预测改进；5. 提供了诊断工具来评估代理质量。

title: Sales Forecasting Based on the Coefficient of Variation for Small-Sample Data

detail.title: Sales Forecasting Based on the Coefficient of Variation for Small-Sample Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: I have nothing to declare

detail.abstract: In the retail sector, particularly for companies with a wide product assortment, forecasting the number of units to be sold in the upcoming week or month is critical for fast and effective decision-making. In this study, the coefficient of variation (CV), defined as the ratio of the standard deviation to the mean, is used to improve forecast consistency. By making forecast reliability quantifiable, this study proposes a methodological framework that enables more effective and interpretable decision-making insights. The applicability and performance of the proposed method are evaluated under scenarios representing different sales behaviors using simulated datasets.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于变异系数（CV）的预测一致性改进方法，通过量化预测可靠性来提升零售业销售预测的有效性和可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用变异系数（CV）来改进零售业销售预测的一致性，并使预测可靠性可量化？
AI.motivation: 在零售行业，特别是产品种类繁多的公司中，准确预测未来一周或一个月的销售数量对于快速有效的决策制定至关重要。传统预测方法在一致性方面存在不足，需要更可靠和可解释的预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于变异系数（CV）理论，即标准差与均值的比率，作为衡量预测一致性的核心指标。该框架将预测可靠性量化，为决策提供更有效的洞察。
AI.method: 使用模拟数据集评估所提方法的适用性和性能，模拟不同销售行为场景。通过变异系数来改进预测一致性，并建立方法论框架。
AI.findings: 所提出的基于变异系数的方法在不同销售行为场景下表现出良好的适用性和性能，能够有效提高预测一致性并使预测可靠性可量化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将变异系数（CV）理论应用于销售预测一致性的改进；2. 建立了预测可靠性的量化框架；3. 提出了更有效和可解释的决策支持方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为零售企业提供了改进销售预测一致性的实用方法；2. 使预测可靠性可量化，支持更有效的库存管理和采购决策；3. 适用于产品种类繁多的零售环境，提升运营效率。

title: Balancing Customer Engagement and Annoyance in Online Retail: Insights from a Field Experiment
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Boston College - Carroll School of Management, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Decision Risk and Operations and

detail.title: Balancing Customer Engagement and Annoyance in Online Retail: Insights from a Field Experiment
detail.abstract: The emergence of e-commerce and digital operations has given firms unprecedented reach: retailers can now send real-time emails and mobile notifications to customers anywhere in the world. These direct-to-consumer promotions (e.g., coupons, emails, push alerts) can boost engagement and sales, but when overused, they can create annoyance and notification fatigue, alienate customers, increase unsubscriptions, and ultimately weaken long-term customer spending. In this paper, we first conduct a large-scale randomized field experiment at an online retailer to study this trade-off between engagement and annoyance. We find that sending fewer emails significantly reduces unsubscription (proxy for churn) by 59% and thus increases future customer survival, but at the cost of a 5-8% decrease in short-term revenue and purchase rate. These effects are heterogeneous: reducing coupon-email frequency lowers churn, especially among customers who previously used few coupons but opened many emails, and it reduces short-run spending, particularly among higher-volume customers and those who rarely opened emails. Then, using historical data over a longer time frame, we find that unsubscribing has a large negative effect on monthly revenue, with a 36% decrease in customer spending. We then embed these results in a customer lifetime-value (CLV) optimization model. The model shows that personalizing email frequency using the field-experimental estimates can improve long-term value: a myopic policy (maximizing immediate revenue) raises average CLV by 6.8%, while a full CLV-optimization policy yields an 8.3% gain over the daily-email baseline. These gains are driven by higher retention as well as modest changes in coupon usage. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of balancing short-term revenue with customer retention: sending emails with coupons too frequently can boost immediate sales but may "burn out" customers, whereas moderately reducing email frequency can yield higher lifetime value in many settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模随机现场实验发现，减少促销邮件频率能显著降低59%的退订率（流失代理指标），但会减少5-8%的短期收入。结合历史数据分析，退订导致客户月收入下降36%。通过客户终身价值优化模型，个性化邮件频率策略可使CLV提升6.8-8.3%，强调平衡短期收入与客户保留的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何平衡直接面向消费者的促销（如优惠券邮件）的短期收入效应与长期客户保留之间的权衡？个性化邮件频率策略能否提升客户终身价值？
AI.motivation: 电子商务和数字运营使企业能够向全球客户发送实时邮件和移动通知，这些促销活动能提升参与度和销售，但过度使用会导致客户厌烦、通知疲劳、退订增加，最终削弱长期客户支出。需要理解这种参与度与厌烦之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户终身价值（CLV）理论、客户流失与保留理论、行为经济学中的通知疲劳理论、个性化营销理论
AI.method: 1. 在在线零售商处进行大规模随机现场实验，研究邮件频率对退订和短期收入的影响；2. 使用历史数据分析退订对客户支出的长期影响；3. 将实验结果嵌入客户终身价值优化模型，评估个性化邮件频率策略的长期价值
AI.findings: 1. 减少邮件发送频率显著降低59%的退订率（流失代理指标），但减少5-8%的短期收入和购买率；2. 效果存在异质性：减少优惠券邮件频率对之前使用优惠券少但打开邮件多的客户降低流失效果更明显，对高消费客户和很少打开邮件的客户减少短期支出更明显；3. 退订导致客户月收入下降36%；4. 个性化邮件频率策略可提升客户终身价值：短视策略提升6.8%，完整CLV优化策略提升8.3%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了直接促销中参与度与厌烦之间的权衡关系；2. 揭示了邮件频率对客户流失和短期收入的异质性影响；3. 建立了将现场实验结果与CLV优化模型结合的框架；4. 为数字营销中的客户疲劳理论提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了优化邮件频率的具体策略：减少邮件发送可显著降低客户流失；2. 展示了如何通过个性化邮件频率提升客户终身价值；3. 提供了识别哪些客户对邮件频率变化更敏感的实用方法；4. 建议企业平衡短期收入与长期客户保留，避免"烧毁"客户

title: The Limits of Institutional Discretion in Multiparty Tribunal Constitution — Part I: Critical assessment of the Cairo Regional Centre's Rules and Practice

detail.title: The Limits of Institutional Discretion in Multiparty Tribunal Constitution — Part I: Critical assessment of the Cairo Regional Centre's Rules and Practice
detail.abstract:
This is Part I of a two-part paper examining the Cairo Regional Centre for International Commercial Arbitration’s approach to tribunal constitution in arbitrations involving multiple claimants or multiple respondents. The two parts pursue a single project but sound in different registers.

Part I is critical and retrospective. It analyses the Centre’s treatment of multiparty appointment breakdowns as that practice has developed under the 2011 Rules and as it has ostensibly been formalised in the 2024 revision. The analysis proceeds on three independent planes: textual coherence, epistemic soundness, and normative justification. Each is developed on its own terms. Taken together, they show that the Centre’s approach cannot be sustained within the structure of the Rules. The gravamen of the critique is that the practice was misconceived at source, and that the amendments to the 2024 rulebook—whatever their intended objective—have neither codified that practice nor left it untouched; instead, they have re-encoded the entire logic of institutional default intervention in multiparty tribunal constitution in ways that the Cairo Centre has yet to acknowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文是两篇系列论文的第一部分，批判性地分析了开罗国际商事仲裁中心在处理多方当事人仲裁庭组成问题上的做法，指出该中心在2011年规则下的实践存在根本缺陷，而2024年修订既未正式化原有做法，也未保持原状，而是重新编码了制度默认干预的逻辑。
AI.research_question: 开罗国际商事仲裁中心在处理多方当事人（多个申请人或多个被申请人）仲裁庭组成任命失败时的做法是否在规则结构内可持续？
AI.motivation: 分析开罗仲裁中心在多方当事人仲裁庭组成问题上的实践发展，特别是2011年规则下的实践以及2024年修订的正式化尝试，揭示其做法在规则体系内的不可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁规则解释理论、制度干预理论、多方当事人仲裁庭组成理论
AI.method: 批判性回顾分析，从三个独立层面展开：文本一致性、认识论合理性、规范性正当性
AI.findings: 开罗仲裁中心的做法在规则结构内不可持续，该实践从一开始就被误解，2024年修订既未正式化原有实践也未保持原状，而是重新编码了制度默认干预多方仲裁庭组成的整个逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为仲裁规则解释提供了多维分析框架（文本、认识论、规范性），揭示了制度干预逻辑的演变机制，对多方当事人仲裁庭组成理论有重要贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为仲裁从业者理解开罗仲裁中心规则的实际应用提供批判性视角，为规则修订提供参考，帮助当事人更好地预见和处理多方仲裁庭组成问题。

title: Spreading the Good Apples out: Market Entry Dynamics of Quality Differentiated Products
affiliations: University of Turin,  and Universita di Cagliari

detail.title: Spreading the Good Apples out: Market Entry Dynamics of Quality Differentiated Products

publicationDetails.detailsText: Research Technical Papers| Central Bank of Ireland

detail.abstract: The paper investigates firms' rollout strategies for quality-differentiated products across geographically dispersed markets. Using a theoretical framework that integrates nonhomothetic preferences, we show that premium goods are more likely to enter wealthier markets first, allowing firms to capture higher markups. We find that the main factors influencing the selection of follow-up markets differ by product quality: for premium goods, income levels are the primary determinant of expansion paths, whereas geographic proximity is the main driver for lower-quality products. Using micro-level data from the refrigeration industry, we confirm a significant positive association between market-entry order and income for higherquality products. Furthermore, we observe that follow-up markets tend to be geographically more dispersed for premium goods, reflecting a shift away from proximity-based expansion strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了企业在不同地理市场推出质量差异化产品的策略。研究发现，高端产品倾向于先进入富裕市场以获取更高溢价，而低端产品则更依赖地理邻近性进行扩张。
AI.research_question: 企业在不同地理市场中推出质量差异化产品的策略是什么？特别是，高端产品和低端产品的市场进入顺序和扩张路径有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解企业如何在不同地理市场推出质量差异化产品，以及产品质量如何影响市场进入策略，对于企业制定全球化扩张战略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非位似偏好理论框架，该框架解释了消费者对质量的需求如何随收入变化，从而影响企业定价和市场进入策略。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析。首先构建理论框架，然后使用制冷行业的微观数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. 高端产品更可能先进入富裕市场以获取更高溢价；2. 高端产品的扩张路径主要受收入水平驱动，而低端产品主要受地理邻近性驱动；3. 高端产品的后续市场在地理上更加分散，偏离了基于邻近性的扩张策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将非位似偏好理论应用于企业市场进入策略研究；2. 揭示了产品质量如何调节市场扩张的决定因素；3. 提出了质量差异化产品的市场进入顺序理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业制定全球化产品推出策略提供指导；2. 帮助管理者根据产品质量选择不同的市场进入顺序；3. 为高端产品和低端产品提供差异化的扩张路径建议。

title: The Missing Pillar of Canada's AI Strategy: Data Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Waterloo

detail.title: The Missing Pillar of Canada's AI Strategy: Data Supply Chains

declarations.funderStatement: This project was partially funded through contributions from select C.D. Howe Institute members to the Institute’s Competition, Innovation & Growth Working Group. The C.D. Howe Institute (CDHI) operates under a strict Independence and Non-Partisanship policy. CDHI requires all funding partners to agree that any contribution does not and shall not, in any way, compromise the CDHI’s Mission Statement, nor constrain CDHI’s academic freedom and editorial independence; They must also agree that any research undertaken by CDHI does not stipulate a predetermined result, nor shall it inhibit the independence of CDHI’s staff and authors to pursue scholarly research and disseminate the results of this research.

detail.abstract:
• While significant federal government investments in Canada have strengthened research capacity, talent development, and computing infrastructure, a foundational pillar of AI innovation remains underdeveloped: strong, secure, and trusted data supply chains. This Commentary argues that a comprehensive Canadian AI strategy must explicitly prioritize data supply chains while embedding robust protections for privacy and public trust.
  • Current legal and institutional frameworks lack clear, standardized rules governing data sharing for AI development, and Canada does not yet have formal social-benefit tests to balance innovation gains against potential harms to privacy. These institutional gaps limit the ability of firms to access critical datasets. Coordinated policies to enable responsible access to large, high-quality datasets will give Canadian firms – particularly startups and scaleups – a strong international competitive advantage.
  • I propose a policy framework grounded in three principles: (1) expanded, yet guarded, data access; (2) the integration of privacy-enhancing technologies; and (3) transparent governance mechanisms guided by cost-benefit analysis.
  • Key recommendations include allowing carefully regulated private-sector access to some confidential Statistics Canada datasets on a pilot basis; accelerating the national production of synthetic datasets; embedding social-benefit tests in privacy legislation; and establishing regulated AI sandboxes aligned with regional strengths.

AI.tldr: 加拿大AI战略需要优先发展安全可信的数据供应链，当前法律框架缺乏明确的数据共享规则，建议通过监管访问、隐私增强技术和透明治理来平衡创新与隐私保护。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能促进AI创新又能保护隐私和公共信任的加拿大数据供应链政策框架？
AI.motivation: 尽管加拿大在AI研究能力、人才培养和计算基础设施方面有大量联邦投资，但数据供应链这一AI创新的基础支柱仍然不完善，限制了企业获取关键数据集的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三个核心原则：1)受监管的数据访问扩展；2)隐私增强技术的整合；3)基于成本效益分析的透明治理机制。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，通过识别现有法律和制度框架的缺陷，提出具体的政策建议和实施方案。
AI.findings: 当前加拿大缺乏明确的数据共享标准化规则，没有正式的社会效益测试来平衡创新收益与隐私风险，这些制度性差距限制了企业获取关键数据集的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个平衡AI创新与隐私保护的数据供应链治理理论框架，强调在数据访问扩展中嵌入防护措施的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 具体政策建议包括：试点允许受监管的私营部门访问统计局机密数据；加速合成数据集的全国生产；在隐私立法中嵌入社会效益测试；建立与区域优势对齐的受监管AI沙盒。

title: Interest Rate Risk and the Cross-Section of Expected Corporate Bond Returns
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, Washington University in St. Louis - Olin Business School and

detail.title: Interest Rate Risk and the Cross-Section of Expected Corporate Bond Returns
detail.abstract: We construct a parsimonious interest rate risk exposure (IRRE) index using large, unexpected changes in interest rates implied by Fed Funds futures and observable bond characteristics from 2004 to 2008. This index predicts interest rate risk premium of corporate bonds from 2009 to 2022. As IRRE index increases, average returns and factor-adjusted alphas of the value-weighted portfolio increase monotonically, with a long-short portfolio annualized return of 9.24% (t-statistic of 4.80) and a Sharpe ratio of 1.21 per annum. In addition, the interest rate risk factor constructed based on IRRE has incremental explanatory power for corporate bond portfolios beyond bond market and traded liquidity factor.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个简约的利率风险暴露指数，该指数使用联邦基金期货隐含的利率意外变化和可观测的债券特征，能够预测2009-2022年公司债券的利率风险溢价。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个简约的利率风险暴露指数来预测公司债券的利率风险溢价？该指数能否解释公司债券投资组合的回报变化？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个能够有效衡量公司债券利率风险暴露的指标，以更好地理解和预测债券市场的风险溢价，并为投资组合管理提供实用工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利率风险定价理论，利率变化会影响债券价格和回报，公司债券对利率风险的暴露程度应该反映在其风险溢价中。
AI.method: 使用2004-2008年联邦基金期货隐含的利率意外变化和可观测的债券特征构建利率风险暴露指数，然后检验该指数对2009-2022年公司债券回报的预测能力。
AI.findings: IRRE指数能够显著预测公司债券的利率风险溢价。随着IRRE指数增加，价值加权投资组合的平均回报和因子调整后的alpha单调增加，多空组合年化回报达9.24%（t统计量4.80），年化夏普比率1.21。基于IRRE构建的利率风险因子对债券投资组合具有增量解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个简约的利率风险暴露度量方法，丰富了利率风险定价理论，为理解公司债券市场的风险溢价结构提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的利率风险暴露衡量工具，可用于债券投资组合的风险管理和资产配置决策，具有显著的经济意义。

title: The Geopolitics of Combustion: Saltpeter Supply, Gunpowder Trade, and the Violent Foundations of Early Modern Global Capitalism

detail.title: The Geopolitics of Combustion: Saltpeter Supply, Gunpowder Trade, and the Violent Foundations of Early Modern Global Capitalism
detail.abstract: This paper examines the geopolitics of gunpowder through the global trade in saltpetre, arguing that control over this strategic resource underpinned early modern capitalism and imperial expansion. Originating in sophisticated Asian production systems, particularly in India, saltpetre became indispensable to European fiscal-military states facing chronic shortages. The study shows how the English East India Company transformed commercial participation into coercive monopoly after its military conquest of Bengal, displacing Asian portfolio capitalists and subordinating indigenous labour. By linking resource expropriation, warfare, and state finance, the paper situates the saltpetre trade within the broader framework of war capitalism and global economic divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全球硝石贸易研究火药的地缘政治，认为对这一战略资源的控制支撑了早期现代资本主义和帝国扩张。研究显示英国东印度公司如何将商业参与转变为强制性垄断，将资源征用、战争和国家财政联系起来。
AI.research_question: 全球硝石贸易如何影响早期现代资本主义和帝国扩张的地缘政治格局？
AI.motivation: 理解战略资源控制如何成为早期现代资本主义和帝国扩张的基础，特别是硝石作为火药关键成分的地缘政治意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战争资本主义理论、全球经济分化框架、地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 历史分析，通过英国东印度公司在孟加拉的案例研究，考察硝石贸易从亚洲生产系统到欧洲财政军事国家的转变过程
AI.findings: 硝石起源于亚洲（特别是印度）的复杂生产系统；欧洲财政军事国家面临长期短缺；英国东印度公司通过军事征服将商业参与转变为强制性垄断；取代亚洲投资组合资本家并压制本土劳动力
AI.theory_contributions: 将资源征用、战争和国家财政联系起来，将硝石贸易置于战争资本主义和全球经济分化的更广泛框架中
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了战略资源控制如何实际支撑帝国扩张和早期现代资本主义发展，为理解当代资源地缘政治提供历史借鉴

title: Chinese and Russian Ambitions in Antarctica

detail.title: Chinese and Russian Ambitions in Antarctica

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or primary data collection. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Since 1959, the Antarctic Treaty System (ATS) has kept this far-off frozen continent a non-combatant, non-militarized, collaboratively scientific space. This thesis evaluates how the influx of People's Republic of China and Russian operations in Antarctica disrupts such stability produced over decades. Through the usage of descriptive statistics of capabilities, and qualitative exploration of policy rhetoric and strategic releases, this research legitimizes that China and Russia take advantage of scientific collaborative and ATS election majority allowances upon ATS membership to pursue strategic national gain. The China and Russia collaborative planned expansion through station placements relative to geographical boundaries, dual-use technologies with military/illicit intents, and natural resource governance committees and means to acquire future entitlements placed situationally within the ATS employment agreement but are contrary to collaborative expectations. This, compounded by an inspection regime with a verifiability void, positions China and Russia ahead of the game by 2048 as they successfully circumvent requirements and allow for a renegotiation of the mineral resource freeze. Ultimately, U.S. policymakers and allies need to respond to prompt an American and allied presence, ATS investigatory credibility, and collaborative intentions to preserve the integrity of the agreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了中国和俄罗斯在《南极条约体系》框架下的活动如何破坏南极的稳定，指出两国利用科学合作和条约机制追求战略利益，可能影响2048年矿产资源冻结条款的重新谈判。
AI.research_question: 中国和俄罗斯在南极的活动如何破坏《南极条约体系》维持的稳定，以及这些活动对未来条约完整性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 自1959年以来，《南极条约体系》成功保持了南极的非军事化、科学合作空间。但近年来中国和俄罗斯在南极活动的增加可能破坏这种稳定，需要评估其对条约体系的潜在威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的制度主义、地缘政治理论、战略竞争理论，以及条约体系中的制度漏洞和战略利用理论。
AI.method: 采用描述性统计方法分析能力数据，结合定性方法分析政策修辞和战略文件，评估中国和俄罗斯在南极的活动模式。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 中国和俄罗斯利用科学合作和条约选举机制追求国家战略利益；2) 通过科考站布局、军民两用技术、资源治理委员会等方式获取未来权益；3) 检查制度存在可验证性漏洞；4) 两国可能在2048年前成功规避要求，重新谈判矿产资源冻结条款。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 揭示了国际条约体系如何被战略性地利用；2) 提出了"制度漏洞战略利用"框架；3) 丰富了地缘政治竞争在国际制度中的表现形式理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 为美国政策制定者提供应对策略；2) 建议加强美国及盟友在南极的存在；3) 呼吁提升《南极条约体系》调查可信度；4) 提出维护条约完整性的具体措施。

title: Policy Uncertainty and the Pricing of Productivity
affiliations: Howard University

detail.title: Policy Uncertainty and the Pricing of Productivity
detail.abstract: I show that economic policy uncertainty (EPU) disrupts how stock markets value fundamental productivity in the AI and robotics sector. Using a smooth-transition local projection model with U.S. productivity and EPU data, I find that the positive effect of labor productivity growth on equity valuations weakens significantly as policy uncertainty rises. This suggests that in uncertain policy environments, the market's pricing of AI-intensive firms becomes less anchored to real economic performance. (Python code and data for replication are included in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，经济政策不确定性会削弱股票市场对AI和机器人行业基本生产率的估值能力。当政策不确定性上升时，劳动生产率增长对股票估值的正面影响显著减弱。
AI.research_question: 经济政策不确定性如何影响股票市场对AI和机器人行业基本生产率的估值？
AI.motivation: AI和机器人行业对经济政策变化高度敏感，但现有研究较少关注政策不确定性如何影响市场对这些行业基本生产率的定价效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性经济学和资产定价理论，探讨政策不确定性如何干扰市场对基本面信息的处理能力。
AI.method: 使用平滑转换局部投影模型，结合美国生产率数据和EPU数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 随着政策不确定性上升，劳动生产率增长对股票估值的正面影响显著减弱，表明在不确定的政策环境下，市场对AI密集型企业的定价与真实经济表现的关联度降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策不确定性对特定行业资产定价效率的影响机制，丰富了不确定性经济学在金融市场的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了重要参考：在政策不确定性高的时期，市场对AI行业基本面的反应可能失真，需要调整投资策略和政策沟通方式。

title: Raw Water as Business Source of Water Utilities Companies in Integrated Reporting

detail.title: Raw Water as Business Source of Water Utilities Companies in Integrated Reporting
detail.abstract: The purpose of this essay is to explore the possibility of including raw water, defined in the Integrated Reporting documents as a "natural capital" in the reporting of water utility companies (WUC). The retains an environmental report and requires it to be integrated with other parts of the , including the financial data. The focus of the study is not on the analysis of integrated reporting as a system, but on the analysis of its main components: natural capital (water in this case), the business model of water companies and the distribution of income through stakeholders using the rental approach. The main suppliers of capital and the holders of property rights, which give reasons for accepting the income in the case under consideration, are defined. Another task of the study is to provide an opportunity to easily integrate the raw water, being the main source of WUS's business model like natural capital with other capitals in the WUC's statement. Are presented models of reporting water as a natural capital in the balance sheet of WUC with economic (monetary) and social (non-monetary) components and sample water natural capital of WUC Balance sheet for practical use, and a model for the distribution of rental income. An option for income sharing through regulatory pricing has also been proposed.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了将原水作为"自然资本"纳入水务公司综合报告的可能性，提出了原水作为自然资本的报告模型和租金收入分配方案。
AI.research_question: 如何将原水作为自然资本纳入水务公司的综合报告中，并建立相应的报告模型和收入分配机制？
AI.motivation: 水务公司需要将环境报告与其他部分（包括财务数据）整合，但现有报告系统未能充分体现原水作为自然资本的价值和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合报告框架、自然资本理论、租金理论、利益相关者理论、水务公司商业模式分析
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过分析综合报告的主要组成部分（自然资本、商业模式、收入分配），提出报告模型和收入分配方案
AI.findings: 提出了包含经济（货币）和社会（非货币）组成部分的原水自然资本资产负债表模型，以及租金收入分配模型和监管定价的收入分享方案
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了综合报告中自然资本的理论框架，将原水作为核心自然资本纳入报告体系，丰富了水务公司商业模式与资本分配的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接应用于水务公司实践的原水自然资本资产负债表模板和收入分配模型，为监管定价提供了具体操作方案

title: Working with Generative AI vs Humans: The Impact on Well-being
affiliations: Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management, North Carolina State University - Poole College of Management, North Carolina State University - Department of Business Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Working with Generative AI vs Humans: The Impact on Well-being
detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has the potential to increase productivity, improve decision-making, and enhance creativity in the workplace. Yet, little is known about the implications of working with GenAI on workers' mental well-being.  We examine this question using an incentivized laboratory experiment in which participants complete two operational tasks either with a GenAI assistant or with a human collaborator via a chat-based interface. Using validated psychological scales and multi-method text analysis of chat transcripts and post-task reflections, we find that collaboration with GenAI significantly reduces mental well-being relative to human-human collaboration. Further analysis of participants' changes in positive and negative emotions reveals asymmetric emotional effects. Specifically, human–human collaboration significantly reduces negative emotions, whereas human–GenAI collaboration does not; conversely, human–GenAI collaboration significantly reduces positive emotions, while human–human collaboration does not. Text analysis suggests that these differences are linked to distinct interaction styles: human–human interactions involve greater ``expressing'' and uncertainty language, which are associated with a decrease in negative emotions; human–GenAI interactions are dominated by technical, task-oriented “doing” communication, which is associated with a decrease in positive emotions. Our findings reveal a hidden human cost of replacing or supplementing human collaborators with GenAI in analytical and operational work.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，与人类合作相比，与生成式AI合作会显著降低工作者的心理健康水平，主要体现在负面情绪不减而正面情绪减少，揭示了用AI替代或补充人类协作的隐性人力成本。
AI.research_question: 与生成式人工智能（GenAI）合作对工作者心理健康有何影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然GenAI在提高生产力、改善决策和增强创造力方面有潜力，但其对工作者心理健康的影响尚不明确，需要实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会情感理论、人机交互理论和情绪调节理论，探讨不同类型协作对情绪状态的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用激励性实验室实验，参与者完成两项操作任务，随机分配与GenAI助手或人类合作者通过聊天界面协作。使用验证的心理量表和多方法文本分析（聊天记录和任务后反思）。
AI.findings: 1. 与GenAI合作显著降低心理健康水平；2. 情绪效应不对称：人-人合作显著减少负面情绪，人-AI合作则无此效果；人-AI合作显著减少正面情绪，人-人合作则无此效果；3. 文本分析显示互动风格差异：人-人互动更多表达和不确定性语言（与负面情绪减少相关），人-AI互动更多技术性、任务导向的"执行"沟通（与正面情绪减少相关）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证检验GenAI协作对心理健康的影响；2. 揭示人机协作与人际协作在情绪调节上的不对称效应；3. 识别不同协作模式下的沟通风格差异及其心理后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒组织在引入GenAI时需考虑心理健康成本；2. 建议设计更人性化的AI协作界面；3. 为工作场所心理健康干预提供依据；4. 平衡AI效率收益与员工福祉。

title: Learning Pay Strategies with Small Samples in Gig Economy Platforms
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - The H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISyE), Yale School of Management and foreva.ai (Eva)

detail.title: Learning Pay Strategies with Small Samples in Gig Economy Platforms
detail.abstract: Gig economy platforms operate in dynamic and competitive labor markets in which workers can compare and choose among multiple job offers in real time. A central challenge for these platforms is to set worker compensation when individual workers' reservation wages are heterogeneous, and when common market-wide factors such as competitor incentives shift workers' willingness to accept offers. We study a profitmaximizing platform that must serve identical requests by sequentially making takeit-or-leave-it pay offers to a pool of workers, observing only acceptances and rejections. Each worker's reservation wage consists of an individual component and a shared global factor that is initially unknown to the platform. We first characterize the optimal policy in a full-information benchmark where the global factor is known, and show that the problem can be solved efficiently via dynamic programming. The optimal policy leverages worker heterogeneity by initially offering pay below the myopic optimum, increasing pay following rejections and decreasing it following acceptances, and avoiding a set of dominated pay levels that are never optimal. We then analyze the realistic setting in which the global factor is uncertain and must be inferred from a small number of observations. While the exact belief-augmented solution is complex, we develop simple and interpretable heuristics with provable performance guarantees. In particular, we propose a direct-commit policy and a probe-and-commit policy that use little or no learning to adapt pay to market conditions. Our results provide actionable guidance for gig economy platforms seeking to set transparent, adaptive worker compensation in competitive spot labor markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了零工经济平台在动态竞争性劳动力市场中如何设定工人薪酬，考虑了工人保留工资的异质性和未知的市场共同因素。研究提出了最优薪酬策略，并开发了具有性能保证的简单启发式方法。
AI.research_question: 在工人保留工资存在异质性且市场共同因素未知的情况下，零工经济平台如何最优地设定工人薪酬以最大化利润？
AI.motivation: 零工经济平台在动态竞争的劳动力市场中运营，工人可以实时比较和选择多个工作机会。平台面临的核心挑战是：当个体工人的保留工资存在异质性，且竞争对手激励等市场共同因素会影响工人接受工作的意愿时，如何设定工人薪酬。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论和机制设计理论，研究零工经济平台的最优薪酬设定问题。考虑了工人保留工资的异质性（个体成分+共同市场因素），平台采用"接受或离开"的报价方式，只能观察到接受或拒绝的结果。
AI.method: 1. 建立完全信息基准模型（市场共同因素已知），使用动态规划求解最优策略；2. 分析市场共同因素不确定的现实情况，开发具有性能保证的启发式策略（直接承诺策略和探测-承诺策略）。
AI.findings: 1. 完全信息下的最优策略：初始报价低于短视最优水平，根据接受/拒绝调整报价，避免使用被支配的薪酬水平；2. 不确定情况下的启发式策略：直接承诺策略和探测-承诺策略能够以少量或不学习的方式适应市场条件，具有可证明的性能保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为零工经济平台薪酬设定问题提供了理论框架；2. 刻画了完全信息下的最优策略特征；3. 开发了具有性能保证的简单启发式策略，解决了信念增强解决方案的复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零工经济平台提供了可操作的指导，帮助它们在竞争性即时劳动力市场中设定透明、自适应的工人薪酬方案。

title: Entrepreneurs Make Leaps: A Critique of the Theory of the Adjacent Possible

detail.title: Entrepreneurs Make Leaps: A Critique of the Theory of the Adjacent Possible

declarations.funderStatement: The first version of the paper was prepared for a workshop that was funded by Syracuse University’s Institute for an Entrepreneurial Society, the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation, the Institute for Humane Studies, and Maria Minniti. I did not receive a stipend or honorarium, but most travel expenses were reimbursed.

detail.abstract: The theory of the adjacent possible (TAP) is a combinatorial account of the growth of the biosphere and the technosphere, conceived by Stuart Kauffman, popularized by Steven Johnson, and formalized into the TAP equation by Roger Koppl, Stuart Kauffman, Abigail Devereaux, and others in their ambitious paper “Explaining Technology” (2023).  The TAP equation is a curve-fitting exercise where unrealistic values of fixed parameters are assumed in order to generate the shape of the hockey stick graph of economic growth.  A crucial mistake in the TAP model is that it “deflates” the agency of breakthrough inventors and especially of innovative entrepreneurs.  As a result of this mistake, it fails to explain several important stylized technology facts like why the Industrial Revolution occurred first in England.  Several stories document how the agency of inventors and entrepreneurs matters, including stories about William Coley, Bart Gullong, Frank Hursey, Jony Ive, Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, George Stephenson, Leo Szilard, Peter Thiel, Josiah Wedgwood, and Wilbur Wright.  These stories show that technological progress is not always incremental, inevitable, or adjacent; technology does not always increase in diversity and complexity; and the inventor’s and the entrepreneur’s urgency, courage, and perseverance can matter.  Actionable explanations of technology are most useful in speeding technological and medical progress.  Empirically thick sources can improve explanations of technology.  So far we know technology flourishes where institutions and policies support rule of law, property rights (including patents), limited regulations, low taxes, and respect for inventors and entrepreneurs.  Some technology leaps occur because we benefit from geniuses and because science fiction can inspire geniuses, and the rest of us, to actualize dreams that currently are not part of the adjacent possible.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判了"相邻可能理论"（TAP），认为其过度简化了技术进步的机制，特别是忽视了发明家和企业家能动性的关键作用。作者通过历史案例证明技术进步并非总是渐进、必然或相邻的，并提出了更全面的技术解释框架。
AI.research_question: 相邻可能理论（TAP）能否充分解释技术进步的模式和机制？特别是，该理论是否忽视了发明家和企业家的能动性在技术突破中的关键作用？
AI.motivation: 相邻可能理论虽然提供了技术增长的组合解释，但其模型存在缺陷：1）通过不现实的参数假设来拟合经济增长曲线；2）低估了突破性发明家和创新企业家的能动性；3）无法解释重要的技术事实，如工业革命为何首先在英国发生。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）相邻可能理论（TAP）- Stuart Kauffman提出，Steven Johnson推广，Roger Koppl等人形式化的技术增长理论；2）能动性理论-强调个体发明家和企业家在技术突破中的关键作用；3）制度经济学-强调制度环境对技术创新的影响。
AI.method: 1）理论批判-分析TAP方程的参数假设和模型缺陷；2）案例研究-通过William Coley、Steve Jobs、Elon Musk、George Stephenson等12位发明家和企业家的历史故事，展示能动性的重要性；3）比较分析-对比TAP理论与基于能动性的解释框架。
AI.findings: 1）技术进步并非总是渐进、必然或相邻的；2）技术并不总是增加多样性和复杂性；3）发明家和企业家的紧迫感、勇气和毅力至关重要；4）制度环境（法治、产权、低税收、尊重创新者）对技术繁荣至关重要；5）天才和科幻灵感可以推动超越"相邻可能"的技术飞跃。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）对相邻可能理论进行了系统批判，指出了其理论缺陷；2）提出了强调个体能动性的技术解释框架；3）整合了制度因素和个体创造力在技术进步中的作用；4）为技术史研究提供了更全面的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了促进技术创新的具体建议（支持法治、产权、低税收等）；2）强调了尊重发明家和企业家文化的重要性；3）展示了如何通过"经验厚实"的资料改进技术解释；4）为加速技术和医学进步提供了行动指南。

title: When Judgments Fail to Enforce: Dissecting the Hidden Collapse of International Investment Justice and Constructing a Preventive Logic Beyond Sanctions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When Judgments Fail to Enforce: Dissecting the Hidden Collapse of International Investment Justice and Constructing a Preventive Logic Beyond Sanctions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: I am fully committed to scientific integrity.
declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract:
International investment justice, in its current configuration, rests upon a silent paradox: arbitral awards that are final and binding in doctrine, yet structurally fragile in enforcement. Despite decades of institutional refinement in investment arbitration, the post-award phase remains a legal vacuum, routinely filled by coercive mechanisms that stand outside the logic of adjudication. This paper does not critique the validity of awards, but rather interrogates their capacity to enforce themselves within a system that claims to depoliticize disputes, only to reintroduce politics at the moment of execution.

By deconstructing the hidden architecture of investment award enforcement, the paper demonstrates that the systemic reliance on economic coercion is not an incidental failure, but the consequence of an institutional design devoid of preventive enforcement mechanisms. Sanctions, however legally framed, emerge not as instruments of execution, but as substitutes for it transforming investment justice into a system of authoritative judgments without autonomous effect.

Against this structural impasse, the paper advances a reconstruction of enforcement logic itself, not through the creation of new coercive authority, but through a preventive legal architecture grounded in contractual consent and pre-funded execution. In doing so, it reconnects judgment with effect without encroaching upon state sovereignty or resorting to sanctions. Ultimately, this work poses a foundational question for international economic law: whether justice can endure when judgments, though formally binding, lack the capacity to be enforced.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了国际投资仲裁裁决执行中的结构性悖论：裁决在理论上具有终局约束力，但在执行上却结构脆弱。论文指出系统依赖经济胁迫并非偶然失败，而是缺乏预防性执行机制的体制设计后果。作者提出基于合同同意和预筹资金的预防性法律架构，以重新连接判决与效果。
AI.research_question: 国际投资仲裁裁决在形式上具有约束力，但为何缺乏自主执行能力？如何在不侵犯国家主权或诉诸制裁的情况下，重新连接判决与执行效果？
AI.motivation: 当前国际投资仲裁存在一个沉默的悖论：仲裁裁决在理论上具有终局约束力，但在执行阶段却结构脆弱。尽管投资仲裁制度经过数十年完善，裁决后阶段仍存在法律真空，通常被强制机制填补，而这些机制本身处于裁决逻辑之外。这导致系统声称要"去政治化"争端，却在执行时刻重新引入政治因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 国际投资仲裁执行理论；2. 裁决自主性理论；3. 强制机制替代理论；4. 预防性法律架构理论；5. 合同同意与预筹资金执行理论
AI.method: 1. 解构分析：揭示投资裁决执行的隐藏架构；2. 制度分析：分析系统依赖经济胁迫的结构性原因；3. 重构方法：提出基于预防性法律架构的执行逻辑重建方案
AI.findings: 1. 投资仲裁裁决执行存在结构性悖论：裁决形式上有约束力但执行脆弱；2. 系统依赖经济胁迫不是偶然失败，而是缺乏预防性执行机制的体制设计后果；3. 制裁无论如何法律包装，都不是执行工具，而是执行的替代品；4. 这导致投资正义变成了"有权威判决但无自主效果"的系统
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了国际投资仲裁执行的结构性悖论；2. 提出了"裁决自主性"与"执行效果"分离的理论框架；3. 发展了预防性执行法律架构理论；4. 重新概念化了国际投资正义中判决与执行的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国际投资仲裁改革提供新思路；2. 提出基于合同同意和预筹资金的预防性执行方案；3. 为解决裁决执行困境提供可行路径；4. 为国际投资法律实践提供避免政治化执行的替代方案

title: How to Tax Business? Economic Rents, Legibility, and the Corporate-Pass-Through Divide
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School, Yale University - Law School and Columbia University - Law School

detail.title: How to Tax Business? Economic Rents, Legibility, and the Corporate-Pass-Through Divide

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Public Law Research Paper No. 6206239
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We reevaluate the choice between entity-level and pass-through taxation in light of two transformative U.S. trends. First, as business taxation converges toward a cash flow tax via expensing, pass-through taxation's variable rate structure generates inefficient investment incentives and negative tax rates, whereas entity taxation offers necessary stability and better targets economic rents. Second, the explosion of complex, multi-tiered partnerships has rendered a growing share of business activity illegible to enforcement. Since entity taxation better targets economic rents and acts as a necessary "circuit breaker" against this inadministrable complexity, we discuss policy reforms to shift the tax treatment of large firms. I.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了实体层面征税与穿透征税的选择，基于美国两大趋势：1) 企业税向现金流税趋同，穿透征税的变动税率结构产生低效投资激励和负税率，而实体征税提供必要稳定性并更好针对经济租金；2) 复杂多层合伙企业的激增使大量商业活动难以监管，实体征税能更好针对经济租金并作为"断路器"应对这种不可管理的复杂性，因此建议改革大型企业的税收处理。
AI.research_question: 在现金流税趋同和复杂多层合伙企业激增的背景下，实体层面征税与穿透征税哪种方式更优？
AI.motivation: 美国企业税制正经历两大变革趋势：1) 企业税向现金流税趋同，通过费用化实现；2) 复杂多层合伙企业的爆炸式增长。这些趋势对传统税收选择提出了新的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收效率理论、投资激励理论、经济租金理论、税收管理复杂性理论
AI.method: 理论分析、政策评估、趋势分析
AI.findings: 1) 在现金流税趋同下，穿透征税的变动税率结构会产生低效投资激励和负税率问题；2) 实体征税能提供必要稳定性并更好针对经济租金；3) 复杂多层合伙企业的增长使大量商业活动难以监管；4) 实体征税能作为"断路器"应对这种不可管理的复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在现金流税背景下重新构建了实体征税与穿透征税的比较框架；2) 提出了税收作为"断路器"应对管理复杂性的理论；3) 深化了对经济租金征税目标的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了改革大型企业税收处理的依据；2) 提出了从穿透征税向实体征税转变的政策建议；3) 为解决税收管理复杂性问题提供了具体方案。

title: Leveraging Digital Tools for Enhanced ESG Supplier Assessments

detail.title: Leveraging Digital Tools for Enhanced ESG Supplier Assessments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: In the context of the transformation of the global economic paradigm and the growing demands for transparency in corporate behavior, the integration of non-financial criteria-particularly Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors-into the strategic procurement planning process has become not only a marker of an enterprise's ethical maturity but also a determinant of its long-term competitiveness. The article substantiates a methodological approach to integrating ESG criteria into supplier selection and evaluation processes for both corporate and public supply chains. It underscores the increasing importance of non-financial indicators for business resilience and compliance with evolving regulatory demands. Crucially, the study emphasizes leveraging advanced digital technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms, and natural language processing (NLP). These tools are vital for automating the assessment of supplier ESG profiles, thereby enhancing objectivity and reducing human error. The article outlines a comprehensive, multi-level ESG integration architecture, detailing its application across tender documentation, contracts, and dynamic supplier rating systems. This approach transforms traditional procurement into a strategically sustainable process, enabling proactive risk management and fostering greater transparency throughout the supply chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将ESG标准整合到供应商选择和评估过程中的方法论，强调利用人工智能、机器学习等数字技术自动化评估供应商ESG表现，构建多层次ESG整合架构，将传统采购转变为战略性可持续过程。
AI.research_question: 如何将ESG（环境、社会、治理）标准有效整合到企业及公共供应链的供应商选择和评估过程中？
AI.motivation: 在全球经济范式转型和企业行为透明度要求日益增长的背景下，整合ESG因素不仅是企业道德成熟的标志，也是长期竞争力的决定因素。非财务指标对企业韧性和合规性越来越重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续采购理论、企业社会责任理论、供应链风险管理理论、数字技术赋能理论（AI、机器学习、自然语言处理在ESG评估中的应用）
AI.method: 方法论方法，提出多层次ESG整合架构，包括：1）招标文件中的ESG要求整合；2）合同条款中的ESG条款设计；3）动态供应商评级系统；4）利用AI、机器学习和NLP技术自动化评估供应商ESG表现
AI.findings: 通过提出的方法论，能够将传统采购转变为战略性可持续过程，实现主动风险管理，提高供应链透明度，增强评估的客观性并减少人为错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）发展了可持续采购的理论框架；2）提出了数字技术赋能ESG评估的理论模型；3）构建了多层次ESG整合的理论架构；4）丰富了供应链风险管理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业提供了可操作的ESG整合方法论；2）展示了如何利用数字技术提高ESG评估效率；3）为公共采购提供了ESG整合参考；4）帮助企业满足监管要求并提升长期竞争力

title: Leader-Follower Formation Control for Multi-USV Cleaning Missions Under Hydrodynamic Disturbances
affiliations: University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering and University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering

detail.title: Leader-Follower Formation Control for Multi-USV Cleaning Missions Under Hydrodynamic Disturbances
detail.abstract: A formation-control framework is implemented for multi-USV cleaning missions operating under hydrodynamic disturbances. The controller combines a disturbance observer, adaptive gain tuning, and hydrodynamic coupling compensation to maintain inter-vessel spacing. Experiments include 15 lake trials, covering wind speeds of 3-7 m/s and currents of 0.2-0.6 m/s. Formation deviation is reduced from 0.74 m to 0.29 m, and sweeping coverage uniformity improves by 21.5%. Results indicate that leader-follower structures remain viable under moderate environmental disturbances in coordinated cleaning operations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于多无人水面艇清洁任务的形成控制框架，结合了扰动观测器、自适应增益调节和水动力耦合补偿，在15次湖上试验中将编队偏差从0.74米降低到0.29米，清扫覆盖率均匀性提高了21.5%。
AI.research_question: 在存在水动力扰动（风、流）的环境下，如何实现多无人水面艇的稳定编队控制以完成协调清洁任务？
AI.motivation: 多无人水面艇在清洁任务中面临水动力扰动（风、水流）的挑战，这些扰动会影响编队稳定性和任务执行效果，需要开发鲁棒的控制方法来应对这些环境干扰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于领导-跟随者编队控制结构，结合扰动观测器理论、自适应控制理论和水动力耦合补偿机制。
AI.method: 设计了一个结合扰动观测器、自适应增益调节和水动力耦合补偿的控制框架，通过15次湖上试验验证，覆盖风速3-7 m/s和流速0.2-0.6 m/s的环境条件。
AI.findings: 编队偏差从0.74米显著降低到0.29米，清扫覆盖率均匀性提高了21.5%，表明领导-跟随者结构在中等环境扰动下仍然适用于协调清洁操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个集成了扰动观测、自适应调节和水动力补偿的编队控制框架，为多无人水面艇在扰动环境下的协调控制提供了理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发的实际控制方法显著提高了多无人水面艇清洁任务的编队稳定性和覆盖效率，为实际水域清洁应用提供了可行的技术方案。

title: Mental Health and Conflicts: A Handbook for Empowerment (2026 Edition)
affiliations: MH Mediate

detail.title: Mental Health and Conflicts: A Handbook for Empowerment (2026 Edition)
detail.abstract:
Mental health needs are universal. About half of us will end up having a diagnosable mental health issue at some point during our lives, and we all know what it is like to have a bad day. We also understand conflicts are hard and they often bring out the worst in us.

There are simple ways to be ready for when mental health needs arise during conflicts. This handbook introduces different mental health perspectives, dispels common stereotypes, and provides tools for empowering mental health communication.

This book is designed to help laypeople as well as professionals across all kinds of conflicts. It includes case studies, personal stories, and takeaway tools to help readers apply the skills to the situations they face in their personal and professional lives.

AI.tldr: 这是一本关于冲突情境下心理健康沟通的实用手册，旨在帮助普通人和专业人士在冲突中处理心理健康需求，提供视角、工具和案例研究。
AI.research_question: 如何在冲突情境中有效识别和应对心理健康需求？
AI.motivation: 心理健康需求是普遍的，约一半人会在生活中出现可诊断的心理健康问题，而冲突往往会加剧心理困扰。需要实用的工具帮助人们在冲突中更好地处理心理健康问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理健康沟通理论、冲突管理理论、心理健康素养框架
AI.method: 手册编写方法，包括案例研究分析、个人故事收集、实用工具开发
AI.findings: 提供了具体的心理健康沟通工具和策略，帮助读者在冲突中识别心理健康需求、打破刻板印象、进行有效沟通
AI.theory_contributions: 将心理健康沟通理论与冲突管理相结合，提出了冲突情境下的心理健康沟通框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为普通人和专业人士提供了实用的心理健康沟通工具包，包含可立即应用的技能和策略

title: Getting Priorities Straight: A Cluster Typology of Nurses’ Implementation Perspectives on Sensor-Based Technologies
affiliations: Paracelsus Medical University Salzburg and Paracelsus Medical University Salzburg

detail.title: Getting Priorities Straight: A Cluster Typology of Nurses’ Implementation Perspectives on Sensor-Based Technologies
detail.abstract:
Background. Sensor-based digital technologies are increasingly implemented in long-term geriatric care to support nursing workflows, enhance patient safety, and enable real-time monitoring. However, implementation outcomes remain inconsistent, suggesting that nurses’ perceptions of such technologies are heterogeneous and not adequately captured by mean-based acceptance measures.
Aims. This study aimed to identify empirically derived implementation perception profiles of sensor-based digital nursing technologies among geriatric nurses working in long-term care settings.
Methods. An exploratory cross-sectional survey was conducted among nursing professionals in long-term geriatric care (n = 43). Implementation perceptions were assessed using binary indicators reflecting functional, efficiency-related, safety, and governance-related aspects of sensor-based technologies. Hierarchical cluster analysis with Jaccard distance and complete linkage was applied to identify distinct implementation perception profiles. Cluster robustness and quality were assessed using silhouette coefficients and bootstrapping procedures.
Results. A four-cluster solution was identified, representing distinct implementation perception profiles. Rather than differing along a single acceptance continuum, clusters were characterized by different configurations of perceived system functionality, efficiency implications, safety considerations, and governance-related concerns. The results demonstrate substantial heterogeneity in how geriatric nurses evaluate sensor-based digital nursing technologies.
Conclusion. Implementation perceptions of sensor-based digital nursing technologies among geriatric nurses are heterogeneous and structured into distinct profiles that cannot be captured by mean acceptance scores alone. A profile-oriented, cluster-analytic approach provides actionable insights for the design and implementation of sensor-based digital nursing technologies in long-term care by supporting more targeted and context-sensitive implementation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过聚类分析识别了老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的四种不同实施感知模式，揭示了护士对这类技术的评价存在显著异质性，而非简单的接受度连续体。
AI.research_question: 老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的实施感知存在哪些不同的模式或类型？
AI.motivation: 传感器数字技术在老年长期护理中的应用日益增多，但实施效果不一致，表明护士对这些技术的感知存在异质性，而传统的均值接受度测量无法充分捕捉这种复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实施科学和技术接受理论，关注功能、效率、安全和治理四个维度的实施感知。
AI.method: 采用探索性横断面调查，对43名长期老年护理护士进行问卷调查，使用二元指标评估实施感知，应用Jaccard距离和完全连接的层次聚类分析识别不同实施感知模式，并通过轮廓系数和自助法评估聚类稳健性。
AI.findings: 识别出四种不同的实施感知模式，这些模式不是沿着单一的接受度连续体分布，而是由感知系统功能、效率影响、安全考虑和治理相关担忧的不同配置特征化，表明老年护理护士对传感器数字护理技术的评价存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对护士技术实施感知异质性的实证证据，挑战了传统的均值接受度测量方法，提出了基于配置的感知模式分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为传感器数字护理技术的设计和实施提供可操作的见解，支持更针对性和情境敏感的实施策略，帮助管理者识别不同护士群体的需求并制定差异化干预措施。

title:
A Semantic Audit Framework for National Security Reports Driven by Structural Empty Graph Networks (SEGN) --
A Methodological Analysis of Latvia's SAB Reporting Mechanism based on the "Single Source of Truth -Computable Reasoning -Audit Interface" Framework
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title:
A Semantic Audit Framework for National Security Reports Driven by Structural Empty Graph Networks (SEGN) --
A Methodological Analysis of Latvia's SAB Reporting Mechanism based on the "Single Source of Truth -Computable Reasoning -Audit Interface" Framework

keywords: Semantic Auditing of National Security Annual Reports
Evidence Alignment and Threshold Escalation Mechanism

detail.abstract: Annual public reports issued by national security agencies serve concurrently as factual disclosures, explanatory mechanisms, and governance statements. Existing methodologies-including topic modelling, keyword co-occurrence analysis, and general information extraction-often struggle to align 'assertion-evidence-mechanism-causality' within a unified framework, thereby failing to establish verifiable inferential loops. This deficiency constitutes a knowledge gap in semantic auditing. Taking the 2025 Annual Report of Latvia's Constitution Protection Bureau (SAB) as its subject, this paper proposes a three-tier digital product roadmap driven by SEGN (Structured Empty Graph Network): It employs Single Source of Truth (SSOT) lossless graph binding to link page numbers with evidence fingerprints. The computable reasoning layer structures the concept-mechanismcausality chain while introducing evidence alignment and coverage thresholds (τ_a, τ_c). Finally, the audit interface records audit status (Pass/Warning/Fail) and uncertainty through field-based documentation. Results indicate that within this report context, mechanism nodes such as 'legal warfare pathways, cybersecurity compliance implementation, and classified information protection governance' occupy pivotal positions in structural centrality and evidence density. Furthermore, under specific conditions, enhanced evidence coverage facilitates mechanism inference migration from warning to pass levels, explainable through an 'evidence alignment-threshold escalation' audit mechanism. These findings support transforming national security texts from readable narratives into sets of inferential objects that are replayable, threshold-based, and falsifiable. This provides a unified language for inferential strength across annual comparisons and document migrations, while offering verifiable foundations for evidence-based risk control in public security and cyber governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于SEGN的三层数字产品路线图，将国家安全年度报告从可读叙述转化为可重放、基于阈值、可证伪的推理对象集合，为公共安全和网络治理提供可验证的证据基础。
AI.research_question: 如何建立统一的框架来对齐国家安全报告中的"主张-证据-机制-因果关系"，形成可验证的推理循环？
AI.motivation: 现有方法（主题建模、关键词共现分析、信息提取）难以在统一框架内对齐"主张-证据-机制-因果关系"，无法建立可验证的推理循环，构成语义审计的知识缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化空图网络（SEGN）、单一事实来源（SSOT）无损图绑定、可计算推理层、证据对齐与覆盖阈值（τ_a, τ_c）、基于字段的审计文档化。
AI.method: 以拉脱维亚宪法保护局2025年度报告为研究对象，提出三层数字产品路线图：1) SSOT无损图绑定链接页码与证据指纹；2) 可计算推理层结构化概念-机制-因果关系链；3) 审计界面记录审计状态（通过/警告/失败）和不确定性。
AI.findings: 机制节点（法律战路径、网络安全合规实施、机密信息保护治理）在结构中心性和证据密度中占据关键位置；增强证据覆盖在特定条件下促进机制推理从警告级迁移到通过级，可通过"证据对齐-阈值升级"审计机制解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供统一语言用于跨年度比较和文档迁移的推理强度评估；将国家安全文本从可读叙述转化为可重放、基于阈值、可证伪的推理对象集合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共安全和网络治理提供可验证的证据基础风险控制；支持国家安全报告的语义审计和推理验证。

title: Dynamic Complementarity
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago, Columbia University and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Dynamic Complementarity
detail.abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at one age promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and provide evidence on dynamic complementarity using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国农村家访项目数据，探讨了动态互补性概念，即早期技能投资促进后续技能增长，并分析了在没有正式干预情况下先天、父母和环境因素对学习成长的影响。
AI.research_question: 动态互补性如何影响儿童技能发展？在没有正式干预的情况下，先天因素、父母因素和环境因素如何影响学习成长？
AI.motivation: 理解早期投资如何影响后续技能发展对于儿童发展政策制定至关重要，特别是在资源有限的农村地区。通过分析中国农村家访项目数据，可以深入了解动态互补性机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态互补性理论：早期技能投资形成的技能存量会促进后续投资的技能增长。人力资本积累理论，强调先天禀赋、家庭投入和环境因素的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用中国农村家访项目的独特数据，分析儿童发展干预效果。采用实证分析方法，比较干预组和对照组，评估动态互补性效应。
AI.findings: 早期家访干预显著促进了儿童技能发展，验证了动态互补性效应。同时发现，在没有正式干预的情况下，先天能力、父母投入和环境因素也对学习成长有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为动态互补性理论提供了实证证据，深化了对人力资本积累过程中早期投资重要性的理解。拓展了儿童发展理论，强调了多种因素的综合影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国农村儿童早期发展政策提供依据，支持家访等早期干预项目的推广。为家长和教育工作者提供指导，强调早期投资和综合环境支持的重要性。

title: RIGHTS TO UNITE -European integration through the societal mobilisation of EU derived rights?
affiliations: Sutherland School of Law, University College Dublin, University College Dublin (UCD), University College Dublin (UCD) and University College Dublin (UCD)

detail.title: RIGHTS TO UNITE -European integration through the societal mobilisation of EU derived rights?

publicationDetails.detailsText: RIGHTS TO UNITE – European integration through the societal mobilisation of EU de-rived rights?
publicationDetails.journalName: UCD Law Working Papers in Law, Criminology & Socio-Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This working paper sets out the RIGHTS-TO-UNITE initial theoretical framework. This framework will inform the qualitative socio-legal comparison to be undertaken within the RIGHTS TO UNITE project and will be revised after each step of this research.

The paper begins with a condensed introduction to the notion of European integration as societalization, capturing our initial perceptions of the integrative and disintegrative effects of European integration on European societies and the emerging European society, culminating in our specific understanding of Europeanization through societalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RIGHTS-TO-UNITE初步理论框架，用于指导RIGHTS TO UNITE项目中的定性社会法律比较研究，并将随着研究进展不断修订。该框架基于欧洲一体化作为"社会化"的概念，分析欧洲一体化对欧洲社会和新兴欧洲社会的整合与分裂效应。
AI.research_question: 欧洲一体化如何通过"社会化"过程影响欧洲社会和新兴欧洲社会的整合与分裂？
AI.motivation: 需要建立一个理论框架来指导RIGHTS TO UNITE项目中的定性社会法律比较研究，以理解欧洲一体化对欧洲社会的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲一体化作为"社会化"的理论框架，分析欧洲一体化对欧洲社会的整合与分裂效应，以及通过社会化过程的欧洲化。
AI.method: 定性社会法律比较研究，采用迭代修订的理论框架方法。
AI.findings: 本文是初步理论框架，尚未报告具体研究发现，但提出了分析欧洲一体化社会效应的概念工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了RIGHTS-TO-UNITE初步理论框架，将欧洲一体化概念化为"社会化"过程，为分析欧洲一体化社会效应提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为RIGHTS TO UNITE项目提供了可操作的研究框架，指导后续的定性社会法律比较研究，并可根据研究进展进行修订。

title: Local Economic Shocks and Human Capital Accumulation: Evidence from Rwandan Coffee Mills
affiliations: World Bank Group, World Bank - Africa and United Nations University

detail.title: Local Economic Shocks and Human Capital Accumulation: Evidence from Rwandan Coffee Mills
detail.abstract: We study the medium-term effects of policy-driven income shocks on human capital accumulation in low-income environments. Using administrative data on test scores of the universe of primary school students in Rwanda and the staggered rollout of coffee mills in the country, we show a positive spillover effect of the coffee mills on students’ performance. Early life exposure to coffee mills is associated with a 0.09 standard deviation (4%) increase in student test scores. Improvements in household welfare, child health, and school attendance are likely operative channels of impact.

AI.tldr: 卢旺达咖啡厂建设对低收入家庭儿童学习成绩有积极溢出效应，早期接触咖啡厂的学生考试成绩提高0.09个标准差（4%），主要通过改善家庭福利、儿童健康和学校出勤率实现
AI.research_question: 政策驱动的收入冲击对低收入环境中人力资本积累的中期影响是什么？具体而言，卢旺达咖啡厂建设如何影响小学生的学业表现？
AI.motivation: 理解政策干预（如咖啡厂建设带来的收入冲击）对低收入国家人力资本发展的影响，为发展政策提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 收入冲击与人力资本积累理论，家庭资源约束模型，儿童发展的人力资本理论
AI.method: 使用卢旺达所有小学生的行政考试成绩数据，结合咖啡厂建设的交错推出设计，进行准自然实验分析
AI.findings: 咖啡厂建设对学生成绩有正向溢出效应，早期接触咖啡厂的学生考试成绩提高0.09个标准差（4%），改善家庭福利、儿童健康和学校出勤率是主要作用渠道
AI.theory_contributions: 为收入冲击与人力资本积累理论提供实证支持，揭示了政策干预通过改善家庭经济条件促进儿童发展的具体机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达及其他低收入国家的产业发展政策提供依据，表明咖啡厂等产业投资不仅带来经济收益，还能通过人力资本积累产生长期发展效益

title: Financial Innovation and the Case for Precautionary Oversight

detail.title: Financial Innovation and the Case for Precautionary Oversight
detail.abstract: This policy essay examines the role of financial innovation in the global financial crisis of 2008 and evaluates the regulatory lessons that emerged from that period. Focusing on the widespread use of complex financial instruments, including collateralized debt obligations and mortgage-backed securities, the analysis highlights the interaction between excess liquidity, misaligned incentives, and inadequate oversight. The essay further explores the role of credit rating agencies and the transmission of systemic risk across interconnected financial markets. Drawing on the concept of a financial precautionary principle, the paper argues that novel financial products should be subject to heightened scrutiny prior to widespread adoption, analogous to safety testing in other high-risk industries. The essay concludes that responsible innovation requires a regulatory framework that balances market efficiency with systemic stability and public trust.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了金融创新在2008年全球金融危机中的作用，分析了复杂金融工具（如CDO和MBS）与过度流动性、激励错配和监管不足的相互作用，提出了基于金融预防原则的监管框架建议。
AI.research_question: 金融创新在2008年全球金融危机中扮演了什么角色？从这一危机中可以吸取哪些监管教训？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机暴露了复杂金融创新产品带来的系统性风险，需要深入分析金融创新与监管之间的关系，以防止类似危机再次发生。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融预防原则、系统性风险理论、金融创新与监管关系理论、激励错配理论
AI.method: 政策分析论文，基于历史事件分析和理论框架应用，采用定性分析方法
AI.findings: 复杂金融工具（CDO、MBS）与过度流动性、激励错配和监管不足相互作用，导致系统性风险传播；信用评级机构在危机中发挥了关键作用；金融创新需要更严格的预先审查机制
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融预防原则应用于金融创新监管，提出了金融产品"安全测试"的概念框架，深化了对系统性风险传播机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立平衡市场效率和系统稳定的监管框架，提出对新型金融产品实施预先审查机制，为政策制定者提供具体的监管改进方向

title: Self-assessed Life-Cycle Saving Behavior in the U.S. and Singapore: Procrastination Versus Economic Shocks
affiliations: RAND Corporation, RAND Corporation and Max Planck Society for the Advancement of the Sciences - Munich Center for the Economics of Aging (MEA)

detail.title: Self-assessed Life-Cycle Saving Behavior in the U.S. and Singapore: Procrastination Versus Economic Shocks
detail.abstract: It is widely believed that procrastination contributes to under-saving. Using household survey data from the United States and Singapore, we find little evidence to support this view. In both countries, indicators of procrastination have only weak, if any, explanatory power for saving regret. About half of respondents aged 60–74 expressed regret about not having saved more, but this sentiment was primarily associated with exposure to economic shocks rather than procrastination. A larger share of U.S. respondents reported saving regret, reflecting their greater exposure to adverse shocks. In contrast, Singapore’s system of mandatory saving for retirement, housing, and health expenses appears to mitigate the long-term financial impact of such shocks. However, with little opportunity for risk pooling, Singapore households still remain vulnerable to shocks. These findings highlight the importance of institutional design in risk protection over the lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现拖延症与储蓄不足之间没有显著关联，储蓄后悔主要与经济冲击暴露有关，而非个人拖延倾向。美国受访者因面临更多经济冲击而报告更多储蓄后悔，新加坡的强制储蓄制度缓解了冲击的长期财务影响，但缺乏风险共担机制仍使家庭面临脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 拖延症是否真的导致储蓄不足？储蓄后悔的主要驱动因素是什么？不同制度设计如何影响家庭应对经济冲击的能力？
AI.motivation: 传统观点普遍认为拖延症是导致储蓄不足的主要原因，但这一假设缺乏实证支持。研究旨在检验拖延症与储蓄后悔之间的实际关系，并探讨不同制度环境下家庭应对经济冲击的能力差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的拖延理论、生命周期储蓄理论、制度经济学中的风险保护机制设计理论、经济冲击对家庭财务的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用美国和新加坡的家庭调查数据，通过统计分析检验拖延指标与储蓄后悔之间的关系，比较两国受访者在经济冲击暴露、储蓄后悔表达和制度保护方面的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 拖延指标对储蓄后悔的解释力很弱甚至没有；2. 约半数60-74岁受访者表达储蓄后悔，主要与经济冲击暴露相关；3. 美国受访者因面临更多不利冲击而报告更多储蓄后悔；4. 新加坡的强制储蓄制度（退休、住房、医疗）缓解了冲击的长期财务影响；5. 但新加坡缺乏风险共担机制，家庭仍面临冲击脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了拖延症导致储蓄不足的传统观点，强调了经济冲击而非个人行为倾向在储蓄后悔中的核心作用，提出了制度设计在生命周期风险保护中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计更有效风险保护制度的依据，建议加强风险共担机制建设，帮助家庭应对经济冲击，减少储蓄后悔和财务脆弱性。

title: Event-Triggered Coordination for Multi-USV Formations in Bandwidth-Constrained Cleaning Operations
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - School of Electrical and Data Engineering, University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - School of Electrical and Data Engineering, University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - School of Electrical and Data Engineering and University of Technology Sydney (UTS) - School of Electrical and Data Engineering

detail.title: Event-Triggered Coordination for Multi-USV Formations in Bandwidth-Constrained Cleaning Operations
detail.abstract: An event-triggered coordination mechanism is introduced for multi-USV formations operating under constrained communication bandwidth. State updates are transmitted only when deviation thresholds are exceeded, reducing network load while maintaining formation coherence. Experiments on a fleet of five USVs over 10 km of accumulated trajectories show a 41% reduction in communication usage with no significant loss in formation accuracy (average spacing error: 0.34 m). The approach enables continuous coordinated cleaning in low-bandwidth environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种事件触发的多USV编队协调机制，在通信带宽受限条件下，仅当状态偏差超过阈值时才传输更新，显著降低了网络负载（减少41%通信使用量）同时保持了编队精度（平均间距误差0.34米）。
AI.research_question: 如何在通信带宽受限环境下实现多无人水面艇（USV）编队的高效协调控制？
AI.motivation: 多USV编队系统在海洋清洁等应用中面临通信带宽限制的挑战，传统连续通信方式会造成网络拥塞，需要开发更高效的协调机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件触发控制理论、多智能体系统协调控制、通信受限环境下的编队控制
AI.method: 设计事件触发协调机制，仅当USV状态偏差超过预设阈值时才传输状态更新；在5艘USV组成的编队上进行实验验证，累计轨迹达10公里。
AI.findings: 实验结果显示通信使用量减少41%，编队精度无明显损失（平均间距误差0.34米），在低带宽环境下实现了连续协调清洁能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于事件触发的多USV编队协调控制理论框架，为通信受限环境下的多智能体系统协调提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了适用于低带宽环境的USV编队协调系统，显著降低通信需求的同时保持编队性能，为海洋清洁等实际应用提供了可行解决方案。

title: Integrating Lean and Quality Principles to Improve Product Safety in Sewing and Packing Process of a Kidswear Export House
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on observational process analysis and did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required.

detail.abstract: Product safety is a critical concern in kidswear apparel due to the vulnerability to hazards for children arising from poorly attached trims, sharp accessories or loose components. Export-oriented kidswear manufacturers often operate under strict timelines, which result in increased dependency on manual inspections and multitasking by operators, particularly during sewing and packing processes. These common practices increase the likelihood of human error and safety-related defects. This study is based on an observational case study conducted in the sewing and packing departments of an export house. The study identifies key issues such as manual inspection of trims, operator multitasking, and reliance of defect detection through end-line inspections. Using established quality and lean management principles, the study proposes improvements aimed at reducing safety risks while maintaining operational efficiency. The case findings highlight that safety issues in kidswear production are often linked to process inefficiencies rather than lack of awareness. Integrating quality management tools, standardized procedures, and ethical frameworks can significantly enhance product safety and compliance during production. The study provides practical insights for merchandisers, quality professionals, and supply chain managers involved in kidswear apparel production.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过案例观察发现，童装生产中的安全问题主要源于流程效率低下而非意识缺乏，提出通过质量管理工具、标准化程序和伦理框架整合来提升产品安全性和合规性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过流程改进减少出口导向型童装制造中的安全隐患，同时保持运营效率？
AI.motivation: 童装产品安全至关重要，但出口制造商在严格时间压力下依赖人工检验和多任务操作，增加了人为错误和安全缺陷风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质量管理和精益管理原则，包括标准化程序、流程改进和伦理框架。
AI.method: 在出口工厂的缝纫和包装部门进行的观察性案例研究。
AI.findings: 识别出关键问题：人工检验装饰件、操作员多任务处理、依赖最终检验发现缺陷；童装生产安全问题通常与流程效率低下相关，而非意识缺乏。
AI.theory_contributions: 将质量管理原则与童装安全实践相结合，提出流程效率与产品安全的关联性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为采购员、质量专业人员和供应链经理提供实用改进方案，包括整合质量管理工具、标准化程序和伦理框架来增强生产过程中的产品安全性和合规性。

title: Dynamic Coverage Allocation for Multi-Vessel Waste Collection Based on Density-Aware Region Partitioning
affiliations: Delft University of Technology - Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime, and Materials Engineering, Delft University of Technology - Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime, and Materials Engineering and Delft University of Technology - Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime, and Materials Engineering

detail.title: Dynamic Coverage Allocation for Multi-Vessel Waste Collection Based on Density-Aware Region Partitioning
detail.abstract: Efficient large-area waste collection requires adaptive spatial allocation among multiple unmanned surface vessels. A density-aware region partitioning method is introduced, using kernel density estimation to quantify waste distribution maps obtained from visual observations. Region boundaries are adjusted using a workload-balancing rule within leader-follower subgroups. Experiments using eight simulated waste fields and three 40-minute lake trials demonstrate a 28.7% reduction in mission time and a 24.1% improvement in area coverage balance compared with static partitioning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于密度感知的区域划分方法，用于多无人水面艇的大面积垃圾收集。该方法利用核密度估计量化视觉观测得到的垃圾分布图，并在领导者-跟随者子组内使用工作量平衡规则调整区域边界。实验显示，相比静态划分，任务时间减少28.7%，区域覆盖平衡性提高24.1%。
AI.research_question: 如何实现多无人水面艇在大面积垃圾收集任务中的自适应空间分配？
AI.motivation: 大面积垃圾收集需要高效的空间分配策略，静态划分方法无法适应动态变化的垃圾分布，导致任务效率低下和资源分配不均。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于核密度估计的密度感知区域划分理论，结合领导者-跟随者子组架构的工作量平衡规则。
AI.method: 1) 使用核密度估计量化视觉观测得到的垃圾分布图；2) 在领导者-跟随者子组内应用工作量平衡规则动态调整区域边界；3) 通过8个模拟垃圾场和3次40分钟湖上试验进行验证。
AI.findings: 相比静态划分方法，提出的密度感知区域划分方法使任务时间减少28.7%，区域覆盖平衡性提高24.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于核密度估计的密度感知区域划分理论框架，为多智能体系统的自适应空间分配提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可用于实际湖泊垃圾清理的无人水面艇协同控制系统，显著提高了大面积垃圾收集的效率和资源利用率。

title: Organisational Succession Science: Why Succession Fails Despite Formal Planning: An SPR Diagnostic of Structural, Psychological and Relational Misalignment
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Organisational Succession Science: Why Succession Fails Despite Formal Planning: An SPR Diagnostic of Structural, Psychological and Relational Misalignment
detail.abstract: Succession processes continue to fail across organisational contexts, even where legal, financial and governance planning is extensive. Working Paper No. 1 Established Organisational Succession Science as a field concerned with continuity across leadership and ownership transition. Working Paper No. 2 developed the OSI Model and its Structural, Psychological and Relational framework, and Working Paper No. 3 advanced the OSI Legitimacy Model as a mechanism through which authority becomes accepted and enacted. This paper extends that cumulative programme by offering a diagnostic explanation for succession failure despite formal preparedness. Drawing on governance research, family business studies, leadership transition literature and institutional theory, the analysis argues that structural arrangements often provide certainty without producing authority. When planning is confined to structural domains, psychological legitimacy and relational authority remain unmanaged; leaders can hold legal control while lacking accepted leadership, and predecessors can relinquish office while retaining influence. The paper identifies recurring failure trajectories, including slow organisational decay, successor burnout, governance fragmentation and performative succession; it positions these outcomes as systemic and predictable rather than accidental. The paper is descriptive and theory building and is intended to support subsequent empirical study design within the OSS programme.

AI.tldr: 该论文诊断了组织继任失败的原因：尽管有正式的结构性准备，但缺乏心理合法性和关系权威，导致继任者拥有法律控制权却缺乏被接受的领导力，前任者放弃职位却保留影响力。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织在拥有充分法律、财务和治理规划的情况下，继任过程仍然会失败？
AI.motivation: 继任过程在各种组织环境中持续失败，即使有广泛的法律、财务和治理规划。需要解释这种正式准备与继任失败之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理研究、家族企业研究、领导力过渡文献和制度理论，特别是OSI模型（结构性、心理性和关系性框架）和OSI合法性模型。
AI.method: 理论构建和诊断性分析，基于先前工作论文的累积研究计划，旨在支持后续的实证研究设计。
AI.findings: 结构性安排通常提供确定性但不产生权威；当规划仅限于结构领域时，心理合法性和关系权威未被管理；识别了四种失败轨迹：组织缓慢衰败、继任者倦怠、治理碎片化和表演性继任。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了组织继任科学领域，提供了继任失败的系统性解释框架，将失败轨迹定位为可预测的系统性结果而非偶然事件。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织识别继任失败的潜在模式，强调需要超越结构性规划，管理心理合法性和关系权威，为设计更有效的继任流程提供指导。

title: The Silk Road of Ashes: Exposure to NAFTA and Adult Mortality
affiliations: Austin Peay State University and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: The Silk Road of Ashes: Exposure to NAFTA and Adult Mortality
detail.abstract: The implementation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) in 1994 resulted in a great restructuring in industry composition in the US, with substantial heterogeneity across local areas. In this paper, we investigate the effects of NAFTA on the mortality rates of the working-age population. We implement event studies and difference-in-difference analyses to examine dynamic changes in mortality rates in different years relative to NAFTA and in areas with differential exposure to NAFTA. Comparing areas with high versus low trade exposure measures, we find a 2.1 percent rise in the mortality rate of those aged 25-55. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests a 7.3 percent rise in mortality for the treated population, who lost their job due to NAFTA. Further analyses using a wide range of alternative data sources suggest that reductions in income-employment, reductions in wealth, increases in disability, decreases in health insurance coverage, decreases in private health insurance, and a higher likelihood of reliance on presumably lower quality public insurance as candidate mechanisms.

AI.tldr: NAFTA实施导致美国工作年龄人口死亡率上升，特别是在贸易暴露度高的地区，25-55岁人群死亡率增加2.1%，因NAFTA失业的人群死亡率增加7.3%。
AI.research_question: NAFTA如何影响美国工作年龄人口的死亡率？
AI.motivation: NAFTA实施导致美国产业重组，各地区受影响程度不同，需要研究这种贸易政策变化对人口健康的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策变化通过就业、收入、财富、医疗保障等渠道影响人口健康，地区异质性分析框架。
AI.method: 事件研究法和双重差分法，比较NAFTA前后不同年份的死亡率变化，以及不同贸易暴露度地区的差异。
AI.findings: 高贸易暴露地区25-55岁人群死亡率上升2.1%，因NAFTA失业的人群死亡率上升7.3%。机制包括收入就业减少、财富下降、残疾增加、医疗保险覆盖率降低等。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易政策对健康影响的理论机制提供了实证支持，揭示了贸易自由化可能带来的负面健康后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了贸易政策调整时需要考虑健康影响的证据，建议配套社会保障措施以缓解负面健康效应。
